"Franklin and Friends," based on the children's book series featuring Franklin, is a computer-animated series geared toward preschoolers that aims to teach the kids lessons. The series follows Franklin the turtle, now older than in the books and previous TV series, as he experiences adventures and achieves milestones in the community of Woodland, learning lessons along the way. Hipólito es un pianista ciego que ofrece refugio a una joven desvalida llamada Santa. Él se enamora de la chica y hace todo lo posible para que no se dé cuenta de su ceguera al conocer su casa a la perfección, pero un error terminará con la ilusión.
En España, dos hermanos compran a una gitana un billete de lotería que resulta ganador y vuelven con ella a México.

Bruce sits down with Thomas Cahill to discuss his unique journey from the laboratory to the forefront of life sciences investing, with advanced degrees from Duke University and a foundation in chemistry.

Thomas Cahill dives deeper into the venture creation model that has made Newpath Partners a force in biotechnology; Tom is a founder, investor and board member across numerous groundbreaking healthcare companies.

Explore the allure and rising momentum of gold as an alternative investment, especially as prices soar to all-time highs; from ancient empires to modern portfolios, discover why gold continues to shine as a hedge against inflation.

Hosts robot fights from competitors all over the world.

Cosmetic dentist designs celebrity smiles; new laser zaps unwanted tattoos; Elysium develops "Fountain of Youth" pill.
Many don't know it, but New York is a city that runs on steam; it's one of the few cities that relies on the old technology to heat some of its famous buildings.
New York has some famous bridges; these engineering examples have helped set the tone for how bridges around the world are designed.
New York City might be known as the concrete jungle, but its nearly 30,000 acres of park space have been an ever-present part of this metropolis.
Keeping the lights on in New York City is no easy task; as New York moves towards a greener future, the manner of generating electricity will have to evolve.

On this episode of the BiggerPockets Money podcast, Jeremy Schneider of Personal Finance Club explains how Trump Accounts work, who should open one, how they compare to 529 plans and custodial accounts (UGMA/UTMA), and why they may become.

On this episode of the BiggerPockets Money Podcast, hosts Mindy Jensen and Scott Trench sit down with Cody Berman to uncover how he achieved financial independence before age 30 and built a $5 million net worth through entrepreneurship, side hustles.
Eleven Madison Park leads the plant-based culinary revolution; Le Poisson Rouge reimagines the indie music scene; Air Company introduces the future of fuel.
Why office-to-apartment conversions are booming; infinite machine builds EV bikes for cities; inside Tribeca Immersive's AI judgment booth.
New York is known as one of the rattiest cities in America with an estimated population of close to 2 million rodents; here is how New York City rats out its rodents.
The yellow taxi cab is the quintessential New York City ride; the threat of ride-share apps and city scandal has left cab drivers to face debt.
Many things come to mind when thinking about New York, but how the city deals with its garbage is usually not one of them; here is how the city hauls away its trash.
New Yorkers create, on average, 1.3 billion gallons of wastewater per day that makes its way through 7,500 miles of pipes that make up the city's sewer system.
Una joven va con su novio a bailar y la abuela de ella sale a buscarla de noche en delegaciones, discotecas y cabarets.
A punto de casarse, un ranchero se salva de tamaña catástrofe cuando su caballo le contesta con un "no" al cura.
Un hombre pobre decide solucionar sus problemas económicos al forzar a una de sus hijas a casarse con un hacendado.
Dos grandes amigos son muy mujeriegos, pero uno ama a la hermana del otro, pero por enredos de faldas la pierde.
Cuando un hombre pierde dinero en el juego, y olvida ir a su propia boda, su novia embarazada es enviada a Europa.
Un joven maestro llega a un colegio para señoritas para impartir la materia de música y escandaliza a la directora.
Una niña es adoptada por un regimiento militar y educada como varón, cuando ella se enamora creen que es un marica.
Un grupo de jóvenes se pierde en el desierto al caer su avión, mientras que lejos de ahí su empresario los espera.
Dos rancheros terminan su trabajo en la hacienda y van a la fiesta de un pueblo donde se gastan el dinero de su tío.
José José muestra la realidad de la vida de una estrella y cómo la fama, el dinero, y los placeres pueden destruirlo.

Desde pequeñas, Yolanda y su hermana gemela Irene sufren por el abandono de su padre. Al crecer, Yolanda se convierte en cantante y encuentra el amor, mientras que Irene sufre tragedias y decepciones. El destino las enfrenta con su padre de nuevo.
Durante una gira por los Estados Unidos, un cantante argentino se enamora de una artista mexicana que es casada.
Una famosa cantante de rancheras abandona su carrera, cuando muere su esposo, pero luego se arrepiente de su decisión.
Un hacendado muere de disgusto cuando su rival le hace creer que le ha quitado legalmente sus propiedades.
En una agradable amistad entre un hombre despreocupado y un muchachito, surge una extraña sorpresa.

The Maclean brothers, Paul and Norman, live a relatively idyllic life in rural Montana, spending much of their time fly-fishing. The sons of a minister, the boys eventually part company when Norman moves east to attend college, leaving his rebellious brother to find trouble back home. When Norman finally returns, the siblings resume their fishing outings, and assess both where they've been and where they're going.

On the way to a tryout with the ⚾🐻 [MLB] Chicago Cubs, young baseball phenom Roy Hobbs (Robert Redford) is shot by the unstable Harriet Bird (Barbara Hershey). After 16 years, Hobbs returns to pro baseball as a rookie for the last-place New York Knights. Despite early arguments with his manager, Pop Fisher (Wilford Brimley), Hobbs becomes one of the best players in the league, and the Knights start winning. But this upsets the Judge (Robert Prosky), their owner, who wants Hobbs to lose games, not win.
A woman (Jill Ireland) hires a bush pilot (Charles Bronson) to free her husband (Robert Duvall), framed for a murder, from a Mexican prison.

Undersea adventure about a couple who become involved in a dangerous conflict with treasure hunters when they discover a deadly shipwreck in Bermudan waters. When they realize that the cache includes morphine, the pair enlist the help of an old treasure hunter to escape the drug dealers who hid their product amidst the sunken wreck.

On the planet of Krull, an evil creature called the Beast decimates the world's army and kidnaps the lovely Princess Lyssa, who is destined to become queen. Her brave beau, Prince Colwyn, leads a motley band of warriors, including Ergo and Kegan, to rescue his beloved. However, before he can face the Beast, Colwyn must locate a mystical weapon known as the Glaive, which he can use to slay the hideous villain.
A giant crocodile goes head-to-head with a giant anaconda. The town sheriff must find a way to destroy the two monsters before they kill the whole town.

Science fiction adventure about a group of people who attempt to contact alien intelligence. Roy Neary (Richard Dreyfuss) witnesses an unidentified flying object, and even has a "sunburn" from its bright lights to prove it. Roy refuses to accept an explanation for what he saw and is prepared to give up his life to pursue the truth about UFOs.

Charlie Lang (Nicolas Cage) is a simple, kindhearted New York City cop. When he realizes he has no money to tip waitress Yvonne Biasi (Bridget Fonda), Lang offers her half the winnings of his lottery ticket. Amazingly, the ticket happens to be a winner, in the sum of $4 million. True to his word, Lang proceeds to share the prize money with Biasi, which infuriates his greedy wife, Muriel (Rosie Perez). Not content with the arrangement, Muriel begins scheming to take all the money.

In this adaptation of Truman Capote's seminal true-crime novel, ex-convicts Perry Smith (Robert Blake) and Richard Dick Hickock (Scott Wilson) hatch a plan to rob a wealthy Kansas family, the Clutters. The men enter the Clutter home expecting to find a safe filled with cash, but in fact find no money at all. Enraged, they kill the entire family and flee. While on the run, they face not only the realities of their terrible crime but also their own earthly impermanence.

Princess Salome (Rita Hayworth) is the daughter of King Herod (Charles Laughton) of Galilee. Cast out after her affair with Caesar's nephew, Salome finds herself back in the kingdom of her father when she falls in love with Claudius (Stewart Granger), the commander of her father's army. Meanwhile, Salome's evil mother, Queen Herodias, is continually being condemned by John the Baptist, and plotting to use Salome as a tool to get the prophet executed.

Theodora Lynn (Irene Dunne) is secretly the author of a salacious novel written under a pen name. She must hide her identity from the residents of her small, conservative Connecticut town, who disapprove of the book. When Theodora goes to New York to visit her publisher (Thurston Hall), she meets the book's cover artist, Michael Grant (Melvyn Douglas), who tries to convince her to reveal herself as the real author. When Theodora falls for Michael, she soon finds that he has secrets of his own.

Libidinous Hogan (Jack Lemmon) is a landlord who prefers to rent his rooms to attractive single females. Hogan is instantly smitten with a pretty new tenant named Robin (Carol Lynley), but realizes that he'll have to contend with Robin's boyfriend, David (Dean Jones), if he's to attain the object of his desire. He gets his opportunity when he learns that the couple's living arrangement is a pre-marital experiment to see if they would be compatible as partners when sex is out of the equation.

When his impoverished past is uncovered, Matt Howard is promptly fired by the Peytons, a wealthy family in Williamsburg during the Revolutionary War era. Undeterred, Matt returns to court the family's daughter, Jane, and the two marry and raise a family in the Virginia backwoods, infuriating the Peytons. The birth of a crippled son results in years of tension between Matt and Jane, and, when Matt decides to join the army, Jane makes a stunning decision.

After saving the life of his royal father's usurper, Pelias (Douglas Wilmer), whom he fails to recognize, Jason (Todd Armstrong) is encouraged by the conniving murderer to begin a quest in search of the Golden Fleece. In doing so, Pelias hopes for Jason's death to thwart the prophecy that he will reclaim the throne. Along the journey, Jason is protected by the goddess Hera (Honor Blackman), and his crew includes Hercules (Nigel Green) and Acastus (Gary Raymond), a saboteur planted by Pelias.

High-spirited Irish immigrant Marty Maher (Tyrone Power) is an awkward misfit at West Point until he's taken in as an assistant by kindly athletic director Capt. Herman J. Koehler (Ward Bond). A budding romance that turns into a happy marriage to a fellow Irish immigrant, housemaid Mary O'Donnell (Maureen O'Hara), also helps Maher mellow into a beloved and long-standing fixture at the military academy, where his career as an officer and mentor spans 50 years. This film is based on a true story.

Arriving in Tokyo two days before the 🏅 [Olympics] Olympic Games, Sir William Rutland (Cary Grant) struggles to find accommodations due to the number of tourists. When Rutland responds to a roommate-wanted ad posted at the British Embassy, he meets Christine Easton (Samantha Eggar), who reluctantly allows him to move in. Soon, Rutland decides to offer half of his room to an American athlete, Steve Davis (Jim Hutton) -- and when he notices Easton and Davis hitting it off, he tries to bring them together.

Rich playboy Peter Kirk (Henry Fonda) crashes into Dr. Helen Hunt (Barbara Stanwyck) on a ski slope and overplays his injuries so she will continue her medical attention. He declares his love, and, although Helen insists that her career will always come first, the two get married. Soon, Peter is consumed by jealous suspicions of his wife's male patients and embarrasses Helen several times. Fearful of driving her away, Peter launches into character-changing behavior to prove his love.

Sweet-natured Alice Sycamore (Jean Arthur) falls for banker's son Tony Kirby (James Stewart). But when she invites her snooty prospective in-laws to dinner to give their blessing to the marriage, Alice's peculiar extended family -- including philosophical grandfather Martin Vanderhof (Lionel Barrymore), hapless fledgling ballerina sister Essie (Ann Miller) and fireworks enthusiast father, Paul (Samuel S. Hinds) -- might be too eccentric for the staid Kirbys.
The Durango Kid (Charles Starrett) and his sidekick (Smiley Burnette) look for stolen gold with a history.

Alvarez Kelly (William Holden) is a Mexican cattle rancher who is doing his best to stay out of the Civil War. He has no interest in which side may win or lose -- Kelly is far more concerned about his own survival, and about making money. He soon finds himself in the middle of the conflict, however, when a confederate colonel (Richard Widmark) captures the rancher and forces Kelly to help his soldiers steal a nearby herd of cattle, which they desperately need for food.

During the end of the Civil War, Major Dundee guards Confederate prisoners, Union deserters and ordinary hard-bitten criminals in a remote fort. When Apaches attack the fort and make off with three children, Dundee must set up a posse including Confederates, who face a choice between joining up or being shot. The feud between Dundee and Tyreen is also heated up by a sultry Mexican widow.

Four soldiers of fortune are hired by a wealthy rancher to rescue his beautiful young wife who has been kidnapped by a villainous Mexican bandit. When they finally find her, after fighting their way across deserts and mountains, they discover she is not being held against her will. This causes friction within the band whether they should honor their agreement.
Superior Springfield rifles help scouts (Dennis Morgan, Richard Denning) and the cavalry get forts built in Wyoming.

Noble cowboy the Durango Kid (Charles Starrett) gets snared in a vicious feud between two warring stagecoach operations. One of the two has been recently willed to spitfire Mary Halliday (Carole Mathews), whose father the Kid suspects was murdered by a business rival. With the help of his trusted friends Tex Harding (Tex Harding) and Cannonball (Dub Taylor), the Kid hopes to uncover the truth while hiding the investigation from the strident Miss Halliday.

The conniving Ed Barker (Dick Curtis) murders a rancher and tries to steal the ranch from his widow, Jean Andrews (Ann Doran). However, their old friend Cliff Houston (Charles Starrett) appears on the scene to try and save the day. He makes a deal with Barker and his crew to drive the Andrews herd to market and split the money, but each man really plans to con the other as soon as the time is right. Along for the ride is singing cowboy Bob Stevens (Bob Nolan).
Framed for a murder he didn't commit, a cowboy hides with a traveling woman as he flees a sheriff and hunts for the real killer.

On his way to jail, bandit Tom Tanner (Forrest Tucker) escapes the law and is pursued by Andy Barclay (Randolph Scott), a federal marshal who believes that Tanner will lead him to a stash of stolen gold. Barclay changes horses at the ranch of Karen Galt (Dorothy Malone), planting the seeds of romance before following Tanner to a mine shaft where the stashed loot is hidden. But a gang of outlaws who also want the gold then arrives, forcing Tanner and Barclay to team up and fend them off together.

For a fee, hard-drinking Texas marshal Guthrie McCabe (James Stewart) agrees to help Army officer Jim Gary (Richard Widmark) search for a group of whites who were abducted years earlier by Comanche warriors. After rescuing two of the abductees, McCabe and Gary find that the former captives have fully adopted the culture of their American Indian captors and are barely recognizable. Cultures collide as they attempt to return the settlers to their original -- and now long-forgotten -- lives.
A cowgirl vigilante (Wanda Hendrix) proves to a deputy (Lon McCallister) that the sheriff (Preston Foster) is an outlaw.
The scout's grandson (Bill Elliott) foils land-grabbers; his sidekick (Dub Taylor) flirts with twins.

The inhabitants of a small western community turn on Jim Guthrie (Dana Andrews) when he becomes the prime suspect for a murder he didn't commit. Before getting a chance to prove his innocence, Jim is driven from his home and into the wilderness, where he is left for dead. Despite the danger, he comes back years later, discovering that he's still a wanted man. But a kindhearted local named Chris (Dianne Foster) believes his story, and together they begin a desperate search for the true culprit.
Two old-time Wyoming fur trappers (Charlton Heston, Brian Keith) try to protect a runaway Indian (Victoria Racimo) from her angry ex-mate.

Un hombre que se rehúsa a dejar de comer en exceso sufre un desmayo por comer mucha grasa. A pesar de que su esposa le pide que coma sanamente, su madre lo defiende. El hombre decide ir al nutriólogo para llevar una vida más saludable.
Un joven se aprovecha de su novia porque ella está muy enamorada de él. Ella le hace todos sus trabajos de la escuela, mientras él la engaña con otras chicas de la universidad.

Un hombre se dedica a seducir mujeres al por mayor sin ninguna clase de remordimiento; sin embargo, pierde la vida en un accidente. Al morir, su hermano Víctor quien jamás pensó en tener hijos decide hacerse cargo de sus sobrinas.

Una joven trabaja en una clínica donde hacen cirugías plásticas y se enamora del médico, pero cree que él no se fijará en ella por no ser delgada y comienza a dejar de comer. Luego reacciona al ver que su amiga fallece por padecer anorexia.
Un niño se orina en sus pantalones y sus padres tienen que cambiarlo de escuela. El niño descubre que el compañero de clase que lo hostiga con saña brutal también padece de enuresis.
Una joven se obsesiona con su profesor y trata de tener una relación con él, pero él la rechaza. La chica hace unas pruebas falsas para que todos crean que él trató de seducirla.
Una joven tiene que enfrentar el intento de suicidio de su madre provocado por su alcoholismo y por el desamor de su exmarido. La joven trata de complacer a su madre en todo para que no sufra más.

Un sacerdote se quita su hábito porque tiene mucho calor, un joven le ofrece bolearle los zapatos, pero es una trampa para asaltarlo, lo golpea y se desmaya. El sacerdote se despierta y no recuerda nada.
Un joven comienza a salir con un chico, pero su hermano y su exnovio se preocupan porque piensan que es un asesino serial que ha estado matando mujeres en su colonia.

Mario busca integrarse al grupo de un chico que se dedica a robar cosas personales a sus compañeros de la escuela y a los profesores. Un día una joven acusa a otra chica de haber robado su celular. Mario defiende a la chica, pero esta se molesta.

Desde que era niño, Ricardo ha sufrido abuso sexual por parte de su padrino, quien también es su entrenador de fútbol. Al sentirse mal, le hacen unos análisis y le diagnostican cáncer testicular, por lo que busca justicia.
The latest on a con man who has used many different identities -- and may be a killer.
An update on a California chef who jumped off a cliff after his wife went missing.
A bookie comes under suspicion when his wife is killed.
A man who was tried three times over 13 years for killing his family goes free.

Tommy Carlton owed his ex-wife Elizabeth $85,000 in back child support; so he allegedly paid a hit man $2,000 to make her go away permanently; the hit man was an undercover cop and Elizabeth helped stage her demise.
Aileen Wuornos sold her body to survive; this generated a deep-seated rage for those who would pay for her services which allegedly resulted in the deaths of seven Florida men.

When an unknown assailant guns down sheriff-elect Derwin Brown shortly after winning his election, investigators suspect a political assassination, only to instead uncover an extensive trail of corruption.

Lita McClinton thinks the man at her door is just delivering a dozen pink roses, but the delivery guy delivers death instead; the decades-long hunt for justice spans multiple continents before reaching a dramatic conclusion in an Atlanta courtroom.
Tragedy follows after a young couple argues over the wife's career and the husband's stay-at-home duties.
A series of random killings in Redlands, Calif., leaves police with no clues; the manager of a fast food restaurant finds the ID of one victim in the trash; another ID leads to a suspect.
A 23-year-old woman's loyalty to her friend comes at the price of her life, in a case of being in the wrong place at the wrong time.
A teen made famous by five weeks of nonstop hiccups makes headlines again -- for murder; the downfall of "fixer" to Hollywood's elite Anthony Pellicano.
Wolfgang Beltracchi's world-famous paintings turn out to be fakes; the love triangle of a schoolteacher, a married mom and a hot skydiving instructor ends in murder at 13,000 feet.
A homeless housekeeper bludgeons his employers to death; an astronaut goes on a 900-mile road trip to seek retribution from her ex-lover's new partner.

Tyler Edmonds was just thirteen when he confessed to helping his half-sister Kristi Fulgham kill her husband, Joey; did he really commit murder, or was he just one more in a long line of men that Kristi had manipulated to do her bidding?

Investigators compared the gruesome scene of Earl and Terry Robertson's death to that of the Charles Manson murders; how the quiet and mild-mannered Meredith Moon became an accomplice to one of South Carolina's most horrific crimes.
After her husband Brent was murdered, Renée Poole's multiple affairs and secret life as a stripper makes her the main suspect in his death.

When the body of 22-year-old Misty Morse is found floating in the Indian River, police suspect one of her many boyfriends; with only a piece of nautical rope and a strip of duct tape to go on, an unusual kind of DNA could actually break the case.

Small-town plumber John Cataneo fixes other people's homes for a living, until death came knocking on his front door; to find out who wanted him dead, police investigate the contents of Cataneo's own home, and get the leak they need.

What begins as another sun-soaked day in Boca Raton, Fla., ends in blood-soaked violence, leaving a mother of three a quadriplegic; police find that this seemingly random act may not have been so random after all.

Firefighters make a desperate effort to save a family from a fire, but rescuers arrive too late; police declares the fire was no accident and begins an arson investigation, which includes another unexplained fire that killed a beloved elderly couple.
A camper gathering firewood in Arizona's scenic Sunset Crater National Park is shocked to discover the body of a young woman in a traditional long dress; her Mennonite family and friends are stunned.
A woman wages a psychological war against the person she believes killed her daughter.
Christopher Coleman, former head of security for televangelist Joyce Meyer, is convicted of murdering his wife and two children.
Bret switches identities with a millionaire in a plot aimed at the affections of a beautiful girl.
An ex-gunman is torn between his obsession with revenge and his responsibility to a 6-year-old girl and a lonely widow.
A mysterious stranger (Sam Elliott) befriends and protects a settler (Tom Conti) and his wife (Kate Capshaw) in 1876 Wyoming.
After leaving Dodge City, Bat Masterson takes a job as manager of Denver's Palace Theatre. There he falls in love with Emma Walter, a juggling virtuoso known as the Queen of Clubs.
Two friends from the Union Army find themselves on opposite sides of the law after the war.
Movie, Western, Action, Adventure, Crime drama, Mystery
For saving his life, Ben offers some Ponderosa farmland to an American Indian.
An outlaw joins the Cartwrights' cattle drive, knowing it will take him to the town where his father is the sheriff.
An ex-rodeo rider (Kenny Rogers) leaves his family in Texas and goes to Wyoming for a government round-up.
Only one of the Maverick brothers will be able to collect on a business proposition offered to them by a beautiful lady.

Ex-bounty hunter Talion (Robert Lansing) comes home one day to find his house ablaze and his entire family slaughtered. He soon learns that the culprits are a gang led by nasty Ike Slant (Slim Pickens). While tracking the outlaws, Talion meets fellow bounty hunter Benny (Pat Wayne), who's also after Ike. Initially mistrustful of each other, Benny and Talion are forced to work together when, during a shootout with the criminals, the latter is blinded and the former injures his shooting hand.
Bret thinks he sees a miniature England after he becomes stranded in the desert.
The corrupt sheriff of Stagge City jails Cheyenne on charges of vagrancy.
Cheyenne takes an old mill train home.
An eccentric old friend of Lucas' arrives in North Fork.
A kindly neighbor of Lucas' believes he is President Lincoln.

Newlywed Benjamin Taber is in town with his bride when a bank robbery goes awry, and she disappears in a chaotic shootout. Determined to find her, Benjamin seeks out the help of crusty Quentin Leech, a bounty hunter who has his own reasons for wanting to catch the outlaws. As they follow the group's trail, they receive help from several unlikely sources, including Flora Mae Pepper, the owner of a brothel that doubles as a safe haven.
Jane and Frankie work hard to solve the murder of someone who grew up with them; Jane and Maura must decide when to reveal the truth about Lydia's pregnancy to Angela.
A statue breaks open to reveal a dead woman inside; the squad gets a new homicide detective; Dennis Rockmond returns to Boston and tries to woo Maura; Lydia goes into labor.
Amanda Finley will stop at nothing to keep her son Jackson from marrying Olivia, who she believes is after his money.
A teacher (Kathy Baker) tries to help her teenage son (Paul Dano) make the right decision after he impregnates a classmate.
A woman (Joan Cusack) tries to help her teenage daughter (Mae Whitman) with the college-admissions process.

An executive (Alexandra Paul) returns to her hometown to save a mill from closing and learns that an employee (Cynthia Preston) is plotting revenge on the exec for the suicide of the brother of the worker.
A novelist becomes a suspect in a murder investigation after the death of her neighbor.

After being attacked, a young woman wakes from a coma with retrograde amnesia. She relies on her fiancé and best friend to help her piece together her memories, but mysterious flashbacks force her to question what really happened.
After the death of his wife, a grieving man (Nicholas Brendon) plans to steal away the spouse (Chandra West) of his neighbor (Vincent Ventresca).

Kate is looking for the perfect match online when she swipes and meets Walker, a jet-setting art dealer. After Kate falls for the dashing dealer, she learns that he is a hustler who cons women out of their money.

Jane and the team try to find the contamination source after a man dies from poisoning; Stanley's true feelings are revealed; Tommy and Lydia disagree about custody of their baby; Detective Korsak reunites with his ex-wife.
A famous author's suicide might not be all that it seems; Frost reviews an old murder case; Jane discovers Angela's new romance.
The virtual world and the real world collide when a microbrewer is killed; Angela starts seeing someone new; Jane and the team mentor underprivileged teenagers.
A former college football player is stabbed during a fundraiser; Frost's mother visits Boston.
Dr. Hope Martin returns to ask Maura for a favor; Jane worries about Lt. Col. Jones' spinal surgery; Tommy shows off baby T.J.; a building collapses.
A community parade turns deadly; Maura does not seem like herself; Lt. Col. Casey Jones reveals some shocking news.

A young married couple is found murdered execution-style inside their new home; a teenage boy descends into a state of mental confusion as his obsession with a violent movie character causes his world to blend fiction and reality.
An outcast joins a military-style cult of misfit teenagers; two high school football players share the fantasy of committing an armed robbery.
Upon visiting the home of a woman found strangled to death in a local park, police discover her family has been murdered as well.
A teen forms a friendship in an Internet chat room that takes him down a dark road; a real monster stalks the town of Amarillo on Halloween night in 1979.

A 16-year-old girl who lives across the street from an elementary school begins shooting at students from her window; in May 2007, experts are called to investigate a bloody crime scene in Manheim Township.
A teenager is coerced into a criminal plan by a vindictive mother; after committing petty theft, three teens are chased by police.
A fire in January 2007 claims the life of WWII vet Bennie Angelo; a closer look at the crime scene reveals Bennie was dead before the fire, bumping an arson case up to homicide.
In the 1980s, a suspected serial killer preyed on women in small towns located on the banks of the Mississippi River until the murders abruptly ceased and went unsolved.

The 1964 murder of 9-year-old Marise Chiverella leaves the town of Hazleton, Pa., in fear; an intense manhunt yields numerous suspects but no killer; five decades pass before a student moonlighting as a genetic genealogist reignites the case.

When beloved mother and sister Janora Stevens is found brutally stabbed in her Tulsa, Oklahoma, home, her family is divided and increasingly suspicious of each other; the case chills until a trail of tell-tale fibers leads cops to her killer.

In 1984, Jack Kennedy discovers his daughters brutally murdered; their mother and niece spend their lives keeping the case alive; thirty years later, an informant gives up a name, but the family's ordeal is far from over.

In July 1997, the brutal murder of 19-year-old Tiffany Johnston rocks the small town of Bethany, Okla.; DNA evidence points to her killer over a decade later and leads to the buried bodies of two other missing women in Texas.

When firefighter Gary Parks is killed in a fire ruled to be arson, the investigation into his death shifts to homicide; a serial arsonist is thought to be the culprit, but it takes a dogged cold-case detective to track down the real killer.
A charismatic passenger stirs up conflict between the immigration staff, while customs officers target those smuggling animal products.
TSG, a special unit, fights against every Nothing Hill gang.
Women are not well represented in the police, but they play a key role in India and Palestine where they deal with special cases involving women.
Suspected swallower, illegal cigs, a pistol, and a coal ship search.
The city is embracing the festive spirit to the max with drunken revelers and Christmas parties keeping the paramedics firmly on their toes.

Rodolfo llega a la casa grande, donde corre e insulta a Esmeralda. En un acto ruin, la lleva a la fuerza a casa de Lucio para entregársela. Al llegar José Armando, le exige a su padre que le dé la ubicación de su esposa y les confiesa su matrimonio.

Crisanta y Dominga le dicen toda la verdad a Rodolfo, pero no les cree hasta que Blanca da su versión de la historia. Ante tal situación, revela dónde está Esmeralda y José Armando corre a salvarla. Así, Esmeralda conocerá su verdadero origen.

Adrián y Graciela huyen para poder estar juntos. Rodolfo está consternado por todo lo ocurrido, pero duda de lo que le han dicho y no piensa ceder ni ante las pruebas. Esmeralda le confiesa algo a Fermín.

Rodolfo continúa en su posición de orgullo y no acepta a su hija. Fátima le aconseja no hacerle lugar en la familia a Esmeralda, a pesar de la opinión de Blanca. Esmeralda sigue torturándose, creyendo que sucedió algo entre ella y Lucio.

Erika sospecha que Fernanda continúa enamorando a Eduardo. Fernanda se sorprende al saber que Erika decidió adelantar la fecha de su boda. Gonzalo se molesta al saber que por culpa de Fernanda, Camilo está encarcelado.
Santiago se alegra al saber que Aurora está esperando un hijo. Bárbara convence a Gonzalo de no ayudar a Camilo a salir de la cárcel. Santiago se molesta al saber que Camilo abusó de Aurora.

Bárbara le confiesa a Aurora la verdad sobre su origen. Fernanda teme que Gardenia les cuente a todos sobre su relación con Eduardo. Gardenia idea un plan para arruinar la boda de Eduardo. Eduardo besa a Fernanda.
Erika sufre al saber que Eduardo está enamorado de Fernanda. Bárbara descubre que el hijo que espera Priscila es de Vladímir.
Steve y Eduardo llevan a cabo sus planes para deshacerse de Artemio. Eduardo descubre que Barbara es la madre de Aurora.
Bruno y Elvira llevan a cabo sus planes para deshacerse de María y de su negocio. Santos comienza un plan de escape para huir de prisión, pero las cosas se le complican.

Giuliano se alegra al recibir la noticia de que Santos ha muerto. Wendy le confiesa a Justo que su embarazo es de alto riesgo. Michael se niega a aceptar que Santos ha muerto por lo que idea un plan para encontrar su cuerpo.
Rodrigo se pelea con un compañero de su escuela y Paloma trata de arreglar la situación, pero solo logra empeorarla. Giuliano entra al cuarto de Wendy y amenaza con matarla.

Coloso canta en un bar para pagar la cuenta. Fernando le dice a Ana que la ama y quiere estar con ella toda la vida. Rodrigo encuentra a Paloma con otro hombre y se aleja de ella, pero todo es un malentendido.
Santos se sorprende al ver a María después de tanto tiempo. Wendy da a luz, pero su vida aún corre peligro, pues Giuliano se hace pasar por un doctor para asesinarla.

Fátima finge mostrar la casa a Esmeralda, pero intenta deshacerse de ella. Cuando, al dejarla sola, la joven cae en la piscina, Graciela corre en su auxilio. Mientras, en la ciudad, José Armando visita a Lazcano para programar la cirugía.
Eladio entra al cuarto de Julia, ella se altera mucho y le pide a la enfermera que no lo deje pasar. Por su lado, Regina le pide a Arturo que le diga la verdad sobre su relación con Julia.
Nina culpa a Regina de que Arturo le haya pedido el divorcio. Por su lado, Daniela le dice a Eladio que David y Regina tienen una relación.
Arturo visita a Julia en el hospital y le asegura que nunca la ha dejado de amar. Por su parte, David le dice a Arturo que está dispuesto a hacer lo que sea con tal de estar al lado de Regina.

Consuelo le cuenta a Arturo la verdad sobre su pasado y él promete hablar con Erick para ayudarla. Julia está decidida a dejar a Eladio. Por otro lado, Franco chantajea a Arturo para que Eladio no se entere de que él estuvo en el hospital.

Eladio encuentra a Franco hablando con Arturo, él le dice que estaba diciéndole que ellos se harán cargo de las construcciones de Santiago. Eladio se molesta porque Julia se fue del hospital sin avisarle.

Isabel le dice a Facundo que si se va a un spa con ella por solo una noche, lo dejará en paz. Facundo le dice a María que se irá a un viaje de negocios para estar con Isabel. Santiago le suplica a Isabel que no lo engañe con Facundo.

Union vet Ned (Joel McCrea), gunned down by some tough cattle rustlers, comes to in a wagon train under the care of kindly widow Ellen (Virginia Mayo). But, as he heals, he senses all is not well, and realizes that the suspicious men leading the train are taking the settlers to land owned by his estranged half-brother, an embittered man who will shoot any strangers. Ned then tries to warn the pioneers, while preparing to face the sibling who harbors a deep-seated grudge against him.

A former Union officer, John Hayes (Randolph Scott) now manages a stagecoach company. However, Clay Putnam (Andrew Duggan), a businessman still loyal to the South, is intent on robbing the coaches operated by Hayes, which transport gold to the North from California. Hoping to heist the treasure as a way to revive the Confederacy, Putnam also has a grudge against Hayes, since his wife, Norma (Virginia Mayo), was once involved with the handsome Union soldier.

During the end of the Civil War, Major Dundee guards Confederate prisoners, Union deserters and ordinary hard-bitten criminals in a remote fort. When Apaches attack the fort and make off with three children, Dundee must set up a posse including Confederates, who face a choice between joining up or being shot. The feud between Dundee and Tyreen is also heated up by a sultry Mexican widow.

Former Union soldier John Parrish (Glenn Ford) wants to sell his ranch and start a new life by settling down out east. However, the ruthless tactics of Lew Wilkison (Edward G. Robinson), the scheming businessman interested in his property, make Parrish reconsider the move, especially after one of his ranch hands is murdered. Adding to the increasingly tense conflict is Wilkison's wife, Martha (Barbara Stanwyck), who is cheating on her husband with his brother, Cole (Brian Keith).

Morgan Hickman is a tough gunslinger with a knack for keeping his cool in tense situations. When he wanders into a town where the local lawman has been killed, he finds callow but eager Ben Owens temporarily acting as sheriff. Soon Ben, who wants to keep his new position, is looking to Morgan for guidance. Though the bounty hunter has his own issues with law enforcement, he admires Ben's enthusiasm and decides to train him to be an effective sheriff.

In New Mexico, one-time bounty hunter Joe Kidd owns a ranch where a nearby group of Mexican revolutionaries, led by Luis Chama, fights for their rightful land after the U.S. government denies their claims. In response, a greedy landowner gathers a posse to capture Chama and solicits Kidd's assistance. Kidd, who has no interest in the matter, changes his mind when he discovers Chama has stolen a horse and roughed up a worker from his ranch.

Plácido y Plutarco se muestran muy contentos ante su familia y explican que Don Justo les ha dado sus primeras vacaciones pagadas. La familia López se organiza para salir juntos de paseo a Pepetongo.

Mientras Simone se va a Riviera Maya, Paco la espía en redes sociales.

Macedonio toma represalias obligando a Paco y al Borrego a negociar una tregua.
Paco y Brayan están deprimidos por la ruptura de sus relaciones, pero, con la ayuda del Borrego, intentarán recuperarlas.
Paco quiere borrarse el tatuaje de Simone y encuentra un grupo que lo podrá ayudar.
La banda firma un contrato con altos ejecutivos de Televisa para hacer un reality de talento. Zacarías se entera y amenaza con demandarlos. Prisca denuncia a Hassan y la policía lo encarcela.
Ludoviquito está confundido y atrapado entre su primer amor, otra niña que le gusta y unos papás entrometidos que a fuerza quieren ayudarle.
Brad Pitt es un actor muy famoso y Ludovica es una de sus fans. Pero ella se da cuenta de que es su exnovio de la preparatoria, que antes se llamaba Nazario, y empiezan a salir como enamorados.
Ludoviquito quiere entrar a un concurso de los videos más estúpidos de la gente y sin querer se lleva un video de sus papás haciendo cochinadas. Ludovico y Federica tendrán que recuperarlo.
Federica y Lucrecia participan en el torneo de reclamos femeninos. Don Camerino no está muy de acuerdo, así que obliga a Ludovico que haga perder a Lucrecia si no quedara despedido.
Federica asiste a un seminario en un convento para controlar sus celos. Don Camerino le pide a Ludovico que lleve a su sobrina Leonarda al convento porque tiene problemas de alcohol.
Por olvidar su aniversario, Federica exige a Ludovico conseguir un regalo antes de la cena para no dormir a oscuras en una tina, pero él no tiene dinero y ya no sabe qué hacer.
Con mucho espíritu navideño, Federica y Ludovico presentan algunos bloopers que pasan durante las grabaciones.
Ludovico, Federica e hijos van al show del mago Chen Kai. Federica participa como voluntaria en un acto, pero cuando el mago la desaparece ya no sabe cómo hacerla volver.

Vanessa es la nueva representante vecinal, y su primera decisión es aceptar tener como vecino a un nuevo negocio que hace escándalo con unas enormes bocinas. Se cumplen las dos peores pesadillas para Roko.
El doctor Rafael Rivas se muda al edificio y Magdalena no deja pasar la oportunidad para conseguir una consulta gratis.
Silvita trata de mantener limpios los pasillos del edificio, ya que Lorena y Magdalena sacaron todas sus macetas. Mientras Luis trabaja, Pedro y Cris verán una película.
Silvita le demostrará a su vieja amiga Caro que tiene un matrimonio perfecto con Luis. Además, Lorena culpa a Germán por no tener limpio el patio del edificio.
Frankie abre un canal de videos para hablar sobre todo lo que sabe de cine. Mientras tanto, Magdalena quiere tener un departamento con un jardín en el techo.
Magdalena gastará el bono que se ha ganado Arturo en comprar su tan anhelado aire acondicionado. Por otro lado, se anuncia un corte de agua de una semana.
Don Arnoldo, mientras duerme, menciona que tiene un tesoro en el pueblo de Apaseo el Grande, Guanajuato. La familia López implementa un plan para la búsqueda del tesoro.
Plácido es despedido de su trabajo a causa de un incidente de Plutarco con Don Justo. Licha, mientras lee una revista, encuentra un artículo de la bruja Madame Patú, experta en la lectura de cartas.
Plácido busca trabajo desesperadamente. El único trabajo que logra encontrar Plácido es vendiendo tamales. Justito invita a su abuelo materno a cenar a su casa. Tecla abandona a la familia López.
Licha fallece de manera inesperada y los López organizan un emotivo funeral, donde cumplen su última voluntad con sus cenizas. Llega alguien a la casa que amenaza con quedarse para siempre.

Los López deben tres meses de alquiler y la Chivis los amenaza con el desalojo si no le entregan el dinero en 24 horas. Por otra parte, Carlos, el padre de la Nena, ha regresado con la intención de quedarse.

Plácido se lastima el pie y debe guardar reposo de un mes, por eso enviará a Adolfo a que recupere su trabajo. Martina hace un hoyo en la pared y la Nena descubre, a través de este, un departamento abandonado.
María intenta lavar el tanque de agua y queda atrapada en él. En el almacén, Carmelo juega con Delfino y Betza. Doña Lucha no sabe que María está dentro del tinaco y prende la bomba.

Tercer aniversario del coma de María, se apoya a San Hipoclorito arcángel, Albertano la recuerda y Doña Lucha se cree elegida, pide canonizar a Hipoclorito arcángel por milagroso y piensa que María debe morir, va al hospital y trata de desconectarla.

Gracias a una película, Albertano descubre una manera poco inusual de sacar a María del coma. Albertano trata de poner en marcha su plan, pero es interrumpido por doña Lucha y Carmelo. Albertano seduce a María, quien despierta y sorprende a todos.

María sale del hospital y todos en la vecindad la reciben con cariño, María le pide a Doña Lucha le prepare pozole para celebrar que despertó del coma e invita a toda la vecindad. Llega la enfermera a casa de Albertano y pelea con María por su amor.

El chino entra a la escuela y lleva a su casa al Macaco, al verlo Doña Lucha le prohíbe juntarse con él, pero termina aceptándolo. Albertano se entristece, no tiene amigos, pero el chino y Macaco le ofrecen su amistad.

Se aparece la madre de María quién la abandonó por andar de cantina en cantina y en las ferias. En la azotea juega Doña Lucha con toda su familia, al subir la mamá de María se pone a jugar con ellos, apuesta las cosas de María y pierde todo.
Vítor y Albertano se convierten en guías durante un campamento y los niños viven una experiencia no muy divertida.

Vítor convence a Albertano para que lo ayude a montar un consultorio esotérico en el mercado; Vítor se disfraza de brujo, mientras Albertano se las ingenia para investigar la vida de los clientes, provocando un caos con sus engaños.
Oriana escucha los reclamos que Cutberto le dice a Teresa por haber sido una mala mujer con Mariano. Hernán le pide a Esperanza se case con ella y formen una familia.
Teresa comienza sus planes para comenzar a enamorar a Fernando. Esperanza y Hernán se casan en el hospital para comenzar una nueva vida juntos.
Mariano le muestra a Aída el bebé de Esperanza y le pide comprenda que él no es el causante de los errores de Rubén. Oriana le confiesa a Arturo los engaños de Teresa.
Arturo enfrenta a Teresa y le reclama por sus engaños. Aída le deja en claro a Aurora que luchará por el amor de Mariano y se enfrentará a quién sea para conquistarlo.

Arturo planea vengarse de Teresa y para ello le cuenta a Fernando los planes que tiene para que ella se sienta miserable a su lado. Teresa enfurece al saber que Oriana es la responsable de que Arturo desconfíe de ella.

Alejandro confirma que Andrea nunca estuvo embarazada. Karla se roba el dinero de Constancio. Hugo le propone matrimonio a Mili. Damián pone en libertad a Valeria. Pilar, la amiga de Valeria, trata de conquistar a Alejandro.

Constancio le regresa a Andrea el departamento con la condición de estar juntos de nuevo. Mili se pone celosa al ver a Alejandro y a Pilar y le pide a Hugo que anuncie su compromiso. Alejandro se decepciona de Mili y decide seguir con su vida.

Alejandro trata de demostrarle a Mili que realmente la quiere, pero ella no puede creerle. Mili sorprende a Constancio en la tumba de Rosario. Andrea continúa moviendo los hilos de la campaña de desprestigio en contra de Constancio.

Andrea le pide a Karla que sea sus ojos dentro de la mansión. Alejandro le pide a Mili que lo disculpe por no haber creído en ella. Luciana le deja en claro a Braulio que está dispuesta a destruir a Mili.

Ni Hugo ni Alejandro ceden y están dispuestos a pelear por Mili. Constancio cae en la trampa de Andrea y ella recupera su trabajo. Gracias a Gloria, Mili no cae en la trampa de Alejandro y le demuestra a Hugo que ya no lo quiere.
Matilde se ve a escondidas con el teniente Solís, pero su familia se opone a su relación porque es un hombre pobre. Don Joaquín firma los documentos donde reconoce a Manuel como hijo legítimo.
Matilde escribe una carta para Adolfo; su tía le anuncia que esa noche habrá una velada. Matilde recibe carta de Adolfo anunciándole su regreso.

Humberto le dice a Augusta que Manuel les devolverá las escrituras y les pagará la hipoteca a cambio de casarse con Matilde. Augusta le explica a Matilde que están a punto de perder su casa y le ordena que se case con alguien que los saque del apuro.

Augusta le dice a Hilario que Manuel Fuentes Guerra le ha manifestado su interés por Matilde. Adolfo se presenta en casa de Matilde y Augusta le dice que ni su marido ni ella aceptarán que su hija se case con un don nadie.

Adolfo es llevado a San Juan de Ulúa. Manuel le dice a Augusta que se nota que no le agrada a Matilde como pretendiente. Augusta le advierte a Matilde que, después de que Manuel la vio casi desnuda, se tiene que casar con él.

Juan planea hacer que Sofía se case con él lo más pronto posible. Gabriela le pide a Ruth que no le confiese a Sofía que ella no es su hija. A Sofía se le rompe el corazón al saber que Gabriela jamás la ha querido.
Jimena enfurece al ver a Ruth con Juan. Juan le pide a Sofía que sea su esposa de una manera muy especial. Jimena decide separarse de Óscar al ver que él la desprecia.
Sofía prepara todo para su boda con Juan. Óscar decide comenzar sus terapias para volver a caminar. Juan descubre que Raquel es la dueña de todas las propiedades de los Uribe.
Fernando se enfurece al saber que Ruth fue quien evitó que don Agustín muriera. Soledad le advierte a Gabriela que su hijo quiere matarla. El Coyote evita que Ricardo asesine a Raquel.

Gabriela enfurece al saber que Ricardo siempre estuvo enamorado de Soledad. Jimena decide irse del pueblo para poder alejarse de Óscar. Raquel le confiesa al Coyote que Eva es la verdadera madre de Sofía.

Con la información que le entregó Oñate, Aarón confronta a Gaviota sobre su verdadera identidad y le hace creer que fue Rodrigo quien la desenmascaró. Rodrigo descubre que los problemas de la hacienda son un engaño.

Aarón le hace creer a Rodrigo y a la familia que él y Gaviota fueron amantes. Gaviota le confiesa a Clarita que se quedaron sin dinero. Tanto Rodrigo como Minerva buscan a Gaviota para exigirle una explicación, pero no la encuentran.
Aarón le entrega a Oñate el dinero que supuestamente le entregó a Gaviota para alejarse. Gaviota y Rodrigo sufren al sentirse traicionados. Sofía termina por caer ante los encantos de Francisco.

Clarita cree que Gaviota pueda estar embarazada, mientras que Rodrigo se encierra en la hacienda para alejarse de todos. Videgaray y Bruno dudan de las acusaciones de Aarón hacia Gaviota. Daniela le dice a Rodrigo cómo fue que descubrieron a Gaviota.

Minerva le aconseja a Pilar que impida que Videgaray limpie el nombre de Gaviota. Rodrigo no puede más con su dolor y quema los recuerdos de Gaviota, provocando un incendio en su habitación. La salud de Gaviota empeora.

Rubí está segura de que Héctor murió porque Alejandro intervino a su favor. Ante la muerte de Héctor, Rubí se muestra indiferente y cínica. Lucio le cobra todos los favores a Rubí, mientras que Maribel oye que Elisa demandará a Alejandro.

Paco admite que se sintió atraído por Ingrid, así que Lorena decide dejarlo. Las investigaciones sobre la muerte de Héctor dan como resultado el suministro de un medicamento. Rubí acepta la propuesta de Lucio para sacar a Alejandro de la cárcel.
Rubí chantajea a Maribel con la libertad de Alejandro; Ernesto descubre que su padre es el culpable de la muerte de Héctor; Bermúdez mata a Lucio y a su hijo gracias a Rubí.

In the wake of her grandmother's funeral, hotel manager Lisa Reisert is waiting to fly back home when she meets charming Jackson Rippner at check-in. She thinks it luck that they're seated together on the plane, but soon learns otherwise. Jackson hopes to assassinate the head of Homeland Security, but to do so, he needs Lisa to reassign the official's room number at her hotel. As insurance, Jackson has kidnapped Lisa's father.

Ever since his father died, young Kale (Shia LaBeouf) has become increasingly sullen and withdrawn, until he finds himself under house arrest. With cabin fever setting in, he turns his attention to spying on his neighbors, becoming increasingly suspicious that one of them is a serial killer. However, he wonders if he is right, or if his overactive imagination is getting the better of him.

After surviving a car accident, Michelle (Mary Elizabeth Winstead) wakes up to find herself in an underground bunker with two men. Howard (John Goodman) tells her that a massive chemical attack has rendered the air unbreathable, and their only hope of survival is to remain inside. Despite the comforts of home, Howard's controlling and menacing nature makes Michelle want to escape. After taking matters into her own hands, the young woman finally discovers the truth about the outside world.

Factory worker Trevor Reznik (Christian Bale) suffers from insomnia so severe that his condition has taken its toll on his weight and his mental health. When Trevor unintentionally causes an on-the-job accident that horribly injures a coworker (Michael Ironside), he begins to become even more troubled. Despite a relationship with Stevie (Jennifer Jason Leigh), a pretty prostitute, Trevor descends further into paranoia, blaming his problems on an enigmatic figure named Ivan (John Sharian).

When an inner-city Detroit foster mother (Fionnula Flanagan) is murdered in a botched holdup, four of her now-grown adopted children suspect it was no random killing. Rising musician Jack (Garrett Hedlund), former-Marine Angel (Tyrese Gibson), hotheaded hockey player Bobby (Mark Wahlberg) and settled-down husband and father Jeremiah (André Benjamin) go on the hunt for neighborhood criminal kingpin Victor Sweet (Chiwetel Ejiofor) while being trailed themselves by the local beat cops.
Movie, Crime drama, Action, Dark comedy, Thriller, Mystery

After building an empire with bootleg alcohol, legendary crime boss Al Capone (Robert De Niro) rules Chicago with an iron fist. Though Prohibition agent Eliot Ness (Kevin Costner) attempts to take Capone down, even his best efforts fail due to widespread corruption within the Windy City's police force. Recruiting an elite group of lawmen who won't be swayed by bribes or fear, including Irish-American cop Jim Malone (Sean Connery), Ness renews his determination to bring Capone to justice.

Crooked cops on the take -- small-time drug lords -- sleazy informers and sadistic rich kids ready to kill --- for police detective John Shaft, its just another night in the underbelly of New York City, another shift facing down cops and criminals who want him dead and a legal system that thrives on money, not justice.
Movie, Action, Dark comedy, Crime drama, Thriller
Tennessee Sheriff Buford Pusser carries a big stick after thugs beat him up and kill his wife.

A turf battle between New York City street gangs that rages from Coney Island to the Bronx. The Warriors are mistakenly fingered for the killing of a gang leader. Soon they have every gang in the city out to get revenge, and they must make their way across the city to their own turf.

Mike Sullivan (Tom Hanks) is an enforcer for powerful Depression-era Midwestern mobster John Rooney (Paul Newman). Rooney's son, Connor (Daniel Craig), is jealous of the close bond they share, and when Mike's eldest son, Michael (Tyler Hoechlin), witnesses a hit, Connor uses the incident as an excuse to murder Sullivan's wife (Jennifer Jason Leigh) and youngest son. Forced to flee, Sullivan and Michael set out on a journey of revenge and self-discovery.

Amsterdam Vallon (Leonardo DiCaprio) is a young Irish immigrant released from prison. He returns to the Five Points seeking revenge against his father's killer, William Cutting (Daniel Day-Lewis), a powerful anti-immigrant gang leader. He knows that revenge can only be attained by infiltrating Cutting's inner circle. Amsterdam's journey becomes a fight for personal survival and to find a place for the Irish people in the 1860's New York.

The life and career of shock-jock superstar Howard Stern (himself) is recounted from his humble beginnings to his view from the top. Possessing a desire to be an on-air personality since childhood, Stern meanders through the radio world, always with his supportive wife, Alison (Mary McCormack), by his side. Landing a gig in Washington, D.C., Stern meets Robin Quivers (herself), who will become his long-time partner in crime. When the two move to New York, they face the wrath of NBC executives.

Though haunted by combat memories, heroic pilot Ted Striker (Robert Hays) agrees to return to the cockpit to man the controls of Mayflower One, America's first commercial spacecraft. But, as soon as Mayflower One lifts off, an electrical malfunction sends the ship veering off course. A shaken Striker struggles to guide the shuttle through a treacherous asteroid belt, tame its failing computer systems and stop the disgruntled Joe Seluchi (Sonny Bono) from detonating a deadly bomb on board.

Gen. Aladeen (Sacha Baron Cohen) has ruled the oil-rich North African country of Wadiya since the age of six, when 97 stray bullets and a hand grenade killed his father in a hunting accident. After an assassination attempt takes the life of yet another body-double, Tamir (Ben Kingsley), Aladeen's uncle and most trusted adviser, convinces Aladeen to go to New York. Unfortunately, Aladeen has a less-than-friendly reception from exiled Wadiyans, who want their country freed from his despotic rule.

Jim McAllister (Matthew Broderick), a well-liked high school government teacher, can't help but notice that successful student Tracy Flick (Reese Witherspoon) uses less than ethical tactics to get what she wants. When Tracy runs for school president, Jim feels that she will be a poor influence on the student body and convinces Paul, a dim-witted but popular student athlete, to run against Tracy. When she becomes aware of Jim's secret involvement in the race, a bitter feud is sparked.

When North Korean ruler Kim Jong-il (Trey Parker) orchestrates a global terrorist plot, it's up to the heavily armed marionettes of the highly specialized Team America unit to stop his dastardly scheme. The group, which includes the thespian-averse technology expert Chris (Matt Stone), not only has to face off against Jong-il, but they must also contend with F.A.G., the Film Actors Guild, a cadre of Hollywood liberals at odds with Team America's "policing the world" tactics.

Aging pals Billy (Michael Douglas), Paddy (Robert De Niro), Archie (Morgan Freeman) and Sam (Kevin Kline) have been best friends since childhood. When Billy finally proposes to his much-younger girlfriend, all four friends go to Las Vegas to celebrate the end of Billy's longtime bachelorhood and relive their glory days. However, the four quickly realize that the intervening decades have changed Sin City and tested their friendship in ways they had not imagined.

Kirk (Jay Baruchel), an average guy stuck in a dead-end job, can't believe his luck when a gorgeous, successful woman named Molly (Alice Eve) falls in love with him. With no help from his stunned friends, relatives and ex-girlfriend, Kirk must figure out how to make this unlikely relationship work, even though he's the first to admit that Molly is way beyond him.

Despite being well into adulthood, brothers Doug and Steve Butabi still live at home and work in the flower shop owned by their dad. They exist only to hit on women at discos, though they're routinely unsuccessful until a chance run-in with Richard Grieco gets them inside the swank Roxbury club. Mistaken for high rollers, they meet their dream women, Vivica and Cambi, and resolve to open a club of their own.

Tim (Paul Rudd) a rising executive, works for a boss who hosts a monthly event in which the guest who brings the biggest buffoon gets a career boost. Though he declines the invitation at first, he changes his mind when he meets Barry (Steve Carell), a man who builds dioramas using stuffed mice. The scheme backfires when Barry's blundering good intentions send Tim's life into a downward spiral, threatening a major business deal and possibly scuttling Tim's romantic relationship.

Nick Marshall (Mel Gibson) gets a whole new outlook on life when a fluke accident gives him the ability to read women's minds. At first, this "gift" provides Nick with way too much information, but he begins to realize that he can use it to good effect, especially when it comes to outwitting his new boss, Darcy Maguire (Helen Hunt).

After a short fling with a beautiful woman named Lila (Malin Akerman) and at the urging of his friends and family, Eddie (Ben Stiller) proposes marriage. But Eddie didn't realize that Lila is a shrew, and she reveals her true nature during their honeymoon. He then meets Miranda (Michelle Monaghan) and is convinced she is his soul mate. Eddie sets out to woo Miranda and extricate himself from his wife's claws.

As his wedding day approaches, Peter Klaven (Paul Rudd) realizes he has no one to act as his best man. Through a series of "man-dates," he finds Sydney Fife (Jason Segel), and the pair become instant friends. But as Peter's "bro-mance" with Sydney grows stronger, it threatens his relationship with his fiancée (Rashida Jones), forcing Peter to make a choice.
A 40-year-old workshop foreman falls for the daughter of his boss, and nobody approves of the relationship.

La batalla entre los seis escuadrones da inicio y cada punto será vital para salvarse de la sentencia. Los pequeños demostrarán su talento a través de su carisma, su voz, sus pasos de baile y sus increíbles habilidades.

Uno de los seis escuadrones dice adiós y antes de irse, Tadeo le hace una petición especial a los jueces. Los capitanes cuentan sus historias de vida de una manera muy peculiar. Los pequeños bailarines muestran sus mejores pasos.

Grandes estrellas de la música acompañan a los pequeños en el reto de canto. La bailarina argentina, Laurita Fernández, se une como jueza invitada para calificar los retos de baile. Los capitanes rinden homenaje a Verónica Castro.

Es noche de sentencia y los cinco escuadrones darán lo mejor en el escenario. María León se une como invitada al panel de jueces. Los capitanes se enfrentan al reto de "Gali dice" para ganar un punto extra.

Es noche de eliminación y uno de los escuadrones deja la competencia. Los pequeños cumplen el reto de canto de Miguel Bosé con sorprendentes resultados. Los capitanes se enfrentan al reto del "Botonera".

La competencia entra en su recta final y cada prueba será decisiva para los escuadrones. Yuri se une como juez invitada. Los capitanes comparten una parte de su vida con el público. Verónica Castro recibe una sorpresa de parte de su nieta.
Los pequeños reciben como invitada especial a Lucero. Albertano pone a prueba la honestidad de los capitanes. Las parejas tendrán que demostrar sus habilidades en una prueba de baile improvisado.

Los pequeños llegan a la semifinal y uno de los tres escuadrones sentenciados será eliminado. Prince Royce canta al lado de los pequeños sus mejores éxitos. Los capitanes pasan un día especial junto con los jueces.

Después de diez semanas donde los momentos de diversión, alegría y emoción se hicieron presentes, los pequeños viven el último programa de la competencia con un gran performance al lado de grandes artistas como Paulina Rubio.

Biby Gaytán, María León, Albertano y Juanpa Zurita se unen a la nueva temporada y tendrán la tarea de seleccionar a los pequeños competidores. Los escuadrones quedan atrás y la competencia se vuelve individual.
Los jueces se dan a la tarea de seleccionar a los últimos participantes. Los aspirantes se enfrentan en una serie de duelos donde tendrán que demostrar sus cualidades de canto y baile.
Los pequeños tendrán que dar su mejor esfuerzo y demostrar su talento en el escenario, ya que cuatro cantantes, junto con cuatro bailarinas, serán eliminados en el primer duelo de la competencia.

Galilea Montijo presenta los escuadrones que participan en la competencia. Entre los jueces destacan: Bianca Marroquín, Raquel Ortega, Pierre Angelo, Noel Schajris, María José y Manuel Ibáñez. Además de contar con la presencia de Gloria Trevi.

She goes to a bank to get some cash, only to become a hostage in an unfolding robbery, until the getaway driver, Colin (Russell Crowe), saves her from his fellow robbers. They hit the road together, with the cops, her husband and the robbers in pursuit.

Scientists create amphibious supersoldiers and detonate a nuclear bomb. In the midst of the fallout, a monster arrives, leaving Japan defenseless. Mankind's only hope is an irradiated water goblin with death on its mind.

Their battle against Set and his henchmen takes them into the afterlife and across the heavens for an epic confrontation.

Centuries ago, Kaulder managed to slay the all-powerful Witch Queen, decimating her followers in the process. Before her death, she cursed the valiant warrior with her own immortality, separating him from his beloved wife and daughter in the afterlife. Her resurrection now threatens the survival of the human race as Kaulder, the only one of his kind remaining, faces her vengeful wrath.

Now both He-Man and Skeletor's forces arrive on Earth searching for the potent weapon.

This remake of the classic horror film is set in San Francisco. Matthew Bennell assumes that when a friend complains of her husband's strange mood, it's a marital issue. However, he begins to worry as more people report similar observations. His concern is confirmed when writer Jack Bellicec and his wife discover a mutated corpse. Besieged by an invisible enemy, Bennell must work quickly before the city is consumed.

When the Solomons trade in the craziness of big-city life for the quiet of a North Dakota farm, little do they expect the nightmare that follows. Soon after arriving, teenage Jess (Kristen Stewart) and her younger brother see terrifying apparitions and endure attacks from a supernatural source. Jess must warn her disbelieving family before it is too late to save them.

Medical researcher Frank (Mark Duplass), his fiancée Zoe (Olivia Wilde) and their team have achieved the impossible: they have found a way to revive the dead. After a successful, but unsanctioned, experiment on a lifeless animal, they are ready to make their work public. However, when their dean learns what they've done, he shuts them down. Zoe is killed during an attempt to recreate the experiment, leading Frank to test the process on her. Zoe is revived -- but something evil is within her.

Pierde su brazo y ahora enfrenta un grave problema, no puede ejercer su profesión. Descubre que su pareja tenía otra familia y toma represalias, ahora le exigen el pago de los gastos médicos.
Natacha queda como la única heredera de su papá, pero su media hermana Claudia tiene otro testamento. Por otro lado, una familia contacta a la receptora del corazón que donó su hijo fallecido.
Katherine busca desalojar a la suegra por los experimentos que hace. Los padres dejaron que la menor embarazada se case, ella queda emancipada para algunas cosas, pero no para otras.
Asegura que su anciana hermana murió por la excitación sexual que experimentó con dos strippers. Le dan poco presupuesto para una publicidad musical y el resultado es una auténtica basura.
Su marido no solo abusa de ella, sino que además, es el asesino de su anterior esposa. Una "baby-sitter" tiene un incidente en la casa donde cuida de una niña, pero quien muere es su propia hija.
Quiere que su esposa embarazada deje de comer pollo porque afecta el tamaño del pene del bebé. Tuvieron un encuentro sexual con su pareja de inquilinos, ella quiere repetir y él que se marchen.
Dos modelos se pelean porque una de ellas ganó el "casting", después de hacerle una jugada sucia a la otra y provocar su traslado al hospital. Demanda al arrendatario por vivir con una loca.
Pide empleo en un restaurante donde solo trabajan chicas, considera que fomentan la discriminación. Susana le exige que Mario vaya a terapia para que supere su adicción a los videojuegos.
La esposa de Fabio muere durante un paseo en el bote de Edi, ella dejó un seguro de vida a nombre del anfitrión. Tiene que abortar por el ataque de un felino y decide demandar a su condominio.

La doctora Ana María Polo interviene en batallas legales que afectan a los latinos. Como en una corte, las partes presentan testigos y evidencias para que ella emita su decisión. Además, expertos contribuyen con sus conocimientos.
Seguramente se introduce en la casa de su familia verdadera y ahora la reclama como suya. Se hizo un anillo de compromiso con las cenizas de su padre, su madre se niega a que su esposo esté ahí.
Stephany se graba desnuda para su canal de recetas veganas, pero su esposo distribuye el material en una web porno. Ramón usa su gallo como apoyo sexual, su vecino no soporta el canto del ave.
Alexander está hundido en la depresión, su amiga y terapeuta le decide aplicarle un tratamiento de choque y él piensa que morirá. Valentín demanda a Débora por arrancarle un testículo.
Brendan quiere abortar, pues el feto afecta su proceso de transformación, pero su pareja no está de acuerdo. Por enfermedad, convierte a su hija en su cuidadora, una responsabilidad de adultos.
Adrián demanda al amante de su esposa por haber destruido deliberadamente su matrimonio. Juan está obsesionado con una muñeca inflable con apariencia de niña, su esposa está asustada.
La obesidad ayuda a José a luchar contra la eyaculación precoz, pero afecta su salud. Una madre pierde la custodia de sus hijos, porque su esposo hace peligrosos videos de bromas con ellos.
El esposo de Jenny se ha convertido en un narcisista que solo aprecia su propia belleza. Por proteger la calidad de sus plantas de marihuana, elimina una gran cantidad de abejas del vecino.
Contagia de hepatitis A a su yerno y a un amigo, pero no a los nietos. Alina pierde su bote tras ponerlo como colateral de la fianza del hermano de su nuera Fary, y ahora quiere que se lo pague.
Un bebé muere por un "slime" que hicieron sus hermanos mientras estaban con su madrastra. Pide una canción biográfica para su matrimonio, el resultado es tan desastroso que se cancela la boda.
Dos hermanos no se soportan y sus padres no saben cómo resolverlo. Sufre de una rara enfermedad, toma bebidas energéticas para no quedarse dormido, ahora no puede conciliar el sueño.
Efraín demanda a su padre por introducir dos colmillos de león en su maleta para pasarlos por la aduana. La mujer de Pedro se suicida en casa de Lourdes, él cree que ella la incitó.
Katiuska exige que su madrastra pague sus deudas médicas, por su culpa ella perdió su embarazo. María Alejandra acusa a su esposo de usarla como moneda de cambio en una deuda, la violaron.
Luis responsabiliza a Ricardo del suicidio de su hija, lo acusa de prostituirla en Las Vegas. Marta va a prisión por drogas y sus hijos se quedan con su hermana, quien no le permite verlos.
A Camila la van a deportar por culpa de su exjefe Raúl, quien la envió en busca de mercancía y de un amigo ilegal. Mariana demanda a una periodista por informar que había defraudado al gobierno.
Cristian le exige a su madre el dinero que su padre dejó para sus estudios, pero ese fondo ya no existe. En otro caso, Armando y su profesora bailan tango con mucha pasión y Jenny se molesta.
Un dúo de músicos urbanos denuncia que su productor los controla con un reloj que no pueden quitarse. Adrián cumple su deseo de vestirse y actuar como niña, su esposa le pide el divorcio.
Enyer le pide a su tío que cumpla el contrato que firmaron, él se niega porque no cuidó de su hijo. Angélica quiere abortar, cree que tiene al diablo en la barriga, su esposo busca internarla.
Victoria exige que la mujer de su exesposo le pague lo que le prestó, ella alega que vive en su casa gratis. Gustavo pide el divorcio, su mujer lo acusa de matar a la hija por la herencia.
Su esposo la llama por el nombre de su abuela, ella descubre que es su abuelo. La esposa lo espera en tierra y para que no lo atrapen con su amante, la lanza de la avioneta en paracaídas.
Compra la empresa donde sufrió acoso y pone a su exjefe a trabajar como pene gigante. Los duques de Sealand, el país más pequeño del mundo, se enfrentan por títulos nobiliarios y propiedades.

An outlaw and two con men attempt to relieve the Mexican government of $1 million. Once the scam is completed, they have to avoid the attentions of, amongst others, the Mexican army and Billy the Kid - all of whom are eager to claim the cash for themselves.

In the 19th century, the Japanese Emperor sends a gift pony to the US President, but it gets stolen and ransomed by Indians. Sheriff Gideon, assisted by a clumsy Japanese servant, steps up to deliver the ransom.

In San Felipe, bandits target gold meant for the railroad, until a decoy chest thwarts them. When newcomers arrive, a masked gunman begins sabotaging the outlaws. But the real mastermind may be the town's respected leader, hiding treachery behind wealth and charm.
A man comes to Canyon City and becomes involved with two feuding factions after a bank clerk gets killed during a botched holdup.
While Cjamango is away from his farm, six bandits murder his family. Coming to terms with this tragedy, he sets out to avenge his loved ones.

In the 1840s, the Sager family decides to brave the journey to Oregon in hopes of a better life. While traveling along the trail, their wagon train is attacked by natives, which results in the father's death. Shortly after, the family experiences another tragedy when the mother dies of pneumonia. When the wagon train leaders dismiss the seven orphans from the group, the oldest child, John (Stewart Petersen), decides to lead his brothers and sisters to the new life his parents wanted.

When the eldest daughter of a family of settlers is captured by an American Indian warrior, her brother, Sam Sutter (Stewart Petersen), sets out to rescue her. Along the way, he encounters a wise, but alcoholic trapper named Russian (Richard Boone) who agrees to help him. The pair's journey into the remote Red Rock region of Utah is a perilous one, which ultimately brings them face to face with Chief Cut Tongue (Henry Wilcoxon), whose solution to the situation is a treacherous one.
Old Shatterhand, Winnetou and Castlepool battle a ruthless oil baron trying to create a war between Native Americans and white settlers.
A sheriff (Franco Nero) ventures into Mexico to find the crime boss who murdered his father.
An Apache chief raises a white child as his own son.
Nobody knows a mysterious gunfighter who has joined a scramble for stagecoach gold.

In the American West, Willet Gashade (Warren Oates), a former bounty hunter, and Coley Boyard (Will Hutchins), his dimwitted partner, are approached by a secretive young woman (Millie Perkins) who offers them money to guide her through the desert but refuses to discuss why she is traveling. The group embarks on the journey and is eventually joined by Billy Spear (Jack Nicholson), a volatile gunslinger the woman has also hired. The only question is why.
Bank robbers go on the run after a heist when the bank's manager hires a posse to track them down.
