When an asteroid threatens to collide with Earth, NASA honcho Dan Truman (Billy Bob Thornton) determines the only way to stop it is to drill into its surface and detonate a nuclear bomb. This leads him to renowned driller Harry S. Stamper (Bruce Willis), who agrees to helm the dangerous space mission provided he can bring along his own hotshot crew. Among them is the cocksure A.J. (Ben Affleck), who Harry thinks isn't good enough for his daughter (Liv Tyler), until the mission proves otherwise.
Movie, Science fiction, Action, Adventure, Thriller, Fantasy

Just-paroled army ranger Cameron Poe (Nicolas Cage) is headed back to his wife (Monica Potter), but must fly home aboard a prison transport flight dubbed "Jailbird" with some of the worst criminals living. Along with Diamond Dog (Ving Rhames) and Baby-O (Mykelti Williamson), genius serial killer Cyrus "The Virus" Grissom (John Malkovich) unleashes a violent escape plot in mid-flight. Secretly working with U.S. Marshal Vince Larkin (John Cusack), Poe tries to foil Grissom's plan.

In a Mexico City wracked by a recent wave of kidnappings, ex-CIA operative John Creasy (Denzel Washington) reluctantly accepts a job as a bodyguard for 9-year-old Lupita (Dakota Fanning), the daughter of wealthy businessman Samuel Ramos (Marc Anthony). Just as Creasy begins to develop a fondness for the young girl, a bloodthirsty gunman (Jesús Ochoa) kidnaps her. Now, Creasy must pick off a succession of corrupt cops and criminals to reach his ultimate object of vengeance.

Lt. Daniel Kaffee (Tom Cruise) is a military lawyer defending two U.S. Marines charged with killing a fellow Marine at the Guantánamo Bay Naval Base in Cuba. Although Kaffee is known for seeking plea bargains, a fellow lawyer, Lt. Cdr. JoAnne Galloway (Demi Moore), convinces him that the accused marines were most likely carrying out an order from a commanding officer. Kaffee takes a risk by calling Col. Nathan R. Jessep (Jack Nicholson) to the stand in an effort to uncover the conspiracy.

As a puppy, Bella finds her way into the arms of Lucas, a young man who gives her a good home. When Bella becomes separated from Lucas, she soon finds herself on an epic 400-mile journey to reunite with her beloved owner. Along the way, the lost but spirited dog touches the lives of an orphaned mountain lion, a down-on-his-luck veteran and some friendly strangers who happen to cross her path.
An agoraphobic woman (Marin Ireland) unexpectedly connects with the plumber (Paul Sparks) who enters her apartment to make a repair.

In this modern take on Edmond Rostand's classic play "Cyrano de Bergerac," C. D. Bales (Steve Martin) is the witty, intelligent and brave fire chief of a small Pacific Northwest town who, due to the size of his enormous nose, declines to pursue the girl of his dreams, lovely Roxanne Kowalski (Daryl Hannah). Instead, when his shy underling Chris McConnell (Rick Rossovich) becomes smitten with Roxanne, Bales feeds the handsome young man the words of love to win her heart.

Life always seems complicated for good ol' Charlie Brown (Noah Schnapp), the boy who always tries his best against seemingly impossible odds. When the Little Red-Haired Girl moves into his neighborhood, Charlie Brown develops a crush on her. Meanwhile, his best friend Snoopy embarks on an epic adventure in a fantasy world. As a World War I flying ace, the lovable beagle pursues his nemesis, the Red Baron, while also trying to win the heart of a beautiful poodle named Fifi (Kristin Chenoweth).

Tom and Kate Baker compromise their careers to raise 12 children. Tom coaches a high-school football team, while Kate has retired from journalism to raise the family. Things change when Tom is offered a college coaching job in a new city at the same time a publisher buys Kate's parenting memoir. After moving, Kate goes on a book tour, leaving Tom in charge of the children. The children, already unhappy about relocating, plunge the household into chaos.

When the Switchblade, the most sophisticated prototype stealth fighter created yet, is stolen from the U.S. government, one of the United States' top spies, Alex Scott, is called to action. What he doesn't expect is to get teamed up with a cocky civilian, World Class 🥊 [Boxing] Boxing Champion Kelly Robinson, on a dangerous top secret espionage mission. Their assignment: using equal parts skill and humor, catch Arnold Gundars, one of the world's most successful arms dealers.
Movie, Comedy, Action, Adventure, Crime drama

After returning home to England, aristocrat Robin of Loxley learns that the evil Sheriff of Nottingham has seized his family estate. He soon joins forces with Friar Tuck and Little John -- a fierce Arabian warrior who wants to put an end to the Crusades. Armed with arrows and dubbed Robin Hood, Loxley leads a band of oppressed rebels in a daring plan to rob the Sheriff of his money and take away his power.

Following a grueling five-week shift at an Alaskan oil refinery, workers led by sharpshooter John Ottway are flying home for a much-needed vacation. A brutal storm causes their plane to crash in the frozen wilderness, and only eight men, including Ottway, survive. As they trek southward toward civilization and safety, Ottway and his companions must battle mortal injuries, the icy elements, and a pack of hungry wolves.
Movie, Adventure, Drama, Action, Thriller, Horror
A security guard protects an eleven-year-old girl who is being targeted by a gang for participating as a trial witness.

After a string of bizarre bank robberies in Southern California, with the crooks donning masks of various former presidents, a federal agent, Johnny Utah (Keanu Reeves), infiltrates the suspected gang. But this is no ordinary group of robbers. They're surfers -- led by the charismatic Bodhi (Patrick Swayze) -- who are addicted to the rush of thievery. But when Utah falls in love with a female surfer, Tyler (Lori Petty), who is close to the gang, it complicates his sense of duty.
A trooper (Tim Thomerson) leaves 2247 Angel City for 1985 Los Angeles to stop a zombie mystic (Michael Stefani) out to change history.

Inner-city Miami schoolteacher Jane Hetzko gets her knee broken when she stands up to the school's gang leader, Juan Lacas. Her boyfriend, mercenary combat specialist Jonathan Shale, goes undercover as a substitute teacher to take down the punk, but soon discovers that Lacas is merely an underling for the real criminal mastermind. Assembling the team from his last jungle raid, led by his right-hand man, Joey Six, Shale declares war.
Government agents find evidence of extraterrestrial life at the South Pole.

A cop who loses his partner in a shoot-out with gun smugglers goes on a mission to catch them. In order to get closer to the leaders of the ring he joins forces with an undercover cop who's working as a gangster hitman. They use all means of excessive force to find them.

Young entrepreneurs Sean (Emile Hirsch) and Ben (Max Minghella) meet stranded travelers Natalie (Olivia Thirlby) and Anne (Rachael Taylor) at a hot Moscow nightclub. Their whole world changes in an instant when an alien attack devastates the city and everything goes dark. Joined by a Swedish businessman (Joel Kinnaman), the youths emerge from hiding days later and must somehow fight back against a nearly invisible enemy that could find and disintegrate them at any moment.
Movie, Science fiction, Action, Thriller, Adventure, Horror
A Hong Kong policeman (Leslie Cheung) blames his reformed-gangster brother (Chow Yun-Fat) for the death of their father.
After his wife is brutally murdered, a martial-arts master (Scott Adkins) teams up with an old friend (Kane Kosugi) to sharpen his battle skills and seek revenge.

Physical therapist Leslie Wright (Queen Latifah) lands the dream job of working with basketball superstar Scott McKnight (Common). All goes well until Leslie finds that she is falling in love with him. Scott, however, is oblivious to Leslie's romantic overtures and focuses his attention on Morgan (Paula Patton), Leslie's gorgeous friend, who would love to be the basketball player's trophy wife.

A celebration of love and creative inspiration takes place in the infamous, gaudy and glamorous Parisian nightclub, at the cusp of the 20th century. A young poet (Ewan McGregor), who is plunged into the heady world of Moulin Rouge, begins a passionate affair with the club's most notorious and beautiful star (Nicole Kidman).

Born with the snout of a pig, young Penelope Wilhern spends life a virtual prisoner in her home. Believing that the only way to break the curse is to marry one of her own kind, she meets a number of suitors, but all reject her. Two devious men, one with a grudge against the family, hire a man to pose as a suitor, but complications arise when he begins to fall in love with Penelope, and she makes a bid for freedom.
Broken-hearted Brooke Yeardley makes her 30th birthday wish on the vision board she made as a teen. As her wishes start coming true, she finds out that life doesn't always follow a plan.

A street performer (Chris Messina) and an unemployed woman (Jenna Fischer), who's under constant pressure from her sister, help each other realize that it only takes a single person to engender someone's self-worth.

Olivia believes that she's the obvious pick to take over when her father retires from their modeling company. Newcomer Simon threatens to upend Olivia's comfortable bubble along with her role as successor.
Two friends at a 1913 British artists' colony compete for the affections of a comely debutante, but the object of their pursuit soon learns to regret her choice.
A successful writer (Greg Kinnear) tries to reconnect with his two children (Lily Collins, Nat Wolff) after his divorce.
An ageless man-child (Keith Poulson) gets married, has a child and -- along with his best friend (Nick Offerman) -- watches his life fly by.
When hard-working content creator Jenny goes on a retreat searching for a proper work/life balance, she ends up finding love as well.
When a couple can't decide on a wedding theme, they hire two wedding planners, Taylor and Ben, to compete for the job by proposing two very different styles.

Zoey Ross gave up on love and her passion for wedding photography after her fiancé, Todd, left her at the altar five years ago. When a childhood friend insists that she be their wedding photographer, she reluctantly accepts and finds herself again.

When a massive, unmanned locomotive roars out of control, the threat is more ominous than just a derailment. The train is laden with toxic chemicals, and an accident would decimate human life and cause an environmental disaster. The only hope of bringing the train to a safe stop is in the hands of a veteran engineer (Denzel Washington) and a young conductor (Chris Pine), who must risk their lives to save those in the runaway's path. Inspired by true events.

Corrupt National Security Agency official Thomas Reynolds (Jon Voight) has a congressman assassinated to assure the passage of expansive new surveillance legislation. When a videotape of the murder ends up in the hands of Robert Clayton Dean (Will Smith), a labor lawyer and dedicated family man, he is framed for murder. With the help of ex-intelligence agent Edward "Brill" Lyle (Gene Hackman), Dean attempts to throw Reynolds off his trail and prove his innocence.
Movie, Thriller, Action, Adventure, Mystery, Crime drama

Only Hellboy can stop the dark prince and prevent humanity's annihilation.

Christine Brown has a loving boyfriend and a good job at a Los Angeles bank. Her heavenly life becomes hellish when, in an effort to impress her boss, she denies an old woman's request for an extension on her home loan. In retaliation, the crone places a curse on Christine, threatening her soul with eternal damnation. Christine seeks a psychic's help to break the curse, but the price to save her soul may be more than she can pay.

When 16-year-old Nicole Walker (Reese Witherspoon) meets 23-year-old David McCall (Mark Wahlberg) at a Seattle nightclub, she falls in love. David is exciting and charming, and despite the wide age gap, he wins over Nicole's family -- except for her workaholic father, Steven (William Petersen), who's suspicious of David from the start. His concerns are realized when David turns out to be a violent sociopath who sees Nicole as his possession, and her family home a fortress to be invaded.

A free man after years in prison, Carlito Brigante intends to give up his criminal ways, but it's not long before the ex-con is sucked back into the New York City underworld. Reconnecting with his dancer girlfriend, Gail, Carlito gets entangled in the shady dealings of his friend Dave Kleinfeld, who also serves as his lawyer. When Carlito and Kleinfeld run afoul of shifty gangster Benny Blanco, it sets them on a dangerous path.

Under the command of Flavius Aquila in A.D. 120, Rome's Ninth Legion marches north carrying its revered eagle emblem and vanishing into the mists. Rumors of the legion's golden eagle appearing in a tribal temple reach Marcus Aquila (Channing Tatum), Flavius' son, 20 years later. Accompanied by his slave (Jamie Bell), Marcus makes a dangerous journey to Scotland to retrieve the hallowed eagle and, in doing so, to restore his father's tarnished honor.
Black ops specialist Connor Gibson infiltrates a maximum security prison to take down legendary driver Frankenstein in a violent and brutal car race.

While en route to prison, a bus carrying criminals Marion (Laurence Fishburne), Beck (John Leguizamo) and Anna (Aisha Hinds) is rerouted to Detroit's soon-to-be-closed Precinct 13 because of a dangerous winter storm. All communications with the outside world are cut off, and Jake (Ethan Hawke), an emotionally volatile police sergeant who is haunted by his past, is forced to work with the criminals in order to survive an attack on the precinct by a group of armed men.

Billionaire industrialist Damian Hale (Ben Kingsley) is master of his universe, until he encounters a foe that he can't defeat: cancer. His only hope is a radical medical procedure called "shedding," in which his consciousness is transferred to a healthy body. After the procedure, Damian, now called Edward (Ryan Reynolds), starts a new life in New Orleans, but he's plagued by disturbing images. When he delves into Edward's mysterious origin, he learns that some will kill to keep it secret.

Charged with the most important assignment of his career, federal agent Ron Fleury has one week to assemble a team, infiltrate and destroy a terrorist cell based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. Culture shock and opposition from local law enforcement combine to hinder his progress and that of his elite team, but a sympathetic Saudi police captain becomes an unexpected comrade-in-arms.

A 3000-year-old limping mummy (Lon Chaney) seeks his reincarnated princess (Ramsay Ames) in a Midwestern college town.

In Cairo, archaeologist Steve Banning (Dick Foran) unearths a vase that he believes could lead him to the ancient tomb of Princess Ananka. Unknown to Steve, his colleague, Professor Andoheb (George Zucco), is also the High Priest of Karnak who holds the secrets of Karas, a mummy who guards Ananka's tomb. Upon receiving funds from magician Solvani (Cecil Kellaway) and his daughter, Marta (Peggy Moran), Steve and the Solvanis embark on an expedition to the grave site, where Karas awaits.
An old archaeologist recalls the mummy Kharis, now at large in New England.
Pirate Captain Clegg (Peter Cushing), an English vicar by day, leads ghostly mounted smugglers by night.
A man (Lionel Atwill) uses mind over matter to replace his legs, then hunts the doctors who took them.
A lawyer (Robert Taylor) advises a blind man's rich widow (Barbara Stanwyck) tormented by nightmares.

When young Fool (Brandon Adams) breaks into the home of his family's greedy and uncaring landlords, he discovers a disturbing scenario where incestuous adult siblings have mutilated a number of boys and kept them imprisoned under stairs in their large, creepy house. As Fool attempts to flee before the psychopaths can catch him, he meets their daughter, Alice (A.J. Langer), who has been spared any extreme discipline by her deranged parents. Can Fool and Alice escape before it's too late?

Talented Christine (Susanna Foster) is unaware that her singing lessons are being funded by a secret admirer, Enrique (Claude Rains), a mysterious violinist with a disfigured face. Christine's colleagues become suspicious when mysterious accidents start occurring at the Paris Opera House, as the deaths coincide with her meteoric rise to stardom. Christine's suitors, Raoul (Edgar Barrier) and Anatole (Nelson Eddy), brave the dark recesses of the opera house to find the true culprit.

Composer Lord Ambrose D'Arcy (Michael Gough) and his backer, Harry Hunter (Edward De Souza), struggle to find a replacement for the female lead in their new opera after she quits in the wake of a gruesome murder. When a new prospect, the nubile Christine Charles (Heather Sears), disappears, Harry cautiously investigates. Meanwhile, a mysterious masked man (Herbert Lom) who is eerily familiar with the opera holds Christine captive and offers to groom her to play the part.
Florida aquarium workers (John Agar, Lori Nelson, John Bromfield) communicate by cattle prod with a captured gill-man.
Grisly murders convince a turn-of-the-century Londoner that she is the latest in a long line of werewolves.
Count Alucard comes out of a lake in his coffin and makes a Southern belle his bride.

Baron Wolf von Frankenstein is determined to prove the legitimacy of his father's scientific work, thus rescuing the family name from disgrace. With the help of Ygor, a grave robber, Wolf successfully reanimates the monster his father originally brought back from the dead. But when several villagers are killed mysteriously, Wolf must find the culprit in order to vindicate his creation, or face the possibility that he may be responsible.

Short on cash, undergrad David Blake (Dirk Benedict) takes a job working as a lab assistant for snake expert Dr. Carl Stoner (Strother Martin). When Stoner begins giving David a series of antibiotics as a safeguard against snakebites, he at first thinks nothing of it. But gradually David begins to notice curious changes in his body, and his new girlfriend, Dr. Stoner's daughter, Kristina (Heather Menzies), notices them too. Could Dr. Stoner really be trying to turn his assistant into a snake?
Desert scientists (John Agar, Mara Corday, Leo G. Carroll) try to stop a fortified spider the size of a building.

In remote Antarctica, a group of American research scientists are disturbed at their base camp by a helicopter shooting at a sled dog. When they take in the dog, it brutally attacks both human beings and canines in the camp, and they discover that the beast can assume the shape of its victims. A resourceful helicopter pilot and the camp doctor lead the camp crew in a desperate, gory battle against the vicious creature before it picks them all off, one by one.

Aurelio convence a Niñón de que financie la renta de los aviones necesarios en España, para así recuperar el cargamento incautado.
Tony y Mónica hacen negocios con Doble 30 y piensan dejar a Ninón fuera. También planean el secuestro de su hijo. Le dieron instrucciones a Alí para proceder con el ataque.
Ninón le pide a Aurelio que la ayude a encontrar a su hijo, secuestrado por orden de Tony Pastrana. Aurelio la apoya y le promete que lo van a encontrar con vida. El español juega sucio.
Omar disminuye los rumores de que El Señor de los Cielos está vivo. Paloma escapa de la casa presidencial. El primer mandatario le encarga a Casillas una macabra misión contra ella.
Ninón llega al sitio donde tienen secuestrado a su hijo y, momentáneamente, le arruina el operativo de rescate a Aurelio. Casillas le pide a Dalvio que le haga un favor al presidente.
En Marsella, Aurelio toma la iniciativa de atacar a Filemón y a los secuestradores de Leonardo. Alguien resulta herido. Colón y su equipo se enteran de que se están robando la droga decomisada.
Ismael, Raymundo, Chatarrero y sus secuaces recuperan toda la droga. La ubican en las naves robadas y la distribuyen. Dejan muchos muertos a su paso. Ninon revela su secreto a Casillas.
Mónica convence al presidente para que le conceda una audiencia a Pastrana. El español le propone a Terán una vida paradisíaca en el exilio, haciéndose doblemente millonario, pero con una condición.
Ahora que Casillas tocó el corazón de Niñón quiere saber la verdad, si ella mandó a matar a Pilar. Ella insiste en que no lo hizo, pero él no le cree. Rutila se niega a buscar al Chema.
Paloma sufre un paro cardíaco y Omar piensa que murió, pero el médico le informa que la pudieron revivir. Cuando ella reacciona y le pregunta por qué la quiso matar, el presidente desata su ira.

Juan Carlos llega a la casa de Aurelio y él se sorprende. Ismael se entera de que el padre de Esperanza logró dar con ellos. Casillas quiere saber cómo lo hizo. Javi anhela un hijo con Rutila.
Juan Carlos le explica a Aurelio cómo llegó hasta él y Casillas trata de saber si le dice la verdad. Salvatierra propone pagar por el rescate de Esperanza. Mientras hablan, secuestran a Pina.
Aurelio hace un recuento de todos los muertos que lleva en su conciencia. Cree que llegó la hora de deshacerse de alguien más. Por su traición, ahora Mónica teme que Casillas le quite a Isidro.

Rutila llama a Casillas y le pide que tenga piedad con Esperanza, porque ella no tuvo la culpa de que la DEA la capturara. Aurelio es tajante y sella su destino. Un video de Terán lo compromete.

Renata quiere celebrar el aniversario de Plutarco y Gaby, pero no tienen dinero para hacerlo. Gaby y Plutarco buscan ideas para su regalo. Con la ayuda de toda la familia, Gaby y Plutarco festejan su aniversario.

Dos niños son aficionados de las películas de suspenso y tienen un blog para evidenciar a los vecinos que hacen cosas incorrectas. Los niños son testigos de un delito por el cual uno de sus padres es injustamente llevado a la cárcel.
Luego del suicidio de una chica, se decide tomar medidas drásticas para prevenir que esto vuelva a suceder.

Said y Sofía salían, pero al conocer a Michelle, Said se enamora de ella y deciden casarse. No obstante, un asalto termina con la vida de Mich, así que su madre decide investigar para hacerle justicia a su hija.
Allison seduce a Samuel, su alumno, y ambos inician un romance prohibido. Su madre sospecha y descubre que Allison ha hecho esto antes. ¿Podrán ocultar su secreto?
Dos muchachas ganan un concurso artístico en los Estados Unidos, y reciben como premio un viaje a México.
Guadalupe amenaza a Carmina para impedir que siga haciendo daño. Gael le confiesa a Elisa que estuvo con otra mujer. Damián le pide perdón a su mamá.

Leona descubre que fue engañada sobre la muerte de su bebé y que en realidad tuvo dos hijos que le robaron. Para hacer justicia, decide vengarse de la familia de su primer amor, además de buscar y recuperar a sus hijos.
María le entrega la carta a Pedro y él la quema. Montserrat le ofrece una disculpa a José Luis por haber creído que él golpeó a María. Carlota le pide a Ezequiel que se case con ella.
Angélica le pide ayuda a su mamá para organizar una boda sorpresa para Refugio y Esmeralda. José Luis le confiesa a Alejandro que besó a Montserrat. Pedro le ordena a Adolfito que mate a María.
Mariano le deja en claro a Teresa que el amor que sentía por ella ya no existe. Arturo enfurece al ver a Teresa al lado de Mariano.
Teresa lleva a cabo sus planes y besa a Fernando para que quede enamorado de ella. Teresa logra convencer de que Arturo y ella se muden al departamento de Fernando.
Chana le lee las cartas a Ramiro y le advierte que Ana Laura corre peligro y que Ana Lucía murió. La Policía detiene a Santiago y lo interrogan por la muerte de Gina.

Renata le pide ayuda al doctor Lemus para falsificar la prueba de paternidad y hacerle creer a Guillermo que es el padre del hijo que espera. Mónica y sus amigas ayudan a poner una hermosa ofrenda en la vecindad para recordar a sus muertos.

Valentín le pide a Ana Laura que sea su novia, la besa y Ramiro los ve desde lejos. Remedios le dice a Ana Lucía que acepte el trabajo con Aníbal. Iñaki invita a Santiago a su departamento y le dice que cree que ya ha estado ahí.
Guillermo echa a Renata de su departamento. Carmen le confiesa a Lucy que se siente muy mal anímicamente y no la hace feliz volver a ser la directora del instituto.
Enrique le cuenta a Florencia que está dispuesto a casarse con Paloma. Gabino visita a Alfonsina sin imaginar que Damián lo estaría esperando.

Matías besa a Jacinta. Clara no permite que Lili conviva con Silvano. Josefa encuentra una pulsera de Columba entre las sábanas de su cama. Leona les confiesa a Ana Julia y a Benjamín que ella es su madre.
Lety le confiesa a Aldo su amor y empiezan una relación; Omar le pide ayuda a Fernando para conquistar a Aurora; Alicia se muda con Marcia.
Mientras Tomás felicita a Aldo por andar con Lety, Fernando no puede con la situación; Omar sigue buscando a Aurora.
Fernando le reclama a Lety por su relación con Aldo; Carolina le confiesa a Luigi su plan para engañar a Omar; Tomás le compra un anillo de diamantes a Alicia.
Marcia le ofrece su amistad a Fernando con el fin de recuperar Conceptos; Tomás hace todo lo posible por conquistar a Alicia; Lety sigue engañando a Omar.
Ariel y Ana Leticia no están dispuestos a vender sus propiedades; Ana le coquetea a Tomás y Alicia se molesta; Omar sigue buscando a Aurora acompañado de Fernando.
Las mujeres del cuartel vigilan muy de cerca a la mujer misteriosa para descubrir su identidad; Alicia le reclama a Tomás por sus atenciones con Ana Leticia.
Doña Julieta escucha a Omar declararle su amor a Aurora y comienza a investigar. Tomás lleva a Alicia de compras y a conocer a su madre para poder casarse.
Lety organiza una reunión para anunciar su noviazgo con Aldo; Alicia intenta caerle bien a la mamá de Tomás para que acepte su relación; Fernando le cuenta a Omar lo que pasó en la fiesta.

Los integrantes del Comité del Concepto acuerdan que Aurora sea la nueva imagen de la campaña de la empresa, aunque Lety está en total desacuerdo. Marcia le aconseja a Alicia no precipitarse para casarse con Tomás.
Martha y su esposo deciden comprarse una casa; Lety acude a una cita disfrazada de Aurora; Alicia les dice a las del cuartel que canceló su boda.
Omar presenta a los clientes de Conceptos una impostora de Aurora, pero solo logra que lo despidan; Alicia reanuda sus planes de boda.
Tomás invita a Celso y a Simón a su despedida de soltero; Alicia le pide a Marcia que le organice la despedida, pero se termina haciendo en casa de Lety; Aurora acepta trabajar para Conceptos.
Después de muchas dificultades, Lety logra firmar el contrato de Aurora con Conceptos; Alicia y Tomás preparan todo para su boda; Omar sufre desempleado y sin amor.
Marcia se muda con Fernando y Omar; Tomás y Alicia afinan detalles para su boda; Lety conoce a una amiga de Aldo llamada Carmina.
Las mujeres del cuartel se presentan en Televisa para hablar con Juan José Origel sobre la mujer misteriosa; Aurora comienza con la filmación del comercial de Conceptos.
Carolina se pone celosa por la obsesión de Omar con Aurora; el comité planea un nuevo programa televisivo; Alicia y Tomás celebran su boda.
Mientras todos celebran en la boda de Alicia y Tomás, Marcia llora por Fernando; Carolina empieza a reconocer sus sentimientos por Omar.
Debido a la falta de actores, Fernando decide protagonizar el episodio piloto del programa de televisión de Conceptos; Aldo empieza a trabajar con Carmina en un libro de cocina.
Gracias a Fernando, la presentación del episodio piloto es un éxito; Lety comienza a sentirse culpable por su doble identidad y quiere confesarle la verdad a Aldo y su asistente.
Alicia y Tomás regresan de su luna de miel y Tomás le muestra a Alicia su nueva casa; Aurora acepta hacer el programa de televisión de Fernando.
Aldo le propone matrimonio a Lety; Fernando decide coquetear con Aurora para darle celos a Lety; Alicia y Tomás inician su vida de casados.
Aldo y Fernando aclaran su situación respecto a Lety; Carolina le cuenta a Luigi y Marcia cómo se siente por Omar; Alicia despilfarra el dinero de Tomás.
Omar descubre sus sentimientos hacia Carolina; las mujeres del cuartel se preparan para su cita con Fernando Colunga; Fernando le prepara una sorpresa a Lety.
Lety le dice a doña Julieta que se casará con Aldo; Omar está tan feliz con Carolina, que se muestra indiferente con Aurora; comienzan las grabaciones para el programa de televisión.
Comienzan las complicaciones en la filmación del programa de televisión; Omar le rompe el corazón a Carolina; Fernando descubre la verdadera identidad de Aurora.
Lety está decidida a desaparecer a Aurora de su vida; Omar intenta recuperar a Carolina; Irmita y Sara llevan a Martha a una reunión de comedores compulsivos.
Aldo, Fernando y los medios de comunicación presionan a Lety por la desaparición de Aurora; Alicia le dice a Tomás que está embarazada.

Martha está decidida a remediar su desorden alimenticio; doña Julieta regaña a Lety por apresurar su boda con Aldo, ya que sigue queriendo a Fernando, además le pide que aclare el malentendido de Aurora.
Tomás le cuenta a Lety que doña Julieta está intentando sabotear su boda con Aldo; Omar acude con Tomás para poder conquistar a Carolina.

Julian Norton tries to help Labrador Murphy, who has a tumor that another vet declined to remove; Peter rushes to an emergency after treasured racing horse Magnum is involved in a horrendous accident.

Peter performs potentially life-changing surgery to remove two huge lumps from beloved pet pooch Scruff; Julian visits beloved pet pony Smartie, who has a bowel blockage so serious it could be life-threatening.

Pampered papillon Belle is out of sorts, and the only way Julian can find the problem is to operate; Snake the corn snake has a lump and hostile look, leading Peter Wright to err on the side of caution; Candela pays Shetland pony Sparkle a visit.

Peter is called out to an ewe whose labor is worsening; Julian has 50 goats to disbud, but Doris the kid is playing hide and seek; border terrier cross Poppy has bone cancer in one of her hind legs, and the only hope of saving her is to remove it.

In a varied caseload, the vets treat a rapidly deteriorating cow, a cocker spaniel in labor, a hen with diarrhea and a jammed food pipe, a lamb with an injured leg, a ferret with a suspicious lump, a calf foaming at the mouth and a swarm of bees.
Peter is mystified by the contents of a cat's stomach; administering anti-mite spray to the biggest eagles in the world; Julian tries his hand at alpaca dentistry.
Julian Norton operates on a dog's liver tumor; Peter Wright helps a ewe birth triplets and castrates a bull named Eddie the Eagle.

Peter has to cobble together a shoe for a lame cow, a cat that has come off second best in a fight has a badly-injured eye, and a springer spaniel undergoes pioneering surgery when fish skin is grafted onto its infected leg.
Julian tends to a young cow whose uterus has prolapsed while she was giving birth; Peter rushes to save a choking lamb.
Peter treats a retired working dog named Boomer who has a tumor on his bottom; Helen helps a Rhea who has a sore wing after mating season started with a bang.
Patients include a Labrador with a taste for gardening gloves, a hermaphrodite dog and a bloated bull.
Lisa's horse Teal has an unexplained gash on his neck and Tux the black Labrador has a nasty-looking mouth tumor.
Peter rushes to help a ewe struggling with childbirth and a billy goat who needs the snip; meanwhile, Julian helps a pug with a broken leg and gives Lucy the llama a much-needed nail trim.
Peter is called out to help a 10-day-old calf who has been rejected by her mum; semi-retired sheepdog Mick has a tumor wrapped around his spleen, prompting Julian to engage in some risky surgery.

Julian is called to relieve a bull who has a huge abscess on his bum that needs lancing; Peter treats a horse with a mysterious cut that won't heal; Vega, a rat, goes under the knife to remove a tumor.
Both Julian and Peter face long nights as they help two struggling animals give birth; Dudley the hedgehog is brought in with pneumonia; Julian attends to school guinea pig Betty.
Julian Norton visits the young people putting everything they have into their number-one passion, farming.
Celebrating the 40th wedding anniversary of Jean and Steve Green with a renewal of their vows on the farm they lived and worked on since the beginning.
Julian Norton is hoping to fix Gary the donkey once and for all; Peter Wright is not sure if he can save Boris, the three-legged cat.
Peter performs difficult surgery on a tawny owl named Flynn; Anne works fast to remove a tumor from Gerby the gerbil, so that he can be reunited with his human bestie, Harry.
A wallaby with a damaged knee; Rottweiler has swallowed a bottle of e-cigarette fluid.
Peter tends to Marshmallow, a foal struggling to take the vital first feed from mum; Julian operates on new mother Bea, a Labrador who has eaten a large sock.
Julian sets up a blood bank at Jackie's alpaca farm to take vital samples; three years after he took off part of her jaw to tackle a cancerous lump, sheepdog Millie needs Julian's help once again.
A cow has a rare and complex problem; baby deer Berry is dehydrated, but the treatment may be more dangerous than the cure.
Peter aids a ewe with tangled lambs; young farmer Jack faces challenges with his egg-laying flock, seeking professional assistance at the practice.
Peter rushes to aid a cow whose uterus is pushed out post-delivery; Julian faces Arnie, the intimidating ram with sight issues.
In a storm, an alpaca births a cria, prompting Peter's visit; Julian introduces Luna the rabbit and takes in Boris, planning his castration.
Julian tends to Bertha, a champion cow with an eye infection; Peter revisits the Greens to check on a donkey, a routine in their 36-year history.
At Boroughbridge, Julian and Ann operate on Scottie dog with a tumor in her chest.
A Lhasa Apso needs elaborate surgery; a Shetland pony has a painful foot condition.

Years ago, motorcycle stuntman Johnny Blaze sold his soul to save the life of a loved one. Now, he transforms into a fiery, avenging agent of justice at night wherever evil roams. As the only one who can walk in both worlds, Johnny is charged by Mephistopheles himself to destroy Blackheart, a demon that wants to overthrow Mephistopheles and create a worse hell than the one that currently exists.

Gon and the other participants enter the final phase of the exam, a one-on-one tournament where the combatants who kill their opponents disqualify themselves; Gon fights Hanzo in the first match.

Gon becomes the first person to pass the Hunter Exam, much to his own astonishment, and Satotz explains what happened at the end of his fight with Hanzo; Hisoka manages to talk his opponents into surrender; Gittarackur goes on the warpath.
After Illumi's actions force Killua to kill, Gon vows to make things right; the group heads toward Kukuroo Mountain to save Killua from his family.
Gon and his friends, on their way to Killua's family compound, become blocked by a huge stone gate.

The gatekeeper allows Gon and his friends to stay in the servants' quarters and train to open the heavy gate; Killua withstands torture from his brother Milluki; beyond the gate, Gon faces a new challenge.
While Gon and his friends get closer to the mansion, Killua faces his father.
The family butler, Gotoh, refuses to allow Gon and his friends to see Killua unless they win a game.
Gon writes a letter to Aunt Mito recapping the Hunter exam's final phase and the hunt for Killua.
Gon and Killua arrive at Heaven's Arena and advance quickly, meeting Zushi.
Wing explains the four basic principles of Nen to Gon, Killua and Zushi.
Wing's training helps open Gon and Killua's aura nodes so they can pass through the barrier; Gon challenges Hisoka to a fight, but must meet one condition before Hisoka will agree.
Gon learns the nature of Gido's techniques but still faces a tough fight, sustaining injuries and facing Master Wing's disapproval; the Agency rejects Kurapika, but a stranger makes him an offer.
After Wing bans Gon from practicing Nen, Sky Arena hosts a revenge match between Hisoka and Kastro.
Kastro's Nen double puts Hisoka at a disadvantage, and he loses both of his arms in the fight.
Gon, now recovered, continues his Nen training; Zushi gets kidnapped; Killua fights Sadaso.
Gon and Killua fight Riehvelt and Gido; Hisoka praises Gon and offers to fight him.
Gon finally gets his fight with Hisoka.
Gon successfully lands a punch as the match with Hisoka reaches its conclusion.
Gon and Killua go to Whale Island, where Mito and her grandmother reveal Ging's past; Gon tries to open a box his father sent him.
Spurred on by Gon's father's message, Gon and Killua plan to go to Yorknew City.
Kurapika interviews for a bodyguard position that ties in with the Southern Piece Auction.
Kurapika and others battle to escape the mansion; Killua seeks information on Greed Island.
Gon and Killua gather info about Greed Island; the biggest auction in the world prepares to open.
Gon and friends try to raise money; the Phantom Troupe makes its move.
The Phantom Troupe attacks the underground auction, but their prize eludes them.
Uvogin slaughters the Mafia's pursuit, including their elite Shadow Beasts; Kurapika gets a chance to make his move against the Phantom Troupe.
Kurapika gets angry when Uvogin, his captive, makes demands; Hisoka contacts Kurapika to meet up.
Uvogin escapes and vows to get revenge on Kurapika; Kurapika must protect his employer from the Phantom Troupe after the gang discovers his location.
Kurapika and Uvogin come to blows as both combatants aim to settle a score.
Gon, Killua and Leorio, wanting to buy Greed Island, come up with a plan to make money by going to the auction market to bid low on surefire treasures; Leorio investigates the Phantom Troupe.
Gon and his friends hope to win the reward placed on the Phantom Troupe; Machi and Nobunaga search for the "chain user"; Gon and Killua receive a tip and begin shadowing the two Troupe members.
The Phantom Troupe captures Gon and Killua and interrogates them for information on the "chain user"; Killua begins to suspect the user's true identity.

The Mafia expects the Phantom Troupe to attack the rescheduled auction; the Ten Dons hire multiple assassins to deal with the Phantom Troupe; Light Nostrade sends Kurapika to join the assassins in dispatching the Troupe.
The Phantom Troupe attacks the auction; only Zeno and Silva can withstand the relentless assault.
The leader of the Phantom Troupe is dead, and Kurapika is shocked by the news; unconvinced, he tries to get a glimpse of the body; the dead bodies of the other Troupe members have been discovered.
Kurapika meets up with Gon and Killua; Kurapika reveals his Nen ability; Chrollo reads the future of Troupe members.
Chrollo uses his new ability to predict the future and predicts that Hisoka is a traitor; Kurapika and Gon plan to capture Pakunoda.

Chrollo uses the information he has on Neon to identify the location of the chain user, Kurapika; Killua is keeping an eye on the Phantom Troupe base when he is joined by Melody, who helps determine that the Troupe is headed towards Kurapika's hotel.

Gon and Killua are captives of the spiders; Kurapika, Melody, and Leorio hatch a plan to capture Chrollo and use him as leverage to force the remaining Phantom Troupe members to release Gon and Killua.
Kurapika has captured Chrollo; he offers to release Chrollo if Pakunoda brings Gon and Killua to him; however, Kurapika is unable to control his emotions in the presence of the Troupe leader.

The game Greed Island is finally on the auction block; Gon and Killua ask the purchaser to hire them as players, but they're told that their Nen is too weak; they begin to work on special abilities so they can be selected as players.
Gon and Killua want to be Greed Island players, but must demonstrate their Nen to a judge to land one of the 32 available spots.
Gon and Killua enter the world of Greed Island in hopes of finding Ging.
Gon and Killua encounter tough monsters as their quest for spell cards leads them toward Masadora; a mysterious girl named Biscuit observes the two as they fight.
When Biscuit defeats Binolt, Gon and Killua ask her to be their master.
Gon and Killua continue to improve their Nen and work together to gather more monster cards; Bisky advances them to the final stage of their training.
Gon develops a new technique based on rock-paper-scissors; Killua must leave Greed Island temporarily to take the Hunter Exam, leaving Gon and Bisky to deal with Genthru.
With Killua back, the three hunters resume collecting cards, but they still face adversaries who intend to beat them to the goal.
After deceiving Team Tsezguerra, Team Genthru has 96 restricted card slots; Gon and Killua try to stop Genthru from winning by monopolizing Path of Shore.
Gon and his friends make it to Soufrabi and challenge the pirate boss, Razor, to a team sports battle; the hunters head to Aiai, "The City of Love."
Gon, Hisoka and Goreinu challenge Razor; Razor challenges them to dodgeball.
Gon is sent to the outfield; he needs Killua's help to defeat Razor.
Gon, Killua and Hisoka must catch Razor's strongest throw in order to be crowned the dodgeball winner.
Hisoka seeks a Nen user with a unique power; Tsezguerra tries to beat Genthru to win the game; Gon keeps training as Killua gives his hands a rest.
Jotaro and the others arrive in Egypt, and are joined by a Boston terrier named Iggy.
Avdol sets a trap for N'Doul, but it doesn't work.
Kakyoin and Avdol are badly hurt in the battle with N'doul, and are taken to a hospital in Aswan.
Jojo and the others look for a boat to take to Cairo where DIO awaits; Chaka walks along a nearby beach where he finds a sword that glows.
Polnareff defeats Chaka the Anubis Stand user, but the barber he visits suddenly starts talking about Anubis and attacks him.
Jotaro and the others arrive in Luxor; Joseph sees an electrical outlet in a rock and gets shocked when he investigates.
Due to the powers of an enemy Stand, Joseph's body becomes magnetized.
Jotaro gets concerned that Joseph and Avdol haven't shown up yet, and goes to look for them.
Because of the power of Alessi's Stand, Set, Polnareff is turned back into a child.
After a long journey, Jotaro and the others finally reach Cairo and start looking for DIO's mansion.
After losing to D'Arby, Joseph and Polnareff have their souls taken.
Hol Horse arrives at Cairo in order to pursue Jotaro and the others, and joins forces with Mondatta.
Hol Horse and Mondatta follow Jotaro and the others to Cairo.
Following Avdol's advice, JoJo has a beggar look for DIO's mansion.
Iggy ends up in a battle to the death against the falcon that guards DIO's mansion.
Jojo and company finally make it to DIO's mansion, where they meet the butler named D'Arby Younger.
The battle for souls with D'Arby continues as Kakyoin challenges D'Arby to a race game.
The baseball match with D'Arby continues, but Jotaro starts declaring his pitches to D'Arby.
Polnareff can't control his emotions when, after a long journey, they must say goodbye to a friend.
Polnareff is pushed to his limits with Cool Ice's merciless attacks.
Polnareff finally comes face to face with DIO, who offers to allow Polnareff to join him again.
A nighttime battle against DIO takes place in the city of Cairo.
Joseph is able to figure out The World's power because of the message Kakyoin left.
DIO tries to escape, but Jotaro fights a final battle with DIO within stopped time.
In April 1999, Jotaro Kujo travels to the town of Morioh to find a man named Higashikata, the newest JoJo, and comes across a freshman being accosted by upstart students.

Josuke spots villain Angelo's Stand and tells Jotaro, who deduces the Stand can somehow enter people, so he warns Josuke to not eat or drink anything until he can reach him; Josuke witnesses the Stand go into his mother.

Angelo's Stand ability seems connected to DIO; after defeating Angelo, Jotaro tries to find the whereabouts of the bow and arrow related to the Stand; Koichi finds trouble when he walks home with Josuke.

To save Koichi, Josuke goes further into the Nijimura household; he manages to dodge an attack, but it hits Okuyasu, and Josuke offers to heal his wounds if he reveals the identity of his brother's Stand.
Josuke and Koichi defeat Keicho and continue their mission to destroy the bow and arrow; when they hear strange noises in a dark room, they enter into another fight.

Riding his bike to school, Koichi accidentally runs over a bag with a cat inside, killing it; a man appears and demands money from the regretful boy, saying that he'll use it to bury the cat, but the situation only gets worse.

Josuke and Koichi hear from Tamami that a high school student named Hazamada might also be a Stand user, so the two go to the school and investigate; Josuke checks inside Hazamada's locker and finds a strange wooden doll that attacks them.

Koichi's classmate Yukako Yamagishi asks him out, but his joy turns to worry when she unexpectedly loses her temper with him, then performs several acts of generosity for him the next day; as Yukako's obsession worsens, she does the unthinkable.

Koichi plans to escape from Yukako by having Reverb find a payphone and contact Josuke and Okuyasu, but Yukako stays one step ahead of him; as Koichi begins to lose hope, Yukako goes to the phone and something unexpected happens.

Josuke and Okuyasu visit a new Italian restaurant where the chef, Tonio, decides what the customer will eat instead of offering a menu; Tonio offers Okuyasu water that has an unexpected effect on him.

Chili Pepper shows himself to Josuke; he seems to be more powerful than Jotaro, and he can travel anywhere electricity flows; Jotaro summons Josuke, Okuyasu and Koichi and tells them a certain someone approaches Morioh.
Jotaro believes Chili Pepper will try to kill Joseph Joestar by attacking his boat, so he leaves Josuke and Koichi to defend the harbor; Josuke deals with his conflicting feelings toward Joseph.

Josuke and the others capture Akira Otoishi and safely retrieve the bow and arrow, restoring peace to Morioh, but Josuke still can't seem to get closer to the father he just met, Joseph; they discuss Josuke's mother, then discover another Stand user.

Koichi and Hazamada learn famous manga artist Rohan Kishibe lives in town, and they go to get an autograph; Rohan thrills the boys by offering a tour of his studio, but Koichi becomes frightened when he sees just how far Rohan takes his work.

Koichi sneaks into Rohan's house and finds Rohan drawing manga at an incredible speed; Rohan can't stop himself from drawing after reading about Koichi's experiences, and he attempts to take another page from Koichi by using Heaven's Door.

Jotaro unexpectedly invites Josuke to accompany him on a hunt for the rat that gained Stand abilities after Akira Otoishi shot it with the bow and arrow; they trace the rat by discovering strange evidence of the power it wields.

Koichi and Rohan discover an alley not listed on any map and decide to explore it, but when they unexpectedly find themselves back where they started with no exit in sight, Rohan suspects a Stand user trapped them.

Josuke encounters a tiny Stand holding a coin and follows it to a new Stand user named Shigekiyo Yangyu, who sends his Stand to pick up all the loose change around town; Josuke comes up with a better use for Shigekiyo's Stand.

Josuke and the others head to the bank with their lottery ticket, but the bank clerk suspects foul play since someone else's name and phone number are written on the back; when he decides to call the number, Josuke takes desperate action.

A depressed Yukako sees a mysterious shop called Salon Cinderella that creates faces to bring people fortune; she receives a new face that allows her to find love and discovers how well it works during a chance meeting with Koichi.
When Shigechi accidentally takes Kira's sandwich bag by mistake, Kira chases after him.

Yoshikage Kira tries to dispose of Shigechi when Shigechi discovers his secret; Shigechi fights back, but Kira's Stand, Deadly Queen, mortally wounds him; clinging to life, Shigechi tries to warn Josuke about Kira.
Jotaro and Koichi try to track down the owner of the button and run into the murderer, Yoshikage Kira, and his Stand; Koichi ignores Jotaro's order and decides to face Kira on his own.
Koichi manages to survive the battle with Heart Attack; when Kira shows up, Koichi attacks, but Kira has the upper hand and seeks payback for his humiliation.
Josuke and the others head to Kira's house to learn more about him; they make some creepy discoveries until a camera on Kira's desk suddenly takes a picture.

Yoshihiro steals the bow and arrow and looks for people to turn into Stand users to protect his son; Rohan looks for Kira, hoping to find him before he tries to kill off his new family; a strange boy interrupts Rohan and challenges him to a game.
Kira, living as Kosaku Kawajiri, struggles to control his urge to kill, finally snapping when he sees Shinobu's neck; Josuke and Okuyasu encounter a strange person in the middle of a crop circle.
Rohan catches onto Josuke's attempt to cheat him at cee-lo, but when he can't prove it, he cuts off his own pinky and declares that he'll take Josuke's pinky too if he can figure out Josuke's trick.
Jotaro tries to find the mysterious footprint Stand's user, racing around on his motorcycle for a phone to call Koichi for help while the mysterious Stand continues to chase him.
Shinobu discovers a cat in the basement with a hole in its neck and inadvertently kills it in fright; a day after Kira buries the cat in their yard, a strange plant grows on the spot.

A delivery man forgets to put the brakes on his truck; a chicken surprises a woman; a raccoon tries to pass for a household pet; a person only paying attention to their phone has an encounter with a full table of food.

Still reeling from the events, the survivors come across a gun show that makes the zombie apocalypse look tame.
In Nebraska, a zombie tsunami engulfs the survivors and desperate measures must be taken to survive; Citizen Z gets a visitor.
When Mack tries to have a real date with Addy, he finds himself in a nightmare that reminds him of a certain Bill Murray film with déjà vu vibes.
Radioactive zombies aren't the only danger when the survivors visit a town in South Dakota on the brink of nuclear disaster.
An all-female commune in Utah is where the two groups of survivors reunite, but when someone winds up dead, the illusion of paradise is shattered.
Murphy learns more about his abilities when he is kidnapped by a group of outlaws trying to score OxyContin; drug enhanced zombies attack.
Citizen Z redeploys the survivors to meet with Murphy's doctor; at the compound they uncover game-changing details about their mission and the origins of the zombie virus.
Everyone tries to escape the impending nuclear blast; Citizen Z battles thawed zombies and issues an air bounty for Murphy.
Heroes battle zombies and overeager bounty hunters; Murphy manages to escape; Vasquez considers working with the group.
The heroes encounter a wagon train transporting survivors of the nuclear blast to safety; they go on a quest for a cure.
While looking for a natural cure for the virus, the survivors head to the greenhouse, where Batch 47 is being grown.
A pregnant Serena tracks down Murphy; the survivors stumble across a hidden Mennonite farm with new dangers.
While Murphy is falling for his baby girl, the rest of the team is suspicious of her; Vasquez sneaks away for a meeting; 10K makes a difficult decision.
While crossing the Mississippi, the team splits up after a boating accident; 10K is drawn into a scam; Escorpion sentences 10K, Sketchy and Skeezy to death.
Murphy is captured by an unbalanced zombie fan, who is eager to add him to a zombie museum, so he must match wits to escape.
The team finds an abandoned Air Force base and discovers what looks like alien technology.
The team splits up because of a massive zombie horde and encounters a Native American tribe fighting against itself.
The team gets embroiled in corporate politics after finding a group of white collar survivors hiding out in a hotel.
The team meets La Reina, Queen of the Zeros, after being captured; Dr. Kurian is ready for human trials on his Z-vaccine at the Zero compound.
It's discovered that the Z-vaccine doesn't work; Vasquez gets caught trying to kill Escorpian; Murphy uses mental manipulation to help Warren.
Almost to the promised land in California, Addy and Mack are forced back together; the others deliver Murphy to the coordinates for the lab.
Warren and the group fight off the Zetas, and the zombie horde who have been attracted by the battle.
The gang protects the town against a new enemy.
Warren and gang become prisoners; Murphy escapes the sub with his newly formed blends group.
Warren and team encounter the sole inhabitant of a strange town; Murphy begins a new mission.
More people flock to Murphy's new cult; the others are stuck in the middle of a war.

Returning to her South Carolina hometown reunites a recently divorced mother (Connie Sellecca) with her first love (Randy Travis).

With the holiday season in full swing, a woman is about to score a big promotion at her ad agency in San Francisco. Her life is unexpectedly turned upside down when she inherits a cozy inn in Alaska from her aunt. When she goes to inspect the property and meets a handsome attorney, she's surprised to find that nothing is what she expected. The small-town community is full of fun and festive Christmas traditions, and she starts wondering if the inn might just be the place she belongs.
As Christmas dinner brings four friends together, heartfelt stories of love, family, forgiveness and second chances remind them that the greatest gifts come from the heart.

Aspiring illustrator Harper collaborates with demanding author Caleb. When he insists on working through Christmas in a quaint town, she must use the holiday celebrations to help break his writer's block.
A wedding planner pulled in for a last-minute royal wedding on Christmas Day is shocked to discover the groom is the alluring stranger she met before.
With help from his family and friends, a man stages Christmas in the middle of summer for his sick grandmother.
After finding a reindeer to replace the injured Prancer, Santa's stableman (Gabriel Hogan) finds himself falling in love with the animal's owner (Hilarie Burton).
The director (George Newbern) of a dilapidated foster home must convince the new owner (Roma Downey) to continue funding it.
On the verge of a massive deadline, a cynical workaholic must turn Christmas around in her small town after a small mishap.
A teacher's quiet holiday season gets a jolt of spice when she accepts 12 dares of Christmas challenge from her sister.

After being replaced on live TV, dance judge Bella retreats to her snowy hometown, where she coaches misfit dancers and meets charming handyman Will. As sparks fly, she must choose between fame and newfound joy.
A best-selling author hides her love for Christmas after an ugly break-up, but finds love again when she joins a website for people who are crazy about Christmas.
An ambitious hotel manager returns to her family's B&B for Christmas to find all three of her high school exes staying there.
Noah Harrington's construction in Oak Creek unearths old Letters to Santa. He partners with historian Tessa Findlay to fulfill Christmas wishes, sparking an unexpected romance.
Deb is only 24 but faces Jane's looming 32nd birthday; Kim and Greyson defend a man who created a Website for married couples looking to cheat.

Featuring easy makeup and fashion hacks, lighthearted pranks and funny observations; entertaining and positive shows about everything trending right now.
Featuring easy makeup and fashion hacks, lighthearted pranks, and funny observations. 123 GO! delivers entertaining and positive shows about everything trending right now.

Judith (Jurnee Smollett-Bell) has known her husband, Brice (Lance Gross), since they were in high school, but now their marriage is growing stale. Having just completed her graduate work in psychotherapy, she's eager to begin a career as a marriage counselor. She takes an internship at a matchmaking firm for millionaires and meets Harley (Robbie Jones), a charismatic client who makes no effort to hide his attraction to Judith. Judith succumbs to his charms, placing her marriage in jeopardy.

One year after the devastation of Hurricane Katrina, high-school basketball coach Al Collins (Forest Whitaker) gathers displaced students and rebuilds the school team, the Patriots. Though the young athletes originally hailed from five different schools, Collins builds them into a cohesive unit and takes aim at the high-school basketball championship.

When Joseph Verrett (Andre Braugher), a Jesuit priest who teaches history at a black high school, is offered the position of basketball coach, he resists at first because he believes the school glorifies sports over education. Eventually, though, Joseph accepts and sets up a game with the unbeaten team from the white Jesuit high school. Father Grant (Rip Torn), the pastor of the parish, cautions against such a divisive move, but Joseph disagrees and prepares his team for the game.

When a successful New York advertising executive (Will Smith) suffers a great tragedy, he retreats from life. While his concerned friends try desperately to reconnect with him, he seeks answers from the universe by writing letters to Love, Time and Death. When his notes bring unexpected personal responses, he begins to understand how these constants interlock in a life fully lived and how even the deepest loss can reveal moments of meaning and beauty.

Waitresses at a Georgia restaurant, Nisi and Mickey, decide to fly to Los Angeles for a music-video audition in order to raise money for their dream project, a business that combines soul-food dining with a hair salon. Circumstances eventually find the Southern ladies on the estate of Mr. Blakemore, an elderly millionaire. Despite their vast cultural differences, Nisi and Mickey form close bonds with Blakemore and his butler.

When a no-nonsense LAPD detective (Robert De Niro) is forced to star in a reality-based television show with a frustrated actor-turned-LAPD-patrolman (Eddie Murphy), they find their lives turned upside down by a powerhouse producer (Rene Russo) and her very intrusive camera crew.

Once a first-rate Secret Service agent, Joe Hallenbeck (Bruce Willis) is now a gruff private investigator whose latest gig is protecting a pole dancer (Halle Berry). When she's murdered, he grudgingly teams up with her boyfriend, Jimmy Dix (Damon Wayans), an ex-quarterback with a gambling problem, and the two go after her killers. Before long, they stumble onto a plot by a well-known football magnate (Noble Willingham) to bribe federal legislators into legalizing sports gambling.

Reporter James (Charlie Sheen) brings petty crook Franklin (Chris Tucker) to justice, but as Franklin is being taken to jail, he is unwittingly drawn into a violent prison break. The police pursue Franklin, mistakenly thinking he killed several officers, so the fugitive turns to James for help. Figuring he has stumbled upon the story of a lifetime, the journalist agrees to prove that Franklin is innocent. Unfortunately, things don't go smoothly, and both men find themselves on the run.

Two families, bound by tradition, are locked in a brutal war. Asian and African American gangs are vying for control of Oakland's waterfront. But when the first casualty is the Asian warlord's son, the gang war becomes more dangerous than either side ever imagined.

When Mason (Ice-T), homeless and living on the streets of Seattle, hears about a job as a hunting guide for a group of wealthy clients, he gladly signs on and is taken to a cabin in the middle of a Pacific Northwest forest. There he meets psychiatrist Doc Hawkins (Gary Busey), oil baron John Griffin (John C. McGinley) and Wall Street investor Derek Wolfe (F. Murray Abraham). The next morning, however, Mason is awakened to learn that he's the prey the men will be hunting.
Fun DIY-projects, crafts and experience the joy of doing it.

Tris Prior lives in a futuristic world in which society is divided into five factions. As each person enters adulthood, he or she must choose a faction and commit to it for life. Tris chooses Dauntless -- those who pursue bravery above all else. However, her initiation leads to the discovery that she is a Divergent and will never be able to fit into just one faction. Warned that she must conceal her status, Tris uncovers a looming war which threatens everyone she loves.

Now on the run from Jeanine and the rest of the power-hungry Erudites, Tris and Four search for allies and answers in the ruins of Chicago. They must find out what Tris' family sacrificed their lives to protect and why the Erudites will do anything to stop them. Side by side, Tris and Four face one seemingly insurmountable challenge after another, as they unravel the secrets of the past and -- ultimately -- the future of their world.

Tris escapes with Four to journey beyond the wall that encloses Chicago. For the first time, they leave the only city and family they have ever known to find a peaceful solution. Once outside, they learn shocking new truths that render old discoveries meaningless. As the ruthless battle threatens humanity, Tris and Four quickly decide who to trust to survive. Tris must ultimately make difficult choices about courage, allegiance, sacrifice and love.

Returning to her home planet Pandora, an infamous bounty hunter forms an unexpected alliance with a ragtag team of misfits. Together, they battle alien monsters and dangerous bandits to uncover one of Pandora's most explosive secrets.
Movie, Science fiction, Action, Adventure, Comedy

Using his love for comics as inspiration, teenager Dave Lizewski (Aaron Johnson) decides to reinvent himself as a superhero -- despite a complete lack of special powers. Dave dons a costume, dubs himself "Kick-Ass," and gets to work fighting crime. He joins forces with the father/daughter vigilante team of Big Daddy and Hit Girl, then befriends another fledgling crime-fighter called Red Mist (Christopher Mintz-Plasse), but a scheming mobster soon puts their alliance to the test.

Elite spy Orson Fortune must track down and stop the sale of a deadly new weapons technology wielded by billionaire arms broker Greg Simmonds. Reluctantly teamed up with some of the world's best operatives, Fortune and his crew recruit Hollywood's biggest movie star, Danny Francesco, to help them on their globe-trotting mission to save the world.
An Elvis impersonator, meth-addicted white supremacists, and a man searching for his wife hunt for a missing wedding ring.
A desperate man takes part in an underworld game of Russian roulette in which gamblers place bets on who will survive.
A firefighter does something unexpected after a man that he has been ordered to testify against threatens him.
Movie, Family, Action, Crime drama, Thriller

A police chief and a detective join forces with an FBI agent to find a serial killer who left skeletal remains in the New Mexico desert. As each of their agendas and methods clash, a tangled web of intrigue casts suspicion in all directions.
Frost's (David Jason) search for the murderer of an animal rights activist leads to a snobbish art gallery.
A body dragged from the river has someone else's driver's license in his pocket; a soccer star overdoses.
A businessman goes into hiding after his assistant is killed.
Either the Task Force or her sister's boyfriend may have kidnapped a hard-working woman; meanwhile, Frost's house burns down.
Frost suspects that a young soldier killed on maneuvers was murdered.
Frost goes into the sex industry to probe a series of murders.
Frost investigates the death of a young physiotherapist, which leads him to a religious author and pillar of the New Union Church.
Frost (David Jason) loses a confrontation with the shrewd lawyer for two suspects in a vicious knife attack and is eventually forced to release them.
Frost investigates a kidnapping after finding a child's body, but is disturbed when he catches the man and has no evidence.
Frost releases a serial-assault suspect, then two children are murdered, and their mother is reported missing.
While investigating a woman's death, Frost is led to believe that the husband was responsible, until a priest reveals a man's confession to him.
Frost investigates the armed robbery and later, murder of a pawnbroker and begins to suspect one of the victim's children of the crime.
Frost (David Jason) becomes involved with an investigation into the death of a reclusive art collector. With Bruce Alexander and Caroline Harker.

A parking lot drug deal turns into a shootout that claims the lives of two Atlanta men; an execution outside a Tulsa, Okla., motel escalates into a double murder when the killer spots a witness to the crime.

A beloved uncle is killed when he attempts to help his niece leave her boyfriend; a man is randomly shot in front of his sister's house; a father of three is gunned down; a suspect on a bike executes a young man in broad daylight.
A man gunned down inside an apartment sets off a chain of events unlike anything Tulsa Homicide has ever seen.
In Tulsa, Okla., as Detective Jason White continues to investigate Courtney Palmer's disappearance, the missing persons case turns into a detective's worst nightmare.
In Atlanta, when a young man is shot from 235 feet away, Detective Darrin Smith discovers an escalating feud that threatens to tear apart a neighborhood.
When a man is murdered just before Christmas, his family helps Tulsa, Okla., detectives search for his killers.
A quick-money scam in Mobile, Ala., ends in a double murder; a rookie homicide detective takes the case personally.
A father is killed when a man opens fire in a crowded convenience store in Atlanta; a Tulsa, Okla., groom-to-be is gunned down before he can turn his life around.
A Tulsa, Okla., high school football player is gunned down when his friends make a dangerous decision; detectives must separate witnesses from suspects to find out who fired the fatal bullet.
When a young mother and her friend are murdered in front of her children in Tulsa, Okla., detectives hope a suspicious vehicle will lead them to the killer.

A late-night shooting leaves one man dead and another alive to help detectives identify the killer; a late-night party turns into a bloodbath; detectives must decide if a duo responsible for a carjacking spree also murdered a single father.

Surveillance cameras at a convenience store capture more than just a shooting; Minneapolis detectives need the help of the Somali community to help solve the murder of one of their own; a 19-year-old woman discovers an intruder in her home.

A man is robbed and shot multiple times on his payday; an eyewitness to a crime points out a potential suspect; a local prostitute may have information when a man is found shot dead in his car; a feud between neighbors gets out of control.
ALF believes that he scared Willie's (Max Wright) uncle to death. With Ann Schedeen.
ALF lends a hand with the neighborhood block patrol and ends up confronting a prowler in the Ochmoneks' house.
It's up to Willie to save ALF from the SWAT team surrounding the Ochomonek house, in which ALF had been chasing a prowler.

ALF, jealous of the attention a stray dog is getting, gives the pooch to a mean old woman who claims to be the owner.

Betrayed confidences cause a falling-out between ALF and Lynn (Andrea Elson). With Max Wright and Anne Schedeen.
Maintenance on the Orbit Gyro has an effect on its robot pilot, Pismo.
Gordon is offered a chance to play in the big leagues when a scout sees him playing in a local baseball game.
Bob thinks he is a television show host after he gets hit in the head.
