ALF and his friends portray an amusing fight against injustice in a jazzed-up version of the classic tale, "Robin Hood", which is considered one of the best in English folklore.
ALF and his friends showcase the magic of true love, a silly battle of good vs evil, and a strangely funny twist in a gender-reversed version of "Sleeping Beauty".
ALF and his friends give a glass-shattering twist to the classic, "Cinderella", by bringing rock 'n' roll, an absent-minded father, and a different kind of fairy godmother into the picture.
Ichabod Crane works with a newspaper, and seems to have solved the mystery of the headless horseman in ALF's version of "The Legend of Sleepy Hollow."
Jack uses magical beans to revive his mother's motel business and ends up finding love in an Alfred Hitchcock version of "Jack and the Beanstalk."
Staggering under failures, the Aladdin brothers wind up in a desert amid a tour and stumble upon a magic lamp that houses a genie in a modern retelling of a popular middle-eastern folk tale.
ALF and his friends present Rapunzel as a long-haired rap-singing beauty with vision-correcting tears in an amusing version of the classic fairytale.
ALF and his friends turn "Rumpelstiltskin" into a modern-day work of detective fiction wherein the protagonist seeks an investigator's help to find out the name of a mystical creature.
In a strangely entertaining version of "The Princess and the Pea", ALF and his friends present the story of a prince who finds love while pursuing comedy as a career.
John Henry becomes an extraordinary chef pitted against a cooking machine in ALF's entertaining version of the popular American folklore.
In an entertaining version of "The Three Little Pigs", ALF and his friends stick to the central plot of young piggies trying to build the best kind of houses.
ALF goes down an elevator shaft instead of a rabbit hole, and enters a magical place to find all kinds of weirdos in his version of "Alice in Wonderland."
ALF and his friends add their own twist to "Peter Pan", the story of a boy who lives in a magical land, never grows up, and befriends three children of a family in the real world.
ALF and his friends present their revamped version of the German classic, "Hansel and Gretel", wherein a brother-sister duo must save themselves from a dreadful witch.
With little help, ALF must take on a powerful witch after he winds up in the land of Oz in an entertaining version of "The Wizard of Oz."
In a retelling of "The Elves and the Shoemaker", a mediator shows up to make things right when a poor guy becomes greedy and exploitative toward some happy helpers.
ALF and his friends give the classic tale, "The Emperor's New Clothes", a hilarious makeover wherein a clothing freak emperor gets duped in the name of fashion.
Goldie Locks does not realize what she is getting herself into by using someone else's house for her enjoyment in ALF'ss version of "Goldie Locks and the Three Bears."
ALF and his friends present their entertaining version of "Little Red Riding Hood", a 17th-century European classic tale about an unsuspecting little girl who faces a scary predator.
ALF and his friends take the rivalry between Snow White and the evil queen to another level in an exciting version of the classic tale.
An Indiana Jones-like character wishes to help King Midas with the cursed touch, but there are people who don't want that to happen in ALF's amusing version of the classic tale.
The Tanners meet ALF for the first time when he crashes into the family's garage. Stars Max Wright, Anne Schedeen.
ALF decides to have some fun while a nervous Mrs. Ochmonek (Liz Sheridan) baby-sits Brian (Benji Gregory).
When Lucky the cat disappears, everyone blames ALF. Stars Max Wright, Anne Schedeen.
ALF calls the president to address his concerns about nuclear weapons. Stars Max Wright, Anne Schedeen.
ALF takes a job selling cosmetics over the phone. Stars Max Wright, Anne Schedeen.
ALF makes his first friend outside the Tanner family, Jody, a lonely blind girl who calls in to a radio talk show.
Vacationers think they've found the perfect place for a bachelor party, but a deadly, flesh-eating virus is waiting to infect them.
Friends (Brandy Schaefer, Mikey Roe, Jeff Larson) encounter genuine horror during a road trip to visit haunted houses.

Still recovering from the trauma of being kidnapped on the previous Halloween by the Blue Skeleton - a group that takes extreme haunt to another level - five friends decide they must face their fears to move on. Heading back out on the road to visit more haunted house attractions, new terror begins when signs of the Blue Skeleton start appearing again.

Hunter's (Brian Gallagher) life turns upside down after his daughter is killed by a drunken driver. He disappears into the woods, and no one sees him for years -- until several partying teenagers are brutally killed one by one.
When Alice stops at a remote gas station at night, she's made the plaything of a crazy sniper with a secret vendetta. To survive, she must figure out who wants her dead.
A young woman studying the habits of webcam users witnesses a murder online and becomes the killer's next target.
As a serial killer stalks the city, a young actress who just moved to town with her boyfriend notices a mysterious stranger watching her from across the street.
A woman finds a VHS tape that shows a series of gruesome tales.
Emily, blind since a car accident killed her mother, has to protect herself and loved ones from an intruder.

Jackie and Jules are a couple celebrating their first anniversary at a secluded cabin in the woods belonging to Jackie's family. From the moment they arrive, something changes in Jules' normally loving wife, as Jackie begins to reveal a previously unknown dark side -- all building up to a shocking revelation that will pit Jules against the woman she loves in a terrifying fight to survive.

A young mother goes into a remote wilderness area with her son and her best friend to scatter her late husband's ashes. On their trek home, they begin to realize that a lone hiker has been following them. After a series of disturbing encounters, they are forced to confront their deepest fears when the stranger's true motives are revealed.
A serial killer brings an unsuspecting new victim on a weekend getaway to add another body to his ever-growing count. She's buying into his faux charms, and he's eagerly lusting for blood.
A film student (Jason Scott Campbell) finds a video camera that contains footage of himself committing murder.

Iris (Brittany Snow) and seven other desperate people become trapped in Shepard's (Jeffrey Combs) mansion. Shepard forces them to play a sadistic game for a large sum of money -- but the dilemmas become increasingly deadly.

Corky (Anthony Hopkins), a failed magician, adopts a new ventriloquist act with an abrasive dummy named Fats, and suddenly finds himself lined up for a television show. When the unbalanced Corky fears he won't pass the required mental exam, he runs away with Fats to his hometown, where he meets an old love from high school, Peggy (Ann-Margret). Corky persuades Peggy to leave her loveless marriage -- but Fats, who seems to be taking on a mind of his own, doesn't approve of the relationship.
Un nuevo líder toma el control del Rancho. Daniel, por su parte, ayuda a Lola a distribuir el agua, pero cada vez quedan menos recursos disponibles.
Madison y Walker parten en busca de una solución definitiva. Por su parte, Nick y Alicia luchan por mantener la paz.
Consiguen lanzar una misión para rellenar los suministros de agua de "El Rancho". Para ello, tratarán de buscar la ayuda en otras comunidades.
Nick y Jake tienen que lidiar con una situación delicada. El Rancho se prepara para afrontar la peor amenaza contra la que ha combatido hasta el momento.
Alicia se encuentra en una posición de liderazgo en la que se ve forzada a tomar decisiones trascendentales.
Alicia encuentra un aliado potencial, Ofelia lucha por la supervivencia y Nick utiliza sus habilidades en su propio beneficio.
Nick detecta una nueva amenaza descendiendo por la represa. Madison se encuentra cara a cara con algo horroroso.
La lealtad de Strands se pone a prueba cuando se enfrenta con un adversario. Además, Madison hace frente a su pasado y la familia Clarke es llevada hasta el extremo.
Wherever your destination, traveling local or far, indoor or outdoor, you can be sure AccuWeather Weekend always has you covered.
Goes beyond the forecast to give you the how and why about stuff you wanted to ask about weather, space and science.

Martial arts master Terry Tsurugi may be an assassin-for-hire, but when he hears of a plot to kidnap Sarai, the daughter of a dead billionaire, he offers her protection. As he attempts to keep Sarai safe, he also deals with a pair of siblings who refuse to pay up after Terry helps their convicted brother escape from prison. But it's Sarai's life he cares about, so when the mobsters manage to steal her away, Terry will battle whoever gets in his way to rescue her.
Elderly prison matrons take sadistic pleasure in torturing the female convicts who stray from the strict moral standards.
Moroccan gangsters involve an American tourist in a complex espionage scheme.
A faith healer (Robert Powell) turns his supernatural powers on a hostile PR man (Broderick Crawford) while treating a senator's (David Hemmings) son.
A chain of suicides sparks a police investigation that has ties to leaders in the Italian government.

After the parents of Ruby (Leelee Sobieski) and her younger brother, Rhett (Trevor Morgan), are killed in a car crash, their parents' best friends, Erin and Terry Glass (Diane Lane, Stellan Skarsgard), become their guardians. The children hear promises of a world of opulence and California fun -- all they have to do is move into the Glasses' gated house. Before very long, though, Ruby suspects that Erin and Terry may not be the ideal guardians they seemed to be.

Little Sang-woo (Yoo Seung-ho) doesn't want to leave Seoul, South Korea, to live with his mute grandmother (Kim Eul-boon) in the countryside, but his mother (Dong Hyo-heui) compels him, as she needs to look for a new job. Fractious and ill-mannered, Sang-woo variously ignores and taunts his grandmother with insulting epithets. When she won't buy batteries for his toy, he even steals from her. But over time, and in the face of her unquestioning love, he comes to admire and respect her.
A funeral director crosses paths with a young girl, which changes his life for the better.
Ji-woo, an outcast at a prestigious private school, meets Hak-sung, the school janitor who is actually a mathematical genius who defected from North Korea.

A young man grows up exiled in a realm that's overrun by menacing demons and monsters. When evil forces threaten his home, he embarks on a heroic journey to save his people and fulfill his destiny as a legendary leader.
A famous pop singer decides to have full-body plastic surgery to change her look.

Mi-yeong, an ordinary lady who sells donuts at a market, goes on her first ever family trip to Hawaii with her loving husband and little daughter. However, their excitement doesn't last very long. Strange people are on board with them and all of a sudden they try to hijack the plane. In the moment of emergency, an unexpected hero appears to save the plane.

Lee Jeong Hwan, a fierce animal trainer, lives a chaotic daily life with his rebellious teenage daughter, Lee Su A, who is full of passion for dancing. One day, Su A becomes infected by a zombie virus that has swept across the globe.

Jack (Jackie Chan), a world-renowned archaeology professor, and his team are on a grand quest to locate a lost ancient Indian treasure when they are ambushed by a team of mercenaries and left for dead. Using his vast knowledge of history and kung fu, Jack leads his team on a race around the world to beat the mercenaries to the treasure and save an ancient culture.
Movie, Action, Adventure, Martial arts, Comedy, Mystery, Fantasy

Taka, a shiftless young man, sets off on a quest to find his missing brother, Mune. Teaming up with a quirky friend and an edgy girl, Taka takes on a pack of monster cats determined to execute unscrupulous pet shop owners.
Three friends discover they have the power to travel back and forth through time. However, they soon find themselves trying to save the world when the future turns out to be not so bright.
A gifted martial artist protects his adopted village from a villain who wants to build a railroad through the center of the community.

In 1975, Travis Walton claims to have been abducted by extraterrestrial beings, but researchers say that alien abductions have been taking place for thousands of years, as depicted in biblical stories of abductions by otherworldly beings.
Charlie and Kate's sexual episode leads to complications when he innocently asks her to a movie; Sam kisses a girl and the picture winds up on a social media site.

Charlie believes his father is faking Alzheimer's, and uses a hidden camera to spy on him. Patrick offers to help Nolan change his appearance to help his self-esteem.
Charlie begins a questionable romantic relationship with an ex-patient after the five-year mandatory waiting period runs out.
Charlie tries to persuade his father to join a choir of people his own age, a decision he later regrets. Lacey helps Patrick as an anger ally while he deals with a bully from high school.
Jennifer moves in with Charlie temporarily and Kate gets jealous.
Charlie tries to help his patient with a placebo pill that supposedly reduces anger; Jennifer asks Charlie to hang out with Kate.
Charlie gets involved with Sam's English teacher, he thinks her bad grade is based on his poor sexual performance; Lacey starts to have illicit romantic dreams about both Kate and Charlie.
Charlie runs into problems when CeeLo Green hires him as his personal therapist. Kate wants Charlie to drop CeeLo as a patient, because he is interrupting their time together.
Charlie and Kate face off as expert witnesses in the same trial; Charlie gives Nolan homework to get in touch with his feelings.
Martin has Charlie's daughter baptized behind Charlie's back.
Charlie dates Jennifer's business partner and finds out she has sexual anger issues; the support group tries to find a rich boyfriend for Lacey.
Lindsay Lohan comes to Charlie for therapy, and they begin a tumultuous relationship that ends up getting her in trouble.
Charlie's neighbors find out he's been having clients with anger issues meeting at his house; Kate goes with Jennifer to help find a dress for Sam.
When Sam finds out that her favorite horse is in equine therapy, Charlie uses that as a bonding exercise for his group.
Charlie's ex causes him problems with his group when she becomes one of his patient's life coach; Lacey helps Charlie's dad get a Facebook account.
Charlie steals a hot woman from an angry nerd who finds a way to make his life a living hell; Lacey takes drugs.
Nick attempts to have a night out with Lindsey, but when all she wants to do is to follow around a young celebrity DJ, Nick tries to teach her how a man should really treat her the way she deserves.
Suzanne begins to force everyone in the family to tell the truth at all times after she catches Nick in a lie.
Lindsey has a new crush and Gigi has a new boyfriend, but when certain secrets cannot be kept, a web of misinformation nearly ruins both situations.
When Nick's new field producer, Sam, turns out to be female, Suzanne is convinced she is trying to steal her man, a suggestion Nick thinks is absurd until Sam actually makes a move on him.
Nick and Suzanne go head-to-head in the kitchen when Nick says cooking is easy and Suzanne challenges him to a family cooking competition.
Kevin helps Frankie study for a test, but Frankie bribes him to take the test for him.
Lindsey is thrilled to get her first job at Up and Down Burger, but when she gives out free food to failed NBA hopeful Terrell, she soon learns the consequences of stealing at the workplace.
Lindsey auditions to dance in a P-Nut music video, but considers quitting when she discovers that the choreographer is a drill sergeant and the other dancers are far more experienced.
When Lindsey accompanies Suzanne to work and meets an old friend of her mother's, a misunderstanding causes Lindsey to believe she may have an older brother that she never knew about.
When Suzanne is overly protective teaching Lindsey how to drive, Nick takes over and makes Lindsey feel confident, until she scratches Suzanne's car and chooses to lie about the incident.
When Troy provokes a school bully, Kevin strikes up a friendship with his tormentor to avoid a beat down. However, Kevin is soon faced with a difficult decision.
After a concussion, Nick is advised to not go to bed for a few hours. To avoid all risks, he attempts to stay up all night.
Suzanne is upset when Marilyn gives her an ugly bracelet as a present, but things get even uglier when Nick sees it and realizes he bought it for Marilyn and that she's re-gifted.
When a well-respected actor shadows Nick to prepare for an upcoming role as an anchor, but his methods turn out to be much more invasive that Nick had expected.
Nick refuses to give Lindsey money for a concert, so Lindsey resorts to stealing sixty dollars from Gigi's purse - but when Gigi discovers the missing money, she blames Kevin for the theft.
When the family's morning routine devolves into fighting, Gigi suggests that they try an old sorority exercise called the Lemon Squeeze in order to turn their problems around.
Nick agrees to go to a Public Enemy concert on the same night as his proposal-versary with Suzanne, who is none too pleased. The children star in internet videos wearing superhero costumes.
Nick's identity is stolen; Suzanne takes a week off to attend a wedding; Marilyn shares a life lesson.
Suzanne tries to keep Nick's birthday gift a surprise by taking out a loan from Marilyn.
Nick and Suzanne have been married for about six months, and the new blended family is beginning to experience growing pains. Nick thinks the kids do not love him and will not accept him.
The entire family plays pranks on one another. However, when the family ignores Nick's choking because they think it is another prank, Nick has a near-death experience and embraces his Zen side.
When the house sitters next door begin acting irresponsibly, Nick and Suzanne question if they are being played for fools.
The family decides to go green, but it is much harder than they thought, and they sometimes realise you have to choose between saving the planet and saving your family.
Nick's boxing match party unexpectedly takes over the family room on the same night Suzanne's book group is meeting in the living room.
Nick tries to be spontaneous, but Suzanne resists and instead plans a date night that fails. They attempt to be spontaneous together until she realises it is best not to share her plans.
Nick says he is too tired for marital relations one night, leading Suzanne to speculate and have major concerns that something is not right in their relationship.
Nick asks Suzanne to help pro baseball player Ray Savage plan a children's charity event.
Suzanne wants to have a formal portrait of the family taken, but trying to pull everyone together proves to be impossible.

Nick notices the family is disconnected and proposes a get-together with friends and family so they have the opportunity to reconnect. Unfortunately, Nick's planning leaves out some important details, leading to chaos.
Suzanne is tired of being the bad cop and Nick being the good cop with the kids, so they decide to switch places.
Kevin takes care of a rat that ends up getting lost in the house. Tension arises between Gigi and Lindsey when one of Gigi's old boyfriends showers them with gifts and clothes.
When Nick happens upon an old college pal, the unexpected meeting gives rise to a business plan that involves a sports star and an energy drink. The results, however, are not so bubbly.
Suzanne and Nick go out with another couple, her friend Danielle and husband Steve. However, the double date soon fizzles when an accusation flies.
Nick is forced to get an assistant, who is a must-hire from his boss. But when the assistant gets too close to his family and friends, Nick is forced to take action.
Nick helps out Willie Mays, a homeless man with a beautiful voice, by getting him a job at KAWT, but Willie takes advantage of his new job.
After a website votes Nick Sexiest Seattle Sportscaster, he tries to embrace his new image. But Nick soon learns being a sex symbol isn't all it's cracked up to be.
Romantic complications ensue when Nick helps a shy colleague improve his love life. Meanwhile, a pinkeye epidemic keeps Lindsey away from school.
Suzanne suspects that Lindsey's athletic new crush from school is gay. However, Nick sets out to prove that he is not in order to save Lindsey from disappointment.
Lindsey and Kevin enter Nick into a Hand on a House contest, where finalists compete by seeing who can keep their hand on a house for the longest.
When Nick inadvertently insults Harold Bradley (a KAWT employee who has been around forever) on-air, he is forced to do damage control.
When a new buxom woman gets hired at the station, Nick's career is threatened. Suzanne takes matters into her own hands to save her husband's job.
Nick and Suzanne consider purchasing life insurance as they feel it would be a good decision to protect their family. However, Nick has reservations about buying a policy.
After a Guys' Night Out, Nick and his friends struggle to recollect the events that led to the disappearance of his wedding ring - and Kevin.
After Kevin watches 'The Sixth Sense', he starts having nightmares that disrupt Nick and Suzanne's sleep.

When Suzanne wants a real honeymoon, Nick tries to plan an extravagant surprise, but despite his best efforts to create something romantic, instead misleads Suzanne into thinking he is cheating on her.
When Nick gets a doctors report that he has high blood pressure, Suzanne does everything she can to make sure his stress levels stay low.
Nick struggles to prove himself when he is promoted to co-host alongside the lazy, arrogant Brick Street.
When Suzanne gets roped into a committee at Kevin's school, where the other mums are mean to her, Nick volunteers to fill in on her behalf, making things awkward when the ladies love him.

Nick goes to watch a game with friends at a sports bar known to have sexy female waitresses. The kids want a larger allowance, but they are not willing to do more chores in return for a higher payout.
Annoyed that she and Nick never do anything together as a couple, Suzanne signs the two of them up for salsa lessons, but is surprised by her control issues on the dance floor.
Using her mother's credit card, Lindsey gets help from Nick in ordering a Michelle Obama jumper online. Kevin pretends to be sick to pull off a scam to get a signed A-Rod jersey.
Lindsey makes a reality show about her family, but she thinks they are too boring - until Kevin finds Suzanne's gun in her bedroom and shows it to Troy, bringing real danger to the household.

Everyone tries to resolve personal issues while stuck in line the morning of a Black Friday sale. Kevin anticipates buying a new video game, Lindsey meets a boy, relationship problems plague Martin and Terrence hopes to buy toys for charity.
Nick becomes a more influential parent, so he pushes Kevin and Lindsey hard, and they become model children.
Nick hesitantly attends his high school reunion, but all of his fears come true when his high school nickname haunts him throughout the event. Lindsey prepares a feast.
When Nick realises he is the same age his father was when he died, he decides not to waste another minute and starts tackling a list of risky activities to accomplish before he dies.
While hosting an awards ceremony, Nick gets laughs by making Suzanne the butt of his jokes, but finds he cannot stand the heat when Suzanne turns the tables and starts making fun of him in public.
Kevin is a big football fan, but Nick does not understand the appeal. Suzanne is frustrated by Lindsey's lack of communication and creates a fake Facebook account to learn what is going on.
When the family oversleeps on the morning Lindsey is set to sing the National Anthem at a baseball game, it is all hands on deck just to make it to out of the house on time.
Nick wants Lindsey and Kevin to give back to the community, so they select a charity they find online. But when the charity keeps asking for more money, Nick has to get to the bottom of it.
After treating Jan Di in a cruel manner, Mr. Jung prepares everything so that Jun-Pyo can visit her in Seoul. Will he be able to go without Madam Kang finding out?
Jan Di's family hears about Jun-pyo's engagement and asks her miserably if it's true.
Ji-hoo can see how hurt Jan Di is by the kiss, and continues to follow her as she stumbles around in shock.
Jun-pyo begins seeing Jae-Kyung in a new light, like he's seeing her for the first time as a potential friend -- or maybe a kindred spirit.
Woo-bin tries to talk some sense into Yi-jung, who is determined to drink himself into a stupor.
At home, Jun-hee reminisces about how her mother meddled in her life, in much the same way she's interfering in Jun-pyo's now.
Yi-jung is waiting outside for Eun-jae, excited to see her -- until he listens in on her phone conversation; from her words, it sounds like a call to a boyfriend.
Jun-pyo begs for Jan Di to advise him not to get married.
Jun-pyo tells Jan Di that he'll protect her, but to Jun-pyo's surprise, she says that she does not want to be cosseted or taken care of.
Yoh agrees to teach Haruna how to get a boyfriend but on the condition she doesn't fall in love with him.
Perhaps feeling it's time to expose one truth, Mr. Jung leads Jun-hee to the unknown patient's bedside; at the sight of her father, Jun-hee breaks down.
Jun-pyo asks Yumi to make the lunchbox once more, confirming that Yumi had taken credit for her lunch.
Just being rich isn't enough to endure the teen oppression at Shinhwa -- loners are often marked as targets by the bored über-clique called F4.
A wicked rumor is spread on the Internet that a second-year student at Shinhwa High School is pregnant.
Not too eager to watch Jan Di dancing with one of his best friends, Jun Pyo exits the ballroom and ends up taking out his frustrations by the poolside.
Making a rash choice, Jan Di tells her mother she has to go somewhere and runs off, heading toward Namsan Tower.
Jan Di's bike is set ablaze while she is attacked with water balloons and blasted with a fire extinguisher.
A psychic foresees that Jan Di will be losing something significant.
Jun Pyo intends to expel his best friend and Jan Di out of Shinhwa High School -- and out of F4.

Sonny Hooper (Burt Reynolds) is getting too banged up to remain Hollywood's top stuntman, but he signs up as the stunt coordinator for a big-budget action movie with a pushy director (Robert Klein) and a clueless star (Adam West). Ready to retire from the physical abuse, Hooper is gearing up to make the film's climactic stunt his biggest ever, but cocky young stuntman Ski Chinski (Jan-Michael Vincent) aims to steal the glory with his more scientific, technology-oriented stunt methods.

Jack Hartounian (Jackie Mason), a boorish but good-hearted real estate tycoon, applies for membership at a snooty country club, but is blackballed by the old-money WASPs, led by Chandler Young (Robert Stack). As revenge, he simply buys the club outright and turns it into a garish amusement park. Chandler wants to win the property back by challenging Jack to a golf match, but he hedges his bets by hiring deranged mercenary Tom Everett (Dan Aykroyd) to eliminate his competition.

Academia meets street smarts when Monty Kessler (Brendan Fraser), a graduate student struggling to finish his program, loses his thesis and finds it in the hands of a homeless man named Simon Wilder (Joe Pesci). Though the two get off on the wrong foot, they become unlikely friends, with Simon teaching Monty some important life lessons. Although Monty's roommates, including his buddy, Everett Calloway (Patrick Dempsey), initially dislike having Simon around, they grow to appreciate him, too.

Former sportswriter Andy Farmer and his secretly aspiring author wife, Elizabeth, move to a small farm in Vermont, so Andy can focus on writing a novel. They quickly realize that the locals are not as welcoming as they'd like and that the farm is more distracting than inspiring. Having trouble with his manuscript, and with his marriage on the rocks, Andy is forced to take hilariously drastic measures in an attempt to get his life back on track.

John Murdoch (Rufus Sewell) awakens alone in a strange hotel to find that he is wanted for a series of brutal murders. The problem is that he can't remember whether he committed the murders or not. For one brief moment, he is convinced that he has gone completely mad. Murdoch seeks to unravel the twisted riddle of his identity. As he edges closer to solving the mystery, he stumbles upon a fiendish underworld controlled by a group of ominous beings collectively known as the Strangers.

In a seaside California town, best friends Mac (Mel Gibson) and Nick (Kurt Russell) are on opposite sides of the law. Mac is a former drug dealer trying to clean up his act, while Nick is a high-profile detective trying to take down a Mexican drug lord named Carlos (Raul Julia). Soon Nick's loyalties are put to the test when he begins an affair with restaurateur Jo Ann (Michelle Pfeiffer) -- a love interest of Mac's -- unwittingly leading his friend into a police-orchestrated trap.
A trapper (Al Pacino) joins the fight against the British in 1776 after his teenage son is tortured by a redcoat (Donald Sutherland).

When Cleveland Heep (Paul Giamatti) rescues an enigmatic young woman (Bryce Dallas Howard) from danger, little does he know that she is a character from a bedtime story, who is trying to return to her world. As he falls deeply in love with her, he begins to realize that he and fellow tenants are also characters in the fable, and they must work together to protect her from those who would prevent her from returning home.

Wealthy New York City playboy Arthur Bach (Dudley Moore) is perpetually drunk and completely rudderless. Dutifully supported by his sharp-tongued and quick-witted butler, Hobson (John Gielgud), Arthur reluctantly prepares to enter into an arranged marriage with heiress Susan Johnson (Jill Eikenberry). When he meets Linda Marolla (Liza Minnelli), a waitress from Queens, he falls head over heels in love, but if he backs out of his engagement with Susan, he may lose his fortune.

Having already stolen two from the set of three priceless Napoleon Diamonds, expert jewel thief Max Burdett (Pierce Brosnan) decides to retire on a tropical island with his girlfriend and partner-in-crime, Lola (Salma Hayek). Fate intervenes, however, when Max discovers the third and final diamond is sitting on a docked cruise ship on his very island. It should be a simple job, but FBI agent Stan Lloyd (Woody Harrelson) shows up to make sure Max doesn't get any ideas.

Impressed by high school student David's (Tobey Maguire) devotion to a 1950s family TV show, a mysterious television repairman (Don Knotts) provides him with a means to escape into the black-and-white program with his sister, Jennifer (Reese Witherspoon). While David initially takes to the simplistic, corny world of the show, Jennifer sets about jolting the characters with doses of reality that unexpectedly bring a little color into their drab existence.

Disaster movie sequel following two groups of adventurers as they race to salvage a doomed ship's treasure hours after it has been crippled by a tidal wave. When the gold-diggers enter the overturned liner through a hole cut by the coastguard they discover more survivors still trapped on board and struggle to carry out their plans before the ocean finally claims the wrecked vessel.

An annual beauty pageant in small-town Minnesota turns ridiculously competitive and ultimately chaotic in this biting comedy. Amber Atkins (Kirsten Dunst), the daughter of hard-drinking mom Annette (Ellen Barkin), and Becky Leeman (Denise Richards), who is motivated by her former beauty-queen mother, Gladys (Kirstie Alley), are among the top contenders in the event. As Amber, Becky, and other local girls prepare for the big day, bizarre incidents occur, leading up to an ending with a bang.

La amistad de Mark con un antiguo compañero de policía se ve amenazada cuando el agente le pide que mienta sobre un crimen racista.
Jonathan tiene que lidiar con la ira y la frustración de perder sus poderes sobrenaturales después de que él rechaza una misión de Dios.
Jonathan ahora mortal, tiene problemas para encontrar un trabajo, y Jennifer no comparte su deseo de una relación a largo plazo.
Jonathan da un periodista famoso, que está encarcelado en América del Sur, la oportunidad de entrar en el sueño de su esposa.
Jonathan y Mark ayudan a una antigua bailarina a superar su amargura por ser discapacitada.
Mark (Victor French) ayuda a recaudar dinero para una cirugía de cáncer de un aspirante biólogo marino. Con Michael Landon.
Jonathan y Mark convencen a adolescente Lee para cabildear en el senado estatal para una mayor protección del medio ambiente.
Un magnate reencarnado trata de ponerle fin al matrimonio de clase media de su hijo.
Jonathan hace de intermediario con un entrenador de fútbol que tiene una actitud de ganador a toda costa, pero que anda alejado de su hijo.
Jonathan y Mark ayudan a un candidato a la alcaldía cuyo oponente realiza una campaña sucia.
Una ex enfermera de Vietnam sufre de trastorno de estrés postraumático; un adolescente descubre que es adoptado.
Un niño adoptado se encuentra con su madre biológica, quien es una veterana de Vietnam, que sufre de recuerdos traumáticos de la guerra.
Jonathan y Mark toman empleos en una escuela parroquial justo antes que un desacuerdo sobre la enseñanza obligatoria de religión la lleva a cerrar.
Es la reunión de secundaria de Mark y los envejecidos compañeros de la escuela secundaria deben llegar a la conclusión, de que ellos ya no son los jóvenes populares que solían ser.
Jonathan ayuda a estudiantes para que aprendan a realizar ambiciosos pero responsables informes periodísticos.
Jonathan y Mark alientan a un veterano de Vietnam con discapacidad a trabajar para una organización que ayuda a las personas con discapacidad.
Jonathan y Mark ayudan a los estudiantes a protestar por la jubilación obligatoria de un profesor muy querido.

Esta serie dramática representa en cada capítulo de una hora historias distintas y reales sobre mujeres mexicanas que atraviesan diferentes vicisitudes. Las experiencias de estas mujeres tratan de temas censurados por la sociedad y por lo tanto ellas los enfrentan en silencio, algunas de las situaciones que se examinan son: el abuso infantil, el embarazo no deseado, asesinatos, la pornografía y la violencia familiar entre otras. Al final de cada episodio se muestra una lista de centros o agencias de ayuda para personas que se sientan identificadas con los casos específicos, se hace un llamado para que busquen ayuda y rompan su silencio.
Un espacio en el que se tocan temas controversiales, de forma abierta y sin censura como sexo, infidelidad, identidad de género, salud mental, conductas delictivas, o fractura familiar.

La serie cuenta, en cada capítulo, una historia diferente con personajes nuevos. El eje central de las historias es el transporte público, ya que todas ellas suceden dentro de alguno de los medios de traslado del país.

La serie de misterio y espanto, relata leyendas populares escalofriantes que aterrorizan hasta los más valientes. El programa cuenta estas historias y trata en lo posible de grabar en las localidades, algunas de estas son lugares históricos en que supuestamente las leyendas sucedieron o visita lugares parecidos para así tratar de reflejar la historia original y hacerla tan parecida como sea posible. Si quiere dormir con la luz prendida observe este programa que lo mantendrá en suspenso y aterrorizado.
Durante las fiestas patronales de un pequeño pueblo, surge un inesperado triángulo amoroso entre dos jóvenes y una bella mujer.
Un programa que aborda la información más relevante del fin de semana.
Un programa de entretenimiento que aborda temas de interés personal como cocina, belleza, sexualidad, reflexiones, consejos y otros.

Un programa periodístico que compila varios segmentos de noticias, las cuales tienen una cosa en común, estas son impactantes y asombrosas, algunas de estas noticias que se presentan son controversiales y algunas algo amarillistas. Una serie entretenida que dejará con la boca abierta a más de uno de sus espectadores, las noticias que se incluyen son sobre temas criminales, de salud, religiosos en el que se incluyen milagros y notas curiosas que son de interés público, entre otras, también se informa al público sobre los famosos que están haciendo noticia e información interesante sobre el mundo del entretenimiento.
Una serie que aborda temas relacionados con la situación de la mujer en la sociedad actual a través de testimonios y ofreciendo orientación.
It is autumn and Gordon finds out that Hope is back with her mother.
Indonesia's rich and colorful tropical seas are home to an array of marine life.

This show from legendary Mark Goodson-Bill Todman Productions features two contestants trying to predict answers to survey questions for the opportunity to play a game with oversized playing cards for a chance to win cash. One contestant guesses how many people (out of 100) gave a certain answer to a question and the other contestant then guesses if the number is higher or lower than the opponent's guess. The winning contestant then faces a row of cards and must determine if each succeeding card is higher or lower than the one that precedes it. The contestant who wins two out of three games wins the match and plays the bonus round, called Money Cards. The Money Cards round is similar to the card game in the main game but with three levels of cards instead of one row. The contestant is given $200 at the beginning of Money Cards and wagers any or all of that money when guessing if the cards will be higher or lower than the previous one. A perfect round could earn the contestant $28,800.
Two families, each composed of five members, compete against each other to guess the results of a survey of 100 people.
Operation Smile: transforming lives and bringing smiles to children around the world.
Celebrity panelists quiz three contestants to identify the imposters.

Unfaithful man kills wife; elderly couple poisons drifters; vault traps girl; rose garden gives woman psychic powers; shell's explosion does not harm soldiers.
Portrait painter heals sufferers; a dead son visits a talk-show host; teens visit a morgue; host Jonathan Frakes.

The kraken, griffins, dragons, and even the chupacabra... Are they real? Or merely the product of legends and folklore? Follow us as we delve deep into the facts in this terrifying journey with Mythical Monsters.
Host Hammerson Peters delves into classic stories about alleged mountain-dwelling giants living in the most desolate crags and canyons of Canada's Columbia Mountains.

When Helen discovers that Bliss' community service job is bogus, she tries to give Bliss some actual work to do.

In California, an alleged carjacking goes awry, damaging several cars and putting lives at risk; a traffic stop in Houston turns into a terrifying shootout at a gas station.

In Woodland Hills, Calif., good Samaritans attempt to box in a driver involved in multiple wrecks near a freeway overpass; a woman in Louisiana is berated by another driver who believes she is not driving fast enough.

In Wooster, Ohio, a road rage incident escalates when one of the drivers follows the other back to his home; a driver in Georgia hits a stopped tow truck's ramp and soars over 120 feet; a fender bender in a Texas parking lot spins out of control.

In Castle Rock, Colo., a school bus driver finds himself in hot water when he comes to a sudden stop and frightens some of his passengers; in Florida, after pulling a driver over for speeding, a sheriff experiences a shocking first in his career.

In Torrance, Calif., an alleged fender bender leads to a roadside fight, leaving one driver unconscious; in Baltimore, a reported stolen vehicle fleeing from police crashes into a building causing it to collapse.

One car appears to back into another at a car wash; an accident on a Los Angeles highway leads to several others, damaging six cars and injuring two motorists; a woman leaves her car without putting it into park.

In Vernon, Calif., a motorcyclist escalates an altercation on the road by smashing a driver's rear windshield; when a driver in Flushing, N.Y., allegedly blocks a mobility van from unloading wheelchair passengers, bystanders intervene.
The rules of the road clearly don't apply in this top 10 episode of "Road Wars."
Buckle up, because on this top 10 special of "Road Wars," furious drivers are about to blow their fuse.
In Apollo Beach, Fla., a woman brandishes a gun after an alleged altercation on the road; after a wild chase through downtown Los Angeles, a man attempts to flee from police on a skateboard.

In Sacramento, Calif., two motorists attempt to out-threaten each other over an alleged tailgating incident; in Las Vegas, a driver upset at being allegedly cut off confronts another motorist at a stoplight.

At a red light in Phoenix, a man gets out of his car to confront another motorist, who ends up driving directly into him; when a large truck slows traffic on a small road in New Jersey, an angry driver gets out of his car with a baseball bat.

In a Michigan parking lot, a truck driver repeatedly rams a car in a seemingly random attack; on a remote road in Oklahoma, motorcyclists get into an altercation with the driver of a pickup truck who calls in a sibling and a neighbor for backup.
A St. Louis family is alarmed when a neighbor bangs on their door with a hammer; when their leaf blower disappears, two sisters in Virginia decide to confront the neighbors.

A newly-married couple face a hostile neighborhood when building a tiny home in Missouri out of shipping containers; brawling neighbors in a New York bodega leaves one with a broken jaw; in Alabama, a man claims the neighbors stole his dog.

A pedestrian in Chicago loses her cool when one of her neighbors bicycles on the sidewalk; in South Carolina, a man challenges a neighbor for using a handicapped parking spot when she doesn't look handicapped.

Two Texas neighbors engage in a fiery debate about where dogs should relieve themselves; next door neighbors in England are embroiled in a battle allegedly over noise disturbances; a California woman accuses a landlord of blocking in her car.
A Floridian fisherman turns the tables on a territorial neighbor; in Tennessee, a property line dispute makes a neighbor fear for her life.

A San Francisco man blows his lid when some neighbors don't park properly on a steep hill; in Denver, a dog trainer claims her unwelcome puppy advice ends a friendship with the woman opposite; in Virginia, neighbors engage in a shouting match.

An East London woman battles a swarm of her neighbor's bees taking over her bedroom; in Texas, a new mother is shocked to witness her neighbor playing with fire; a Georgia farmer temporarily blocks a school bus.
A late-night reveler shows up unannounced to a house party and gets a rude welcome; in Scottsdale, Ariz., a barefoot woman blocks the car of two men she accuses of trespassing in the neighborhood.

An Idaho family's next-door neighbor goes to battle with them over the height of their lawn; in Florida, authorities carrying out a home eviction realize they are at the wrong address; a Kansas neighborhood park is terrorized by two loose dogs.

Battling neighbors in San Antonio compare land surveys to determine whose yard owns an extra foot of land; a group of Florida college students are confronted by a man with a weapon; a Houston woman confronts her online critic.

When a Houston family is denied access to a Fourth of July party at the neighborhood pool, verbal fireworks are set off; in New York, a man pulls out a switchblade during a school PTA meeting; in Pennsylvania, a woman taunts her neighbor.

On a full moon, a stranger sets up an erotic photo shoot on a neighbor's porch; two Floridian landscapers are shocked when a woman begins hurling insults; a tenant becomes incensed by his landlord's unannounced visits and decides to lock her out.

In Sacramento, a neighbor mistakenly believes two women exchanging hair products in the park are actually selling drugs; a belligerent woman smashes her neighbor's window in Virginia; neighbors in Canada clash about a lawn care specialist.

El novio de Jennifer coquetea con varias mujeres; el prometido de Kay, dueño de un restaurante tiene una acompañante deliciosa.
Una modelo que es novia de Robert posa desnuda para otro hombre.
Corinne Johnson descubre que su novio, director de escena, en realidad es un excelente actor. Abdul Noonan se entera de que a su novia le gusta el de mantenimiento.
Tom encuentra a su mujer con otro hombre; el novio de Tuneshia tiene una esposa al lado.
El amor de la vida de Tony tiene varias relaciones; la novia de J.T. le engaña a sus espaldas con su mejor amigo.
El esposo de Katy lleva una doble vida secreta; el padre de los hijos de Tammie ama a otra mujer.
La novia de Carly juega para los dos equipos; la novia de James está con otro hombre.
El novio de Diane es demasiado eufórico con otra mujer; la novia de Tatiana pasa su tiempo libre con otra mujer.
Brenda sospecha que es engañada por su novio; novio de larga distancia de Irene tiene una novia en su casa.
Brandi Landry pilla a su novio sudando la gota gorda con otra. Brice Paul descubre que a su novia le gusta fumar y sudar con otro.
El novio de Lucy arregla todo, excepto su relación; la novia de un pueblo pequeño de Austin, se convierte en una chica de la gran ciudad.
El novio de Nicol la ha cambiado por una chica menor; el marido de Angélica tiene una novia.
Brittany Fowler vio unos dibujos inquietantes en la oficina de su novio. Kesha Simmons nota algo raro con su pareja.
Lizet O'Reilly no entiende por qué su novio trabaja tanto. Nicholas Booth quiere que su novia se mude con él, pero ella lo rechaza.
La novia de Jill Kelly comenzó a querer estar sola. La novia de Leroy Cullen está distante y no le devuelve las llamadas.
Tony se entera de que su esposa ha vuelto a sus andanzas. Tatum encuentra a su novio conociendo a otras chicas en una app.
Rayne Brown está preocupada porque su novio cada día trabaja más. Amy Stajan siente que solo le interesa a su novio cuando él necesita dinero.
Lexi McLeod trabaja de día y su novio de noche, lo cual nunca había sido un problema hasta ahora. Pierre Terry no entiende por qué su novia está distante.
Nate cree que su novia puede estar usándolo por su dinero. Christian quiere controlar a Tata.

La esposa de Larry Grant no siempre le contesta el teléfono y solamente se va a dormir temprano cuando él está de viaje. Bridget Braun siente que es momento de dar el siguiente paso, pero su novio está más distante que nunca.
Christian quiere saber por qué Celeste es tan reservada con su vida personal. Por su parte, Amber quiere saber el motivo tras las frecuentes duchas y cortes de pelo de Robert.
Shalyce intenta averiguar por qué Rod parece estar evitándola. Hailey quiere saber por qué Mike no contesta el teléfono cuando lo llama.
Jordan Crosby sospecha que pasa algo con su novia, que ya no le habla ni lo toca. Danni Little se ha dado cuenta de que su novio ya no le lleva el almuerzo ni tiene ganas de pasar tiempo con él.
Lynn teme que su esposo ya no quiera su matrimonio. Ashley nota que del dicho al hecho hay mucho trecho.
Wendy Spring sospecha que hay algo tras el repentino interés de su marido por el yoga. Jasmine Washington quiere mudarse con su novio, pero él la rechaza.
Lindsey Johnson se enamoró de la energía de su novio, pero teme que ahora la esté dirigiendo a alguien más. Mondo Brown está preocupado porque su novia se está saltando las normas de confinamiento.
El esposo de Jasmine quiere más que separarse. Jade duda de las reuniones de trabajo nocturnas de su marido.
A Nicki Parsons le molesta que su prometido haya renunciado al trabajo. Deondre Bradford desconfía del comportamiento extraño de su pareja.
Pedro Green sospecha que su novia solo finge serle fiel. LaShan Hudson quiere saber por qué su novia insiste en hacer ejercicio sin él.
Cata termina con su novio y supone que volverá de rodillas, rogando casarse con ella. Pero tiempo después lo encuentra siendo el hombre perfecto y a punto de casarse con otra.

La seductora agente secreto Helena regresa para cumplir una nueva misión: debe infiltrarse en el círculo privado de un científico genial, de quien sospechan que ha desarrollado un virus altamente mortal y contagioso.
Una manera más relajada de comenzar el día.

Ricardo Soto está casado con Miranda Robles, una mujer guapa con una afortunada posición social. Su esposo aprovechará esta situación para ponerle el cuerno con una jovencita mucho menor que él, sin recordar que el que ríe al último, ríe mejor.
Un empleado del gobierno quiere alejarse de la corrupción, pero se ve atrapado entre perderlo todo o unirse al juego.
Elena es una escurridiza ladrona y artista del disfraz. Al verse perseguida por la policía, se disfraza de monja y se refugia en un convento, donde seguirá cometiendo imprudencias.

Jackie es una joven que disfruta de ayudar a los más necesitados, pero su esposo Samuel no comparte este sentimiento. Un trágico accidente lo deja en coma y entonces ella decide seguir su vida y volverse a enamorar.

Dos jóvenes se reencuentran en otra vida. Alejandro reconoce a Yolanda, quien pertenece a una extraña familia y a la que él culpa de la muerte de su padre. Alejandro busca el secreto detrás de la muerte de su padre.
El hijo de Santa se une con desagrado al negocio familiar, pero debe limpiar su nombre tras ser arrestado por robo.
Un soldado de visita en un pequeño pueblo se enamora de la mujer que dedicó una tarjeta a las tropas.

Kate Snow adora todo lo relacionado con las fiestas, pero sobre todo la tienda que ha pertenecido a su familia durante generaciones, pero un promotor de proyectos se muda a su pintoresco barrio y lo complica todo.
Un niño blanco (Zak Ludwig) y un compañero moreno (Jaishon Fisher) se hacen amigos cuando su padre (Billy Ray Cyrus) y la abuela (Candus Churchill) los obligan a pasar un tiempo juntos.
Con la ayuda de un oso negro llamado Ben, Mark y su tío intentan evitar que un hombre de negocios contamine el ambiente.
Los eventos sobre la II Guerra Mundial alteran las relaciones del editor de un periódico con su familia y amigos.

Tori es una deportista que le da poca importancia a la moda, el maquillaje y las apariencias. Sin embargo, cuando se enamora de un colega, decide transformarse y volverse más femenina para conquistarlo.
Mientras pasa el verano con su tío, un chico citadino hace amistad con un oso negro atrapado en una mina.
Una casamentera profesional y un viudo se conocen por Internet a través de una agencia de citas.
Dos receptores (Samantha Mathis, Peter Dobson) de trasplante de corazón sienten un inexplicable amor por una niña huérfana.
Al quedarse repentinamente sin trabajo, una mujer toma una posición como niñera para un guapo padre adoptivo.
Un exmarido y un primer amor provocan que una mujer dude acerca de su próxima boda.
Un hombre se entera de que la carta de amor de secundaria que escribió a su mejor amiga, está ahora en las manos de su nuevo novio.

Abby es una organizadora de bodas especializada en arreglar bodas que salieron mal. Obligada a trabajar con su exprometido, pronto empieza a cuestionarse si su relación fue el desastre que ella recuerda.
Grace (Rena Sofer) y Michael (Dean McDermott), dos enamorados de la preparatoria, se ven 20 años después durante una reunión.
Tres niños huérfanos se quedan temporalmente con una pareja (Dean Cain, Jean Louisa Kelly) durante la Navidad.
La vida de Jorge y Felipe, dos jóvenes amigos, da un vuelco el día que encuentran un cráneo enterrado en el jardín. Así comienza una espiral de extraños acontecimientos.

Cinco desconocidos despiertan encerrados en un edificio. No saben quién los ha traído ni qué pretende. A lo largo de esa noche, descubrirán con sorpresa que en el exterior está ocurriendo una invasión y que ellos fueron elegidos para detenerla.

Después de una larga búsqueda, las autoridades atrapan al supuesto "asesino de Malagua", un individuo al cual se le acusa de asesinar cruelmente a más de veinte víctimas. Tras las rejas, es visitado por un reportero debido a los fuertes rumores de que él es la persona equivocada, por lo que cuenta la verdad de lo que realmente pasó.
Jennifer se reúne de forma arriesgada con el contratista, quien se enfrenta a Ibrahim. A medida que Ibrahim se acerca a su objetivo, la policía se acerca a él con la ayuda de Zeina.
Sin pistas, Ibrahim renuncia a su destino, pero a Jennifer se le ocurre una nueva idea. Sami pone a Zeina en riesgo.
Un animal ataca a seis estudiantes que están haciendo una excursión por el bosque y los infecta con un virus desconocido que los convierte en criaturas sedientas de sangre.
Un portero investiga un guion perdido y despierta horrores ocultos en un edificio maldito de Nueva York.
Una bella mujer es atormentada por una serie de sueños repetitivos al tiempo que llama la atención de dos hombres.

Secuestran a una joven adinerada, pero la persona que debería pagar el rescate desaparece. Mientras lo buscan, se suceden hechos inesperados que obligarán a los secuestradores a luchar contra sus peores miedos para mantenerse con vida.
Una joven mujer que atraviesa una crisis económica, una niña y un perro fiel pasan la noche en una casa a punto de derrumbarse, que además que esconde un tesoro y un espíritu atormentado.
La historia de Ariel Lambert, un joven de veinte años, a quien luego de un trastorno psicológico, se le recomienda hacer reposo en un lugar tranquilo y apacible.
A man (Anthony Hopkins) searches for his missing daughter in one of several vignettes dealing with issues of love, loss and betrayal.
A 90-year-old atheist has outlived and out-smoked his contemporaries, and as he comes to terms with his own mortality, he searches for ever-elusive enlightenment.

Life deals a few heavy blows to April (Helen Hunt), a 39-year-old schoolteacher. Though she is desperate for a baby, her husband (Matthew Broderick) has decided to end their brief marriage. April barely has a chance to recover from the shock, when Bernice (Bette Midler), a brassy and selfish TV personality, barges into her life, claiming to be her mother.
A dentist (Josh Pais) gains the ability to heal his patients' physical pain while his sister (Rosemarie DeWitt), a massage therapist, develops an aversion to touching and being touched.
As a planet hurtles toward a collision course with Earth, two sisters (Kirsten Dunst, Charlotte Gainsbourg) cope with the approaching doomsday in different ways.
Though a misfit among his brainy family members, Massachusetts bouncer Doug Glatt has a knockout punch that lands him a spot on a minor-league Canadian hockey team.
Two scruffy pals' (Tyler Labine, Alan Tudyk) backwoods vacation takes a bloody turn when ignorant college students mistake them for a pair of murderous hillbillies.
Although they're both dating other people, two co-workers (Olivia Wilde, Jake Johnson) hang out together in bars and try to ignore their mutual attraction.
A 29-year-old lawyer (Gillian Jacobs) and her lesbian best friend (Leighton Meester) experience a dramatic shift in their longtime bond after one enters a serious relationship.
A janitor (Michael Caine) convinces a frustrated executive (Demi Moore) to help him steal gems from their employer, the London Diamond Corp.

Harper (Tye Sheridan), a seemingly naive law student, obsesses over the idea that his shifty stepfather (Stephen Moyer) was involved in the devastating car crash that left his mother hospitalized and comatose. While drowning his suspicions in whiskey, he suddenly finds himself engrossed in a conversation with a volatile grifter (Emory Cohen) and his stripper companion (Bel Powley). As daylight breaks, Harper soon realizes that he's in over his head with this violent duo.

Aspiring doctor Peter Hadley (Jeremy Strong) gets the shock of his life when his hard-nosed father (Peter Bogdanovich) -- and medical-school professor -- fails him, invalidating his acceptance to an elite residency program. His long-standing life plan suddenly in question, the introverted Hadley stumbles through the streets of Los Angeles, until a one-night stand with singer Bogart (Fairuza Balk) lands him on an unexpected pilgrimage to Humboldt County, the marijuana capital of the West Coast.
An obsessed young man (Michael Angarano) crashes the wedding of his older former lover (Uma Thurman) in a misguided attempt to reignite romantic sparks.
A drug-addled, manipulative misanthrope (James McAvoy) begins to experience increasingly severe hallucinations as he tries to solve the murder of a Japanese student.

After Isaac's blind girlfriend walks out on him, his life goes into free fall, and he directs an unhinged staging of Chekhov's "The Seagull," attends the Passover Seder from hell, and attempts to woo a new flame.
The artistry and creativity that bring Cirque du Soleil performances to life.

MacGyver is a top agent for the Phoenix Foundation, a progressive agency devoted to righting the wrongs of the world. Even more progressive is the genius MacGyver, who never carries a gun and always thwarts the enemy with vast scientific knowledge - sometimes with little more than a paper clip and the duct tape in his pocket.
The missing student (Sian Barbara Allen) of a foreign expatriate may hold the vital clue to solving her instructor's watery murder.
McGarrett gets involved when an influential father objects to his 16-year-old daughter's romance with a poor boy.
A murder investigation leads Five-0 to the proud matriarch (Eleanor Parker) of an influential island family; guest Cal Bellini.

Dr. Jason Bull is the charming and cocky founder of successful trial consulting firm Trial Analysis Corporation, where he and his team of experts employ psychology, human intuition and high-tech data to understand jurors, lawyers, witnesses and defendants, and construct effective narratives to help their clients win. Bull's team include his brother-in-law Benny, neurolinguistics expert Marissa, former detective Danny, hacker Cable, and Chunk, who helps perfect clients' appearances for trial. "Bull" is inspired by the early career of Dr. Phil McGraw, who also serves as executive producer.

Failure isn't an option for the new Navy SEALs, and that kind of pressure can take a toll on the members of the special operations forces' most elite unit. This team trains, plans and executes some of the most dangerous, high-stakes missions and deploys for clandestine missions around the globe at a moment's notice. While serving their country is a worthy and rewarding cause, it can put a strain on the SEALs and their families, causing the guys to look out for one another in the face of seemingly overwhelming odds, both on and off the job.

A Florida team of forensics investigators uses cutting-edge scientific methods and old-fashioned police work to solve crimes. Horatio Caine, a former homicide detective, heads a group of investigators who work crimes amid the steamy tropical surroundings and cultural crossroads of Miami.

Tom Selleck stars as Frank Reagan, the New York Police Commissioner, and patriarch of the Reagan clan, a multigenerational family of cops. Frank's oldest son is Danny, a seasoned detective and Iraqi War veteran who occasionally uses dubious tactics to solve cases. Daughter Erin, the lone female, is an assistant district attorney. Fresh out of Harvard Law, Jamie is the youngest member and "golden boy" of the family. Jamie gave up a lucrative future in law to continue the family's tradition in police work, and is asked to participate in a secretive investigation that even his father does not know about.
McGarrett takes his first undercover assignment when he poses as a merchant seaman to probe the murder of a labor-union reformer.
A rising young politician (David Birney) is the victim of a blackmail scheme designed to squelch a congressional probe.
McGarrett clashes with a federal agent while looking for a drug dealer sought for killing a police officer; guest Charles Cioffi.

Eccentric genius Walter O'Brien leads a group of brilliant misfits who constitute Homeland Security's new think tank, helping defend against the high-tech threats of the computer age. The team -- dubbed Scorpion -- includes behaviorist Toby Curtis, mechanical prodigy Happy Quinn, and statistics guru Sylvester Dodd. While comfortable with one another, the team members struggle with understanding life outside their circle, so when they need help translating societal cues, they rely on the skills of Paige Dineen, a woman with a gifted young son.

When a very public sex and political-corruption scandal lands her husband, Peter, in prison, Alicia Florrick (Emmy-winner Julianna Margulies ) must get past the humiliation and betrayal and assume responsibility for her family. She resumes her career as a defense attorney, shedding her persona as the embarrassed wife of a politician, and takes charge of her destiny. Years later, after Peter wins the gubernatorial election, Alicia must balance her evolving career and family responsibilities with her new position as first lady of Illinois.

In what became known as the crime of the century, a boy from one of Chicago's wealthiest families is kidnapped and found murdered; the ensuing investigation zeroes in on the wealthy, thrill-seeking college students, Nathan Leopold and Richard Loeb.
Heiress Barbara Mackle is kidnapped and buried alive in a coffin-like capsule; local police and the FBI race to Mackle's abductor before her time underground runs out.

A reexamination of the 1996 murder of 6-year-old JonBenét Ramsey includes never-before-seen evidence, police interrogation tapes, unsealed documents, more than 500 family photographs, and profiles of chief suspects.
In Boulder, Colo., the police focus on JonBenét Ramsey's family during the murder investigation, then a slew of new suspects emerge, turning the case on its head.

The JonBenét Ramsey murder case takes a turn after an anonymous confession comes to light from a source located 8,000 miles away from Colorado; an interview with the only person ever arrested for the child's murder.
Calling 911, a young father gasps that he has accidentally shot himself while working on a farm; the police hear a second shot on the line while racing to find him.
Police in two cities receive a series of bizarre 911 calls from a serial killer confessing his crimes; the man becomes known as the Weepy Voiced Killer due to his strange, whining voice.
A terrified woman tries to give police clues in a harrowing call, then police find her body in the river, and they discover a stomach-churning truth about a killer who's been a predator for years.

A woman returns home to find her husband unconscious and bleeding on the floor of their horse barn; a 911 operator coaches her through CPR, but it's too late, and police later use the call itself to find clues to a plot to kill a beloved father.
Calling 911, a former police officer struggles to explain he's been shot multiple times and his girlfriend has been abducted.

A man finds his wife with a cord around her neck and makes a heartbreaking 911 call, pleading for someone to save his beloved; then this story of love and loss is complicated by a missing phone, crime scene clues and a mystery man.
Church parishioners call 911 when they find their priest stabbed to death, then police uncover an earlier 911 call made by the priest himself and track a missing cell phone to find his killer.

In a distressing 911 call, a woman reports someone is breaking into her home, then the dispatcher hears a scream and a gunshot; investigators soon connect the case to a previous home invasion and race to solve the crimes.

A man calls 911 screaming for help but is too terrified to give his address, and police scramble to find him; as detectives investigate, they uncover a shocking tale of torture and revenge that demonstrates the deadliness of unrequited love.

A panicked woman calls 911 to say a stranger forced his way into her home and shot her boyfriend in front of their children; detectives untangle a twisted web of jealousy to find out who killed this young father and why.

Two distraught women call 911 when they discover their sister brutally murdered; soon, detectives uncover a stunning surprise and struggle to find a killer whose self-hatred drove him to commit the ultimate crime in a precedent-setting case.
A man calls 911 to report he's on the telephone with his girlfriend who's in trouble; when police respond, the door is answered by the woman's two frightened sons, and she has been severely beaten.

A man calls 911 claiming he found his ex-girlfriend dead, but his behavior on the call leads police to wonder if he could be involved; investigators gather evidence to convict a killer whose unchecked rage left a young son motherless.

When a young woman is shot dead in front of her son, horrified witnesses call 911 and describe the shooter as a slender man who disappeared into nearby trees; though clues are scarce, investigators finally uncover the killer's shocking identity.

A woman calls 911 to say she's found her son unconscious in his home; when police arrive, they realize he's dead; the victim's hands are bound, and he's been strangled; at first, it seems like a burglary gone bad, but police soon discover otherwise.

With the help of a neighbor, an injured woman calls 911 saying an intruder broke into her boyfriend's home and shot them both; police respond to find the boyfriend executed; they must decipher strange evidence left behind to identify the killer.

A dying man calls 911 to say he's been shot in the heart and his son has been shot dead; after the shooter escapes into the night, the detectives must navigate a complex group of suspects to uncover a tangled web of rage and revenge.

Two girls disappear from neighboring counties, and they are later found murdered; one family receives multiple taunting calls from the killer; investigators work to track him down and succeed after discovering a clue delivered by the killer himself.

A terrified neighbor calls 911 after witnessing a young mother being gunned down in her driveway; police work to uncover a complex conspiracy that ripped the loving mother from her three children, just to keep dark secrets hidden.

A frantic woman calls 911 when she finds her husband shot to death; the investigation reveals allegations of harassment from the victim's ex-lover and eventually uncovers a complex trail of deceit, in a murder that was years in the making.

Calling 911, a woman whispers that intruders broke into her home, bound her and her son and attacked her husband; police arrive to find the husband dead and the killers gone; investigators struggle to expose the twisted mastermind behind the crime.

A frantic woman calls 911 saying an intruder just entered her home and shot her husband; when a local fire chief dies from his injuries, first responders work tirelessly to find out who killed one of their own.

A traumatized man calls 911 after seeing his friend shot and killed right before his eyes; with a surprisingly long list of suspects, investigators must sort through layers of lies, jealousy and mistrust to uncover the shooter.
After a doctor is shot at his ranch during a chaotic assault, investigators follow a trail of vehicles, surveillance footage and telephone records to discover a plan hatched by a band of brothers.
Whenever families get together, there's bound to be tension; but when two kissing cousins start carrying on, their relationship ends with nine people dead.
Dianna dives through the looking glass in this paradoxical exploration of truth itself, where the left could be right.
Kyle Hill and Eugenia Cheng join the show to prove there is more than one infinity, that infinity is hidden all around us and that we might actually be infinite ourselves.
Professor Jim Al-Khalili tries to find where gravity is weakest in Britain and where humans weigh the least.
Using Einstein's elaborate theories, Jim Al-Khalili looks at whether the rate humans age is affected by gravity and the speed at which the Earth moves.
Simone Giertz, Reggie Watts and Naomi Fitter join Dianna for an exploration of consciousness.
Comedian Maz Jobrani and Blackjack legend Mike Aponte play the odds, meanwhile, Dianna finds order in chaos, and just maybe hacks the stock market.

Christophe Rocancourt is a French impostor and con artist who scammed rich and powerful people by masquerading in turn as a French nobleman, the heir to the Rockefeller family, or as a Russian prince.

Matthew Cox is a former mortgage broker from Florida who found himself on the Secret Service's most wanted list; he made millions falsifying homeownership and mortgage documents for five times the properties' actual worth.

Jan Lewan is the polka sensation from Pennsylvania who fleeced millions of investors with his classic Ponzi scheme; his name shot to fame when Netflix produced the movie "Polka King" with actor Jack Black playing Jan Lewan.

Nicknamed The Chameleon, Frédéric Bourdin is a former French serial imposter who claims to have faked at least five hundred false identities, including a young Texas boy who went missing in the mid-90s.

Shaun Greenhalgh is a British artist and art forger; between 1989 and 2006, he produced a number of forgeries including Roman and Chinese art objects, and medieval Christian relics, that fooled some of the world's most respected art institutions.

Dubbed the "Mini Madoff," Kiener is one of Germany's greatest con artists, tricking thousands of private investors and banks, including Barclays and J.P. Morgan, to the tune of more than $300 million.

Six-year-old Ritchie asks his parents about the birds and the bees.

Rob's pal Jerry strains their friendship when he starts knocking Rob's television show in public.

Romance enters Sally's life in the form of an insurance salesman named Leo Fassbinder.
Rob's bashful brother arrives in town and proves to be confident and outgoing only when he is sleepwalking.
Rob's brother (Jerry Van Dyke) auditions for the show while awake.
Buddy convinces Rob that he and all other American husbands are being dominated by women.

The frozen Arctic sea isn't just white, the ice glows green with life as algae bloom and sustain vast ecosystems beneath its surface; scientists explore this hidden layer of polar biodiversity and discover what it reveals.

On Maui's Haleakala volcano, witness a cloud spawning site in real time; Pacific trade winds race to meet morning thermals on the upcountry slopes, boiling up clouds for paragliders to try their luck.
Described as "the greatest meeting of land and water in the world," experience the sight and sound of relaxing surf at Point Lobos, with some of the life that revels in it.
An evening drive along Acadia National Park's "Park Loop Road" reveals a land and seascape just as awe-inspiring in a modern vehicle as it was in a horse-drawn carriage.

Bird calls greet the dawn along the Cosumnes River; nestled among Big Sur's foothills is unique wetland habitat shaped by thick summer fog, plentiful winter rain, and moderate year-round temperatures.
The glacial outwash plain in Wyoming, with rolling hills and a nearby creek make this excellent summer habitat for Rocky Mountain elk, mule deer, and the rare pronghorn at dawn.
Dawn on a peak in the Southern Alps of the South Island provides a morning study of high-altitude stillness, spectacular color, and long-distant perspective.
An extraordinary look at the Adams family's 237-year-old garden; a Yorkist rose blooms in homage to the American Revolution; apple trees signify faith and the seasons of the American experiment.

The blossoms of the jacaranda fall like rain from the trees and collect like snow, softening the spring of this mid-Pacific subtropical archipelago.
Witness the event of dawn alongside a magical inland pond with birds, millipedes, and a range of plants; this is sunrise in the state of Rio Grande do Norte in northeastern Brazil.
A desperate man takes part in an underworld game of Russian roulette in which gamblers place bets on who will survive.

Remorseless assassin Joe (Nicolas Cage) is in Thailand to complete a series of contract killings for a crime boss called Surat (Nirattisai Kaljaruek). He hires a street punk named Kong (Shahkrit Yamnam) to run errands for him, all the while planning to kill the youth at the conclusion of his assignment. Instead, Joe becomes Kong's unlikely mentor, and begins a tentative romance with a local shop girl. But as Joe begins to let his guard down, Surat decides it is time to clean house.

Thrown into hell for his crimes, brutal felon John Milton escapes from the fiery pit after cultists murder his daughter and take her baby. Intent on rescuing the child, Milton joins forces with a waitress, who gives him her ex-lover's fire-red muscle car. In it, the two pursue the cult leader, who plans to sacrifice the infant and unleash hell on Earth. However, the hunters become the hunted when Satan sends his merciless henchman to drag Milton back.
An ex-con and reformed sociopath battles a band of heavily armed mercenaries as he tries to uncover the truth behind his brother's mysterious death.

Luke Wright is a two-bit cage fighter, until the day he throws a fixed match. In retaliation, the Russian mob murders his family and destroys his life. Though alone and haunted by grief, Luke springs into action to save a Chinese girl (Catherine Chan) from the same gangsters who killed his family -- and lands in the middle of a high-stakes war. The girl is no ordinary child; she's a math prodigy who holds in her head a numerical code for which various factions are ready to kill.
A monk infiltrates the Chinese underworld to punish a warlord and his deadly army.

Seth and Richie take the Fuller family hostage and attempt to leave the motel undetected, but Freddie -- led by the same force that has been guiding Richie -- arrives at their door, igniting a clash that nearly destroys them all.

After a daring escape from the motel, Seth leads the Fullers' RV to the border crossing; an irrational fear takes hold of Richie; Jacob Fuller takes control of a volatile situation, determined to get his children safely across the border.
Robert Rodriguez invites five amateur filmmakers to take on the same challenge he did 25 years ago with his first film -- to write, shoot and edit a brand-new feature length film with only $7,000.

When the investigations of supernatural detective Edward Carnby (Christian Slater) led him to uncover a long-lost tribe called the Abskani, he finds out that they worshipped demons. These evil creatures are now attempting to resurface in the world, and Edward can stop them only with the help of Aline Cedrac (Tara Reid), an archeologist who also happens to be his old flame. With sinister forces attempting to take over Edward's mind, can he and Aline stop them before it's too late?
A woman embarks on a vengeful quest to save her kidnapped daughter from a mysterious man from her past.

Mega City One is a vast, violent metropolis where felons rule the streets. The only law lies with cops called "judges," who act as judge, jury and executioner, and Dredd (Karl Urban) is one of the city's most feared. One day, Dredd is partnered with Cassandra (Olivia Thirlby), a rookie with powerful psychic abilities. A report of a terrible crime sends Dredd and Cassandra to a dangerous area controlled by Ma-Ma (Lena Headey), a drug lord who will stop at nothing to protect her empire.

Hong Kong police inspector Lin Dong learns that a biochemical invention has been surgically implanted into his missing daughter. With help from a hacker, Lin tries to connect the dots between the device, a sinister army and a strange phenomenon.

Quan is a humble London businessman whose long-buried past erupts in a revenge-fueled vendetta when the only person left for him to love -- his teenage daughter -- dies in a senseless act of politically motivated terrorism. His relentless search to find the terrorists leads to a cat-and-mouse conflict with a British government official whose own past may hold the clues to the identities of the elusive killers.
