A tough cop (Jason Statham) goes after a serial killer who targets police officers.
Los cocineros compiten entre ellos para participar en una sesión fotográfica y ser los anfitriones de una cena para los miembros del Ejército.

Los equipos deben crear su propio menú para el servicio de la noche. A pesar de la mediocre selección, el equipo de las mujeres amenaza con superar a los hombres cuando de servicio de comidas se trata.
Los chefs elaboran platos étnicos con ingredientes selectos; un equipo se queda atrás antes de la cena.
Ramsay pone a prueba los paladares de los chefs con una prueba de sabor a ciegas; Ramsay presenta un desafío inesperado para determinar quién obtiene inmunidad.
El cocinero con el mejor plato gana la inmunidad; los chefs preparan una comida para la anfitriona de televisión María Menounos y el actor Jeremy Sisto.

Ramsay prueba la capacidad de los concursantes de comunicarse y trabajar juntos con una carrera de relevos de tres entradas, y los ganadores obtienen un viaje de helicópteros y una degustación de caviar.

Los concursantes restantes son enviados a la ciudad de Nueva York para aprender sobre los diferentes tipos de cocina y visitar BLT Steak, donde el ganador va a trabajar; de vuelta en Hell's Kitchen, deben preparar un plato con lo que han aprendido.

El chef Ramsay le pide a cada equipo que prepare 3 platillos en 30, 20 y 10 minutos respectivamente, pero que los presente al mismo tiempo. Hay un evento de etiqueta en el restaurante y todos deberán dar la mejor impresión posible.
Los cinco concursantes restantes compiten como un equipo; competidores enfrentan eliminación.
Los cinco chefs restantes intentan de nuevo demostrar su valor al chef Ramsay; después de un pésimo servicio, los chefs se enfrentan a la eliminación.
Los últimos cuatro chefs compiten, ellos deben recrear un plato que han probado, pero sin receta.
Los dos finalistas compiten por el puesto de jefe de cocina en BLT Steak en Nueva York.

Veinte aspirantes a hosteleros presentan sus platos de autor a Ramsay, y a la audiencia, en Las Vegas. Mientras los ganadores de la prueba pasan la noche en la ciudad, los perdedores deberán volver a Los Ángeles en un autobús escolar.
Los concursantes llegan a los dormitorios; Ramsay envía a concursantes fuera de la cocina después de un difícil primer servicio de cena.

Ramsay pone a los concursantes a través de un reto físico con langostas; los ganadores del reto disfrutan de un día en yate y los perdedores deben limpiar cientos de libras de pescado; Ramsay está decepcionado por un desorganizado servicio de cena.

Los atletas Maurice Green, Natalie Coughlin y Danell Leyva ayudan a Ramsay a organizar una carrera 3K, con los equipos rojo y azul corriendo para preparar el almuerzo; problemas de comunicación llevan a peleas durante el servicio de cena.

Los equipos deben identificar el tipo de proteína es usada en cinco platos; el equipo ganador disfruta su victoria en una casa de playa, los perdedores deben moler granos para preparar pan desde cero; los concursantes son puestos en la parrilla.
Ramsay toma una decisión que cambia la competición, dos chefs trabajan como servidores durante el servicio de la cena, cada equipo nomina a dos concursantes para ponerlos en la eliminación.
El Chef Martín Yan juzga seis platos chinos creados por los concursantes restantes; durante el servicio de la cena, un equipo decepciona un invitado VIP; un concursante es eliminado.
Gordon intenta ayudar a una mujer y a su hijo, quienes dirigen su restaurante de Islip, Nueva York, mismo que tiene muchos problemas.
Gordon hace cambios serios en un restaurante italiano, el Fair Lawn, de Nueva Jersey, que está perdiendo dinero. La policía interrumpe una fiesta durante la reapertura del restaurante.

El chef Ramsay intenta mejorar las cosas en un pequeño restaurante italiano llamado Peter's, dirigido por una familia en Babylon, Nueva York, pero se enfrenta a una persona malhumorada muy parecida a "El Padrino".
El chef Gordon Ramsay utiliza su magia en un restaurante de Tuckahoe, Nueva York, que ha sido renovado, pero aun así tiene un servicio y una comida muy malos.
El chef Ramsay está en la Gran Manzana para remodelar Dillon's, un restaurante indio a solo unas cuadras de su próspero restaurante.
Ramsay visita el Restaurante y Salón Handlebar en Mount Sinai, Nueva York para ayudar a arreglar el restaurante de Bill y Carolyn LeRoy, que parece que se quedó en la década de 1980.
Los chefs son sorprendidos por miembros familiares y luego participan en prueba de olla a presión.
Un equipo de ganadores anteriores vuelve a desafiar a los demás concursantes; cada equipo diseña sus propios menús para la cena.
A disrespected but decent British detective unravels a cold case about a missing seventeen-year-old girl while trying to deal with the breakup of his marriage.
Detective Davies is bewildered by an elderly woman's lack of concern for her missing husband.
When a staff member is found dead at the hospital, Lawson suspects the former morgue attendant Ron Jackson, who has vanished without trace.
A traveling salesman crashes his car and is pronounced dead at the scene, but it wasn't the crash that killed him.
Blake is called to a delirious death row prisoner who plead guilty to murder long ago.
When an undercover officer is killed, Frost must force his colleagues to cooperate in the investigation.
Suspects give conflicting accounts about Inspector Fox's death.
After a beautiful gypsy woman is murdered, Blake enters the exotic world of a group of Romani travelers making their way through Ballarat.
Bill Hobart is a murder suspect after a French chef is found dead in a restaurant freezer.
Blake investigates the truth behind Ballarat before unravelling the mystery of a writer's murder.
The family hopes for refuge in the countryside from the contagion, but Marco remains in Florence.
In front of the Signoria, Albizzi accuses Cosimo of plotting to become the city dictator.
Circumstances continue to go downhill in Florence while the family remains in exile; Albizzi takes control of Florence.
The family returns to Florence in triumph; Albrizzi winds up in prison for trying to take over the city.
A businessman's (Barry Bostwick) wife (Susan Lucci) starts a dangerous affair with a college athlete (Patrick Van Horn) at her country club.

On a luxurious cruise on the Nile River, a wealthy heiress, Linnet Ridgeway (Lois Chiles), is murdered. Fortunately, among the passengers are famed Belgian detective Hercule Poirot (Peter Ustinov) and his trusted companion, Colonel Race (David Niven), who immediately begin their investigation. But just as Poirot identifies a motley collection of would-be murderers, several of the suspects also meet their demise, which only deepens the mystery of the killer's identity.
A clueless politician falls in love with a waitress whose erratic behavior is caused by a nail stuck in her head.

Single mother Teena is brutally assaulted by a local gang in front of her 12-year-old daughter Bethie. Despite Bethie being able to identify the attackers, the defense hires a local hot-shot defense attorney who manipulates the law to their advantage. When the criminals are set free, Gulf War veteran and detective John Dromoor is dismayed by the lack of justice and plots revenge against the men on Teena's behalf.
A con artist (Milla Jovovich) faces a tough decision when her criminal past catches up to her and her young son.

As winter break begins, a group of sorority sisters, including Jess (Olivia Hussey) and the often inebriated Barb (Margot Kidder), begin to receive anonymous, lascivious phone calls. Initially, Barb eggs the caller on, but stops when he responds threateningly. Soon, Barb's friend Clare (Lynne Griffin) goes missing from the sorority house, and a local adolescent girl is murdered, leading the girls to suspect a serial killer is on the loose. But no one realizes just how near the culprit is.

A group of carousing American tourists is taking in the cultural landmarks of Paris when a chance encounter results in sightseer Andy McDermott (Tom Everett Scott) saving the life of Parisian Serafine Pigot (Julie Delpy). While on a date at a nightclub with Serafine, Andy is suddenly attacked and bitten by a werewolf. The next day he discovers that Serafine is also a lycanthrope, and that he is beginning his own grueling, hirsute transformation into one of the fanged beasts.
The peace of a desert town is shattered by gruesome murders that appear to be the work of a werewolf.

Apollo 17 was the last U.S.-sponsored lunar voyage -- or was it? Hours of found footage, classified for decades, point to a subsequent moon mission -- Apollo 18 -- that ended very badly. Astronauts John Grey (Ryan Robbins), Nathan Walker (Lloyd Owen) and Benjamin Anderson (Warren Christie), on a mission to install radar scanners, discover a Soviet space capsule nearby. The men also discover a dead cosmonaut, and unfortunately for them, learn how he died.
Movie, Science fiction, Thriller, Horror, Mystery

Renegade police officer Matthew Cordell (Robert Z'Dar) once roamed the streets of New York City unleashing his murderous brand of vigilante justice upon its denizens before being struck down by good cop Jack Forrest (Bruce Campbell). Now, Forrest is eager to move on from those heinous events, but he is stopped short when a familiar killing spree begins. Though thought dead and gone, Cordell is back from the grave and ready to wreak his merciless havoc once more.
Deadly wasps threaten a small town after a scientist (Michael Shanks) accidentally releases them.

Scaggs) has apparently committed suicide. But, as the gruesome visions continue, they sense that there's still something sinister afoot. When they find themselves hunted by a band of homicidal marionettes created by twisted puppeteer Andre Toulon (William Hickey), they discover they're right.

Los padres (Anne Jackson, Eli Wallach) de un niño en estado de coma tratan de consolar a su hija, que se siente responsable.

Jonathan, Mark, y un cínico columnista de un periódico neoyorquino comparten un taxi y buscan el significado del espíritu navideño.

Charley Trapolla, un pequeño criminal, se encuentra un maletín con un millón de dólares dentro. Pero su alegría inicial desaparece pronto cuando los propietarios del maletín, dos peligrosos criminales, quieren recuperarlo.

The story of a killer who was infamous for his whimpering confessions over the phone after each of his murders.

Nick tries to contact the spirit of Malinda Niles to see if she'll reveal her cause of death.

A woman is charged with starting a fire which ends up killing the two sleeping children of her lesbian lover.
Dena Thompson targets, defrauds and attacks the men in her life before deciding to murder her husband.

An outlaw will surrender if his sweetheart gets the reward.
Lucas' old friend arrives for an unexpected visit.

A marshal from another territory comes to North Fork looking for a wanted man.

The unthinkable happens when heavily armed and highly trained terrorists launch a bold daytime attack on the White House. The building is overrun, and President Benjamin Asher (Aaron Eckhart) and his staff are taken hostage. Luckily for Asher, former presidential security officer Mike Banning (Gerard Butler) is on the scene. With time running out, it's up to Banning to locate Asher's son before the extremists do and rescue the president before his captors unleash their ultimate plan.

After the death of the British prime minister, the world's most powerful leaders gather in London to pay their respects. Without warning, terrorists unleash a devastating attack that leaves the city in chaos and ruins. Secret Service agent Mike Banning (Gerard Butler) springs into action to bring U.S. President Benjamin Asher (Aaron Eckhart) to safety. When Asher falls into the hands of the sinister organization, it's up to Banning to save his commander in chief from a horrible fate.

John "Breacher" Wharton (Arnold Schwarzenegger) leads an elite DEA task force. Its latest mission is a high-stakes raid on a safe house owned by one of the world's deadliest drug cartels. Wharton and his team (Sam Worthington, Terrence Howard, Joe Manganiello) complete the mission successfully but secretly steal $10 million for themselves. They think their work is done -- until, one-by-one, the commandos are mysteriously killed. As the body count rises, everyone becomes a suspect.

Danny Bryce (Jason Statham), one of the world's deadliest special-ops agents, returns from self-imposed exile after his mentor, Hunter (Robert De Niro) is captured. Danny reassembles his former team of skilled commandos to launch a rescue mission, and also to infiltrate the highly feared military unit, the British Special Air Service. The mission will not be easy, for Danny and his team must cut their way through Spike (Clive Owen) and a team of assassins known as the Feather Men.
Prehistoric Darwin uses ESP with animals to save a slave girl from a sorcerer.
A romance blossoms between the youngest daughter of a merchant who has fallen on hard times and the mysterious beast her father owes a debt to.
A pregnant photographer (Selma Blair) captures motherhood on film while re-examining her relationship with her estranged mom.
A mall security guard has to protect a female witness from a gang after they lose all forms of communication during a storm.

Eight years after fleeing the Congo following his assassination of that country's minister of mining, former assassin Jim Terrier (Sean Penn) is back, suffering from PTSD and digging wells to atone for his violent past. After an attempt is made on his life, Terrier flies to London to find out who wants him dead -- and why. Terrier's search leads him to a reunion with Annie (Jasmine Trinca), a woman he once loved, who is now married to an oily businessman (Javier Bardem) with dealings in Africa.
Movie, Action, Thriller, Crime drama, Mystery

Bullets fly on the Atlanta freeway as armed thieves make their getaway following a bank robbery in broad daylight. Unhappy with the results, ruthless gangster Irina Vlaslov orders the men to pull off another job. One member of the team is Marcus Belmont (Anthony Mackie), a crooked cop who gets saddled with Chris Allen (Casey Affleck), his new but incorruptible police partner. As Belmont and his cohorts lay the groundwork for the heist, they come up with a devious plan to use Allen as their pawn.
Walker recalls his fiancée in painful flashbacks when her killer, a man now determined to murder Walker, is released from prison.
Victor LaRue makes an escape from his competency hearing, holding the courtroom hostage to exact his revenge against Alex.
Walker must rescue a young man sought by a powerful Chinese gang that wants to retrieve from him a jade dragon they believe possesses magical powers.
A 10-year-old miraculously recovers from a drive-by shooting and enlists Walker to help her stop the violence.
As an archaeology professor in 1957, Sam and a colleague (Lisa Darr) scoff at an ancient tomb's curse until co-workers begin to die.

Reno heads to Chicago to prevent his estranged father from killing an escaped convict who was responsible for the death of the elder Raines' partner.

Game show series have been making a comeback in television, and media and "America Says" is no exception. This program is following in the footsteps of the popular mobile app game "HQ Trivia." The network is planning its own spin on the game show, and Fran Shea, evp, programming and marketing, says she "has been studying the GSN audience and prepared a slate of new shows that reflect what it wants: family-friendly, fun, escapist television." In "America Says," two teams face off to guess Americans' responses to questions covering a variety of topics. Michael Higgins is the host.
Joey Fatone hosts as teams compete to answer practical, everyday questions, including one about how to avoid getting seasick on a cruise ship.
Joey Fatone hosts as teams compete to answer practical, everyday questions, such as how to react when one's dog runs away.
Jonathan's look-alike and his magician brother (Harry Blackstone) plan to kill Jonathan and run Hart Industries.
An eccentric art collector (John Dehner) wants to add Jennifer to treasures by eliminating Jonathan.
Jennifer faces danger after she is lent a flashy outfit with "rhinestones" that are really diamonds.
Thelma's indecision turns to agony when Harry accepts a new job and moves to California.
As the Evanses prepare to join James in Mississippi, a damper is thrown on everything.
Florida's attitude toward James' death causes dissension in an already saddened household.
Thelma's favorite teacher falls first for J.J.'s paintings and then for J.J.

Junk dealer Fred Sanford runs roughshod over his son and partner, Lamont, in a groundbreaking sitcom. Fred's moneymaking schemes routinely backfire, and he does just about anything to get out of working -- up to and including faking a heart attack. He's rude, sarcastic, outspoken, overtly prejudiced, and pretty darn nasty to his friends and family.
An undercover police unit consisting of young looking officers infiltrates high schools to control youth crime. Now available On Demand the same day as DVD. R $4.99.
A court orders Hunter to produce an informant in a murder case, which he defies when the killer is released on bail.
Hunter and McCall (Fred Dryer, Stepfanie Kramer) find a web of vengeance and fraud when they investigate the killing of a thoroughbred racehorse.
Rockford relies on a friend (Bo Hopkins), a disbarred lawyer, when accused of beating a man to death; guest Sorrell Booke.

Jim Rockford is an ex-con and private detective. He was falsely convicted of a crime he didn't commit, but that doesn't stop him from using his ex-con buddies to help him solve crimes. Nothing comes easy for Rockford, but he works hard and usually gets shot at or beat up at least once per episode.
From Ulker Arena in Istanbul, Turkey.
Eight man light heavyweight elimination tournament featuring Tyrone Spong, Brian Collette, Danyo Ilunga, Mourad Bouzidi and more. From New York.
Jerome Le Banner vs. Sergey Kharitonov; Robin Van Roosmalen vs. Shemsi Beqiri. From Los Angeles.
The Aluetian Islands are some of the most remote places in the world to hunt; they host the mighty reindeer, the largest antler-to-body animal in North America.
Eva goes on her first whitetail hunt on Anticosti Island, Quebec.
Fred Lackie leads three different hunts for black bear.
Joe Mantegna visits Quantico and examines the ballistics lab, responsible for testing firearms and armor for all FBI agents.
Joe Mantegna visits the vault, where the FBI stores its most famous confiscated weapons.
Chris and Casey Keefer must push to reach the LZ, with a failing raft. With only a few hours before extraction, will Mother Nature get the best of them before they can get to safety?
Chris and Casey Keefer recount their expedition to the South Pacific, by reliving some of their favorite and more challenging moments.

The Keefer brothers put boots to ground as their journey through Alaska begins. Armed with nothing but a couple of Glock 20s, the brothers immediately begin their search for their first supply-yielding cache.

The Keefer brothers awaken to a frozen tundra. With over 8 miles to cover and no oars, the brothers are forced to trudge their way through shallow water and barren earth as they head downstream in search of the second cache.

Two Michigan conservation officers look into a case of trespassing and violating the safety zone law during the firearm deer season; two experts in wild mushroom foraging go hunting for edibles; a look at potential scenarios for recruits.

A lawyer's astonishing correspondence; a woodland artist's beginnings; the power of Grayskull.
A familiar brand pedals domestic freedom to a culture ready for change, the naked truth behind Victorian-era erotica and an antique timepiece born out of tragedy keeps trains on track.

A catch-up with three sisters in Dorset to discover how their collapsed greenhouse turned into an opportunity to transform part of their garden. Plus, Monty plants garlic and onions, transplants foxgloves, and prepares his strawberry bed for winter.

At Longmeadow Monty checks the progress of the potatoes he planted earlier in the year and recommends plants for dry shade under trees. We travel to Somerset to get water-saving tips from a water scientist who uses a variety of techniques to save as much water as possible in her own garden, and we meet a gardener who has filled his home with over one thousand houseplants.

Monty and the team focus their attention on the loss of wildflower habitats in the UK and the part that gardeners can play in averting the resulting loss of wildlife. Adam Frost is in Lincolnshire to find out how crucial meadows are to supporting an ecosystem.

Monty is preparing for spring colour as well as harvesting pumpkins and squashes. Carol Klein visits comedian Joe Lycett at home, and together, they plant up a container packed with layers of colourful bulbs. Toby Buckland visits Sue Kent's garden near Swansea to help out with autumnal maintenance.

It's all about the maintenance this week at Longmeadow, as Monty cuts back and divides spring flowering plants. Joe Swift and Adam Frost meet up in Leicestershire to see how they can help a couple of novice gardeners turn a neglected area of their garden into a useable and useful space. Nick Bailey goes to Ham House in Richmond to see how they are coping with the ravages of box tree caterpillar and Arit Anderson visits a garden in Suffolk to find out about the concept of rewilding.

Monty has tips and ideas for planting up garden pots to provide a focal point over the winter months, Rachel visits the tulips of Keukenhof, Joe visits Esther Rantzen's much-loved garden, and Carol visits Glebe Cottage.

Charge your glasses as Joe Swift visits a 'drinkable' allotment in London where much of the produce is grown to make beer, wine and cider. In the first of a five-part series about botany, Carol Klein looks at the capsules of potential that herald the start and end of most plants' lives: seeds.

In the second of her films about botany, Carol Klein goes underground to unravel the mysteries of roots and why they are so important to the health of our plants. Joe Swift meets fashion icon, Dame Zandra Rhodes, to explore how the flowers she likes to grow have influenced her designs over the years.

Adam Frost shares the progress that's been made in his garden. Frances Tophill heads to the beach to reveal what gardeners can learn from the coastal plants which have evolved to cope with more extreme conditions.

Adam Frost is in his garden, bringing viewers up to date on how it has been developing, as well as giving advice on growing hydrangeas. Toby Buckland shares his tips on dealing with damaged shrubs, tree pruning and transplanting perennials.

Monty gives tips on moving plants which are in the wrong place or have outgrown their space, shows how to store chillies and harvests the last of his tomatoes. Rachel de Thame returns to Longmeadow to talk to Monty about her return to health and to plant up pots for spring colour.

With autumn just around the corner, Adam takes stock of his garden and plans ahead for some late-season interest under the supervision of Ash the cat. Plus, Frances visits a garden in Kent where the plants provide a non-stop buffet for insects.
Monty catches up with summer maintenance in his wildlife garden and recommends plants for deep, dry shade under trees, as well as giving advice on what to plant now for late summer harvests.

As autumn gathers momentum, it's time to start putting the garden to bed for winter. Monty Don has some timely advice on what to do. Carol Klein meets a nurseryman in Herefordshire, and together they indulge in the beauty of the Japanese maple.

From giant gooseberries and growing the perfect sweet pea to flamboyant dahlias and plants pollinated by a human hair, this week Monty celebrates the plant passions of some of the extraordinary people featured on the show over the last few years.
As autumn unfolds in the garden, Monty Don and Nigel make the most of the season and prepare for the winter ahead. Meanwhile, Carol Klein is in Surrey looking at wild and cultivated heathers.

Monty refreshes a container of overgrown herbs, plants alpines and revisits the shrub and perennial cuttings he took a few weeks ago. Arit Anderson meets a designer who is placing sustainability and the environment at the heart of her gardens.

At Longmeadow Monty is planting bulbs in pots and around the garden for an explosion of spring colour. Carol Klein travels to Yorkshire where she has a close look at the enormous colour range and form of a late season perennial, the salvia. Mark Lane is in Oxfordshire looking at how ornamental grasses can be used in planting design to create exciting combinations.
Monty is back at Longmeadow, getting stuck into more seasonal tasks. Joe Swift heads to Houghton Lodge Gardens in Hampshire renowned for its walled kitchen garden and heritage fruit collection.

As autumn unfolds in the garden, Monty Don has plenty to be getting on with at Longmeadow. In his quest to track down some of the nation's most remarkable allotments, Joe Swift visits a tropical paradise in Runcorn.

Monty Don has advice on how to successfully store an apple crop so it will last through winter and explains why he thinks it high time wall flowers came back into fashion. With tomatoes now over, Monty clears his greenhouse and plans for next year by planting garlic in the vegetable garden. Meanwhile, Carol is home at Glebe Cottage, dividing her perennials to continue the cost-effective stocking of her new beds.

At Longmeadow this week, Monty reaps a harvest from the vegetable garden, plants up a seasonal pot and gives a masterclass on how to make the perfect compost. Adam Frost travels to York to meet a couple who took on 20 acres of land and filled it with flowers.

Monty and the team are at RHS Rosemoor in Devon to find out about their fruit trees and sedum collection, and Joe visits Scampston Hall, home of a ten-year experiment in naturalistic planting by garden designer Piet Oudolf.

The vegetable garden is at its peak now and as well as harvesting, Monty has a look at how his autumn crops are faring as well as giving tips on how to keep the garden looking at its best. Adam Frost returns to Leicester where he has been helping to create a garden from scratch on a new build estate, and Frances Tophill celebrates the summer harvest on her shared allotment.

A celebration of people who are growing their own, from vegetables to flowers, across the UK. At Longmeadow, Monty shares tips and advice on how to get the most out of bargain plants. Meanwhile, Joe visits an extraordinary food project in Bristol.
Monty's dividing his Pulmonaria and gives advice on frost-protection, Joe visits a tropical oasis outside Bristol, and Carol looks at Rowans from around the world.
Daily talk show hosted by Geraldo Rivera and featuring on-the-street investigations and studio talk.
TAPS family members in Atlanta request the help of Jason and Grant to confirm their findings involving an exhibit of artifacts from the Titanic.
After purchasing the Spalding Inn located in Whitefield, N.H., Grant and Jason enlist the help of the "Ghost Hunters International" team to perform an investigation there.
The TAPS team travels to Newark, N.J. to investigate the abandoned Essex County Sanatorium and Hospital.
An invisible force attacks Jason during a private home investigation in Massachusetts.
Maryland's Samuel Mudd House; Virginia's Edgewood Plantation is the former home of Gov. Benjamin Harrison and his son, President William Henry Harrison.
TAPS investigates a Revolutionary War battlefield in Pennsylvania; the team travels to Virginia to investigate the home of Robert E. Lee.
The team investigates the Union County Courthouse in New Jersey; TAPS investigates paranormal activity in a 19th-century New Hampshire home.
TAPS investigates the historical Church of St. Andrew on Staten Island; the team travels to Chicago to investigate a former town hall meeting site called Benton House.
Singer Meatloaf joins TAPS for an investigation of a private island in the Thousand Islands.
The team investigates the USS Salem in Massachusetts and the Cornwall Jail in Ontario for paranormal activity.
Employees and visitors witness strange and frightening events at Fort Henry, a former prisoner-of-war camp during World War II.
TAPS investigates Congress Theater in Chicago when visitors report strange activity.
The team travels to Colorado to investigate paranormal activity at Briarhurst Manor.
Actor Eddie McClintock joins the TAPS team for an investigation of the grave of Buffalo Bill; the team investigates Oakland Hall in Eaton, Ga.
TAPS investigates the historical Amos Blake House in Fitzwilliam, N.H.; the team travels to Florida to investigate a historical museum.
The TAPS crew investigates paranormal activity at a lighthouse in Pensacola, Fla.
TAPS investigates the home of author Mark Twain in Hartford, Conn.
The team investigates the American Legion in Willow Grove, Penn., for signs of the lingering spirits of veterans; an investigation of the Old State House in Hartford, Conn.
TAPS travels to Lakehurst, N.J., to investigate the Hindenburg crash site.
A visit to Alcatraz, one of America's most notorious prisons, in search of the Birdman's spirit.
The team visits an 18th-century fort where voices have been heard whispering in English and French.
The team investigates a haunted Irish pub in New York City and the Harriet Beecher Stowe House in Connecticut.
The team travels to Atlantic City, where it visits the Absecon lighthouse.
Expect supernatural shenanigans as the team visits Southern Mansion Hotel in Cape May, New Jersey; there are tales that the original owner's daughter haunts the building.

Things turn ugly inside a beauty salon for a veteran investigator and his team; a ghost hunter discovers that a remote island is alive with history; investigators unleash evil while investigating a historic home.

When demon hunter Tim Wood is called to a former hospital in Texas where a poltergeist is believed to travel between the abandoned site and a nearby town, he and his team undertake a dangerous experiment to trap the entity on the grounds permanently.

Demon hunter Tim Wood is called to San Antonio to expel an evil presence from a historic mansion, but the case takes a dark turn when a strange doll found on the property reveals a spine-chilling premonition.
The team members investigate demon hunter Tim Wood's erratic behavior; they wage an all-out battle for Tim's soul, which leads to a confrontation with the demon known as Zozo.
A frightened homeowner's security system captures unexplained voices so terrifying that she must leave her house.
Amy and Adam head to Pennsylvania to help a family make sense of unexplainable happenings on their desolate property and find the spirit stalking them.
A shadow man terrorizes a small boy, and his mom is so frightened by the activity she won't use their living space.
An investigation into a shadowy figure takes an emotional turn for Amy when a psychic makes a shocking discovery; a growling voice makes the team fear the ghost is more negative than they believed.
A menacing ghost frightens an 11-year-old girl, and she refuses to sleep alone in her room; Amy and Adam uncover answers about a disturbed grave of a giant Native American man.
A hostile spirit attacks a homeowner and smashes objects, leading the investigation to a breakthrough in an infamous unsolved murder.

An unknown entity torments a teenager afraid to live in his own home; Amy and Adam investigate a creepy crawlspace in an upstairs bedroom that could be tied to the tragic death of a grandfather who was buried alive.

A family won't step foot in the basement because of a brutal murder that took place there, but the kids are still seeing shadow figures and a scary man in the closet; Amy and Adam find evidence on camera.

A terrified couple calls for help after witnessing a chair levitate in their home; Amy endures a chilling paranormal experience in an upstairs bedroom; a psychic's visit later reveals a horrifying truth that leaves Adam and Amy shocked.
A full-bodied apparition terrorizes two young girls at night and Adam and Amy catch it on camera; a heinous murder committed more than 100 years ago might help close the investigation.

Adam and Amy investigate one of the most infamous places in America, the Lizzie Borden House; one of the tour guides experiences terrifying paranormal activity and fears for her life, and Adam and Amy discover there's a life hanging in the balance.
A household lives in fear when a malicious spirit targets the children.
Adam and Amy investigate the home of a former executioner who killed hundreds of criminals, and now something's trying to kill the current homeowner.
Amy and Adam investigate two properties simultaneously, and both homes are afflicted by the same entity; a cache of haunted objects is key to solving this case, but they belonged to different people.
A home in constant turmoil leaves a child sleepless in a room haunted by a shadowy mass that scares the child at night and taunts his mother, growling at her from the closet.

A home gets set ablaze, and the owners insist upon a paranormal cause; the daughter believes something targets her family, prompting Amy and Adam to think she might be psychic and launch a unique investigation.
Amy and Adam investigate an aggressive spirit who terrorizes a woman everywhere she goes.

A family lives in fear because of airborne box cutters, hair pulling and other unexplainable paranormal activity; Adam and Amy discover that one of the spirits in the home has a vital message to deliver.

Amy and Adam are called to Liberty, Mo., to investigate the Odd Fellows Home, a massive compound that once cared for orphans and the elderly; more than 10,000 people died on the property, and their pain has fostered a malevolent entity.
Amy Bruni and Adam Berry investigate a Connecticut home where lives may be at stake; their client believes an evil entity is responsible for killing her children and is living in her home.
Amy and Adam investigate a haunted mirror in Gettysburg, Pa.; abnormal activity turns to unrest when an entity suddenly became physical; Amy and Adam wonder if the mirror is a portal.

Amy and Adam visit the Waverly Hills Sanatorium in Louisville, Ky.; considered one of the most haunted locations in the United States, the building houses countless spirits, including a dangerous entity on the fourth floor.

In Tennessee, Amy and Adam investigate Hales Bar Dam, a location cursed by a chieftain warlord; centuries later the curse still wreaks havoc on the land, and the current owner fears an evil entity is out for revenge.
Amy and Adam investigate a Virginia plantation where an evil overseer has returned to strike fear into the living by seeking out the dead he once brutalized.

Amy and Adam investigate violent spiritual activity that's threatening a young family residing in one of the oldest homes on Cape Cod in Massachusetts; they break new ground as they unveil a never-before-seen paranormal experiment.
Amy and Adam investigate an Iowa farmhouse where a family was brutally murdered by an unknown assailant in 1912; they fear the killer's spirit haunts the home.

After her mother dies, a young woman returns to her hometown to take custody of her 12-year-old half sister. As she confronts her troubled past, she finds solace in an old classmate who gave up his sports dreams to paint watercolors.
In the 10 years before the creation of Mickey Mouse, Walt Disney struggles to master the art and business of animation.
Encouraged by his grandfather, a boy faces his fears and makes new friends at summer camp.
Ray Berry, an NSA analyst, becomes involved in a top-secret investigation when a computer virus crashes the government's computers.

Donna Lawrence, the survivor of a pit bull attack, adopts a pit bull mix puppy that was beaten, set afire and left for dead. Together, they learn to love and forgive as they seek justice and protection for all animals.
A struggling musician becomes a 12-year-old musical prodigy's guardian for a summer.
The airport on the island of Baltra in the Galápagos is about two hours from Quito, Ecuador.
China has one tenth of the world's wetlands with the diversity types and various species.
The world is like a giant delicatessen.
Depending on the part of the world, eating with one's hands could be a sign of good or bad manners.
A making-of episode featuring the adventures and misadventures of "Wild Latam" filmmakers as they travel across Latin America.
The land linking the two American continents is home to rich and diverse rainforests.
A focus on visual language and animal species which transmit information while maintaining eye contact.
Exploring the manufacture and use of cables, turnbuckles, ropes and anything else that can be used to tie, hang from or lasso.
Scientists examine evidence of climate change and the impact it is having on water and animals.
Despite being an essential element for life, humans are making worse and worse use of water.
There are two types of clients at this restaurant called Earth: the gluttons and the ascetics.
At mealtime, many animals prefer company; their eating companions don't even need to be of the same species.
Queen Saovabha Memorial Institute staff is informed of a villager bitten by a mysterious snake in Chiang Mai, but the snake's carcass sent to the staff remains unidentifiable.
As one of the ecosystems on Earth, the city was the latest to be born; it was created to meet human needs, but other forms of life are also endeavoring to find their own habitat here.
Showcases the lives of a white-breasted waterhen and orphaned lesser whistling ducklings in the Singapore Botanic Gardens.
English naturalist David Attenborough explores the lush and vibrant landscapes of the islands of Singapore as he comes across a vast range of wild creatures.
Malaysian superstar Michelle Yeoh returns to home to see her adopted orangutan for first time.
The Great Barrier Reef lies in the Coral Sea. Here wildlife flourishes in the pristine, tropical seas, home to the world's richest marine ecosystem.
Following otters and other wildlife thriving in Singapore's urban waterways, revealing their adaptability and unseen behaviors.
A look at the amazing fauna and peculiar ecosystems in the Mediterranean.
The native Mediterranean wildlife and nature of Menorca; this Spanish island is a biosphere reserve since over 25 years, and is home to animals and plants that can be found nowhere else in the world.

Beginning in the exquisite fishing port of Bosa, Yotam prepares one of the Mediterranean's classic meals, freshly caught lobster on an open fire pit; leaving the coast behind, he then travels into the rugged Sardinian heartland.
Zucchini-yogurt pie; lamb baked in Greek yogurt; Greek yogurt cheesecake.
Spanakopita macaroni and cheese; baked feta-stuffed calamari; sloppy yianni; pan-fried red mullets and sardines.

Jeremy begins with chili oil noodles, while Joe Swash seeks to master kung pao chicken; Jeremy also receives a masterclass in filleting before firing up the catch of the day on the beach; his last dish is peanut butter French toast.

Jeremy's BBQ chicken wings with spicy slaw; Joe prepares Malaysian fried rice; after being inspired by drunken prawns in a home dedicated to whisky, Jeremy makes cinnamon bao doughnuts and chocolate sauce.
Artisanal cheeses; chef Jorge Vallejo uses doble crema (double cream) cheese to make huazontles and quesillo to make cheese soup; whole milk ricotta.
Home-cooked meals in Hunucmá, Yucatán; Panaderia Liz in Mérida; hojaldras -- a pastry stuffed with ham, cheese and chili; frijol con puerco.
Corn-husked tamales at Tamales Teresita; banana-leaf-wrapped chiapanecos style tamales; classic Central-style tamales; sweet corn tamale.

Chef Pedro Abascal uses local farms to supply his hotel restaurants; lamb farm; making roasted lamb in adobo at C-Grill; grilled leg of lamb with green garlic mojo and camote mash; grilled asparagus with pasilla crema; skillet cake.

Executive Chef Sabrina Stillhart shares the secrets behind a few of Gordon Ramsay's signature dishes at Bread Street Kitchen, Gordon chooses an intern for his restaurant in Singapore, and tastes some whisky with Mr. Whisky.
Neroteca is a hidden gem of a restaurant in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia, where Chef Stefano Criber delivers tastes and flavor profiles from Abruzzo, Italy, to Malaysia.
An up-close look at why other restaurants are no match for Pollen in terms of diners' delight.

Chef Phillip is welcomed to Daniel Boulud's DB Bistro Moderne in the atrium of the Marina Bay Sands Resort and Casino, where the classic Parisian Bistro is reinterpreted under Executive Chef Jonathan Kinsella.

Chefs Tetsuya Wakuda, Justin Quek, and David Myers wine and dine at their upper echelon restaurants, share their love of food, introduce a few special dishes, and share one of their master class sessions.
An up-close look at what makes Fairmont Singapore's Anti:dote different from the rest.
The restaurants and the culinary masters have more to share.
Chef Phillip steps into celebrity Japanese chef Tetsuya Wakuda's second outlet outside the original in Sydney, Waku Ghin.
Sampling a variety of tastes, from German sausages ordered through the Internet, to the vines behind the wines of Austria.
Taking a chance on Vegas with "Culinary Travels"; sampling a 16-course menu at the M.G.M. Grand before heading off the strip to Lake Las Vegas.
Jason travels to Perth to experience the city's unforgettable dining and goes on a food adventure for crayfishes, truffles, and finger limes.
Tom cooks southern fried chicken-in-a-basket, as he pays homage to the perfect pub-garden meal.
Carolyn Scott-Hamilton, the Healthy Voyager, demonstrates how to prepare vegan zucchini tarragon soup and white bean hummus with special guest Julianna Heaver.

Tony Bourdain tries to get lost in Chiang Mai, Thailand; his journey entails an impromptu elephant ride through the jungle, amazing meals with a Thai family on a farm, taking in some kick-boxing and trying Thai massage.
Anthony samples kids' liver salad, roasted pig's head, grilled ox heart and breaded pigtail, then a traditional pie and mashed potatoes, and afterward takes a tour of the local Indian community.
Tony joins Jose at the family farm to enjoy a fattened pig at the village feast, and then travels to a destination from his childhood where he debates eating a calf's head.

Jeremy's pork sando with homemade tonkatsu sauce; Joe tries his hand at crispy chili beef; Jeremy cooks up scallops on the shore of Loch Ewe, while his sticky toffee pudding takes things to another level.

Jeremy starts with Sichuanese chicken; during his lesson, Joe tries to master the Wonton fold; on the Gower Peninsula, Jeremy makes spicy Xinjiang lamb and mixed veg skewers, followed by a spicy steamed plum pudding.

Yotam explores Israel's fresh produce and seafood, and cooks with cutting-edge chefs. Excited by the country's abundance of fruit and vegetables, he also travels to a remote farm, and forages for ingredients in the hills of Jerusalem.

Catherine Fulvio travels to Boston with Marian Sinnott's recipe for a chicken paprika dish; she also visits the iconic "Cheers" pub as well as walking the famous grounds of the prestigious Harvard University.

After revisiting a handful of flavorful moments from around the world, Catherine recreates some of the unique recipes she has tasted on her travels to South Africa, and she teaches how to cook the same breathtaking dishes at home.

Ireland's top 6 chippers fry their way into the hearts and minds of Chef Dylan McGrath, takeaway expert Suzie Lee, and celebrity judge Deirdre O'Kane, to ultimately compete in the season's final cook off challenge.
Peruvian game hens with creamy salsa verde; huli-huli spare ribs; Brazilian rotisserie pineapple.
Buffalo broccoli with blue cheese drizzle; Cajun hobo packs; mystery box challenge -- mushrooms.
Steven Raichlen discusses the many approaches to steak that he has demonstrated over the years on his television shows.
Cold-smoked scallops with smoked tomatoes, jicama-mango salsa; smoke-roasted chicken with horseradish glaze; apple-smoked ribs with prickly pear barbecue sauce.
Bacon made from scratch; Canadian bacon; bacon weave sausage roll; snow crab poppers.
Grilled sea urchin and grilled whelk; lobster and grilled Alaskan king crab; bone-in veal chops; rotisserie beef plate ribs with fire-roasted onions and peppers and Chilean salsa.

Yotam begins his Mediterranean journey in the vibrant city of Marrakesh, inspiring his inner chef to create; he then travels to the luminous Atlas Mountains to dine with the Berbers before venturing onward to the coastal town of Essaouira.
Amid the pandemic, Gwynn grows bored with her relationship with Adam. A sex dream involving their friend Lance ignites fantasies, transforming her COVID bubble into a chaotic love triangle.
A team of former Soviet superheroes, assembled during the Cold War to combat a dangerous scientist, is dispatched against destructive robots.

Duke Diver is living the high life as the freewheeling manager of a luxurious resort in Palm Springs, Calif. He soon faces competition from Leo, a former military man who likes the same woman that Duke is interested in. When Diver's past suddenly catches up with him, he must put aside his differences and reluctantly team up with Leo to stop whoever is trying to kill him.

In his small North Carolina hometown, Ron Clark (Matthew Perry) leads a comfortable life as a successful elementary school teacher, earning the respect of the community. However, he knows there are students elsewhere who need him more. Following his inner calling, Clark uproots to New York City, hoping to make a difference for the disenfranchised youths the school system has left behind. Clark makes it his mission to turn around the worst students, even though he knows his job is on the line.

Sinatra and his adult son, Paul, live on the edge of the law in the Brazilian urban jungle of São Paulo. They make a meager living running a brothel, but what profits they make Paul gambles away. When a customer dies on their premises, leaving behind a suitcase brimming with drugs, Sinatra sees a way to start a new life for his new wife and her young child. But his scheme quickly gets complicated when Paul sees the opportunity to take a calculated risk.

Judy (Jordana Beatty) has planned the most awesome summer ever and can't wait to have adventures with her best friends, Rocky and Amy. Then she finds out that Rocky is off to tame lions and that Amy is flying to Borneo with her mother to save a lost tribe. Judy is bummed to be left home with her rotten brother, Stink (Parris Mosteller), and her second-best friend, Frank Pearl. And, what's worse, her parents go to California and leave her with an aunt (Heather Graham) she's never even met.

In this animated musical, the villainous King Haggard (Christopher Lee) plots to destroy all the world's unicorns. When a young unicorn (Mia Farrow) learns that she's in danger and that she may soon be the last of her kind, she leaves the safety of her protected forest and enlists the help of Schmendrick (Alan Arkin), a gentle, albeit clumsy, sorcerer. Together, they embark on a long and dangerous journey with one goal: to defeat Haggard and save the unicorns from extinction.

Teenage Rachel (Lindsay Lohan) is a real thorn in the side of her mother, Lilly (Felicity Huffman). More than just rebellious, she is incorrigible. After Rachel crashes a car, Lilly decides to haul the girl off to a place to which she vowed never to return: Her own mother's (Jane Fonda) Idaho home. Georgia, the family matriarch, lives by a strict code and expects all under her roof to do the same. Given structure and purpose, Rachel's anger at the world begins to subside.
The two remaining Welsh chefs cook their four courses again for the judges. One chef will be chosen to represent Wales in the national finals, taking them a step closer to cooking at the banquet.

Three of Northern Ireland's top chefs - Chris McGowan, Danni Barry and Ben Arnold - go head-to-head with their starter courses to impress this week's veteran judge. Germany is in decline. Once the world's most powerful country is now being devastated by WWII. Adolf Hitler has gone into hiding. The dreaded ruler is no longer openly supporting his people. He is slowly losing his mind.

Explore the complexities of the man who would become one of history's most infamous figures. From his obscure beginnings in Austria to his meteoric rise as Germany's Führer, dive deep into the forces that shaped Hitler's ideology and his leadership.

This documentary programme uses archival footage, interviews and dramatic reconstructions to tell the story of the rise of the Nazis through time as well as the continued rise of Neo-Nazis. `The Rise of the Nazi Party' reveals how the National Socialists exploited economic turmoil to get into power in Germany in 1933 before leading the nation into an era of genocide and military defeat. It profiles the people who helped the Nazis bring destruction to Europe, including Hitler, Himmler and Goebbels.
As punishment for the 1923 'Putsch', Hitler is banned from public speaking. Now he employs Joseph Goebbels to feed Hitler's political ideology to the masses.
Hitler seizes his chance in the wake of The Great Depression, turning the people on the incumbent Democratic Weimar Government and promising a brighter future.
A month after coming to power, Hitler addresses his people through the radio. He promises to make the economy his priority - and the task ahead is massive.
Hitler summons Germany's military leaders to a shock meeting at his headquarters. He lays out his plans for military expansion into neighbouring territories.
Investigate Hitler's biggest mistake, and explore how the German people begin to see through the facade of the Nazi propaganda machine.
Explore how Adolf Hitler and the Nazi Party groomed the German people into thinking the genocide of Jewish people was a morally correct decision.
Explore how with Nazi Germany on the back foot, Hitler's attempts to cling to power become ever more desperate, leading to ever more deplorable consequences.
Explore how the Allies final advance on Nazi Germany in January 1945 sounded the death knell for the Third Reich, a regime which continued with its lies to the very end.

In 1986, cult actress Susan Cabot is found dead in her Los Angeles home; suspicion immediately falls on her son, Timothy Roman, the only witness and immediate suspect; what begins as a shocking Hollywood murder soon opens into a darker story.

The investigation deepens and Timothy's story becomes more complex; Timothy's life was shaped not only by his mother's troubled past but by a chapter in American medical history, as a patient enrolled in a now-buried clinical experiment.

Susan's body is discovered in her bedroom, bloodied, broken and surrounded by confusion; Timothy offers a surreal account of masked intruders, but his story unravels quickly; under pressure, he admits the truth.
Among the secret murders explored are Judith Roberts, Mary Judge in Leeds in 1968, a schoolgirl killed in Staffordshire in 1972 and Carol Wilkinson, a bakery worker murdered in Bradford in 1977.

The pressure continues to build on West Yorkshire Police; on top of the crimes that police decide to include in the Ripper investigation, murders and attempted murders with a clear link to the killer are discarded and left unsolved.

By 1885, beloved cavalryman Buffalo Bill Cody (Paul Newman) has hired a publicist and producer to help shape and promote his traveling Wild West show, which presents historically inaccurate reenactments of conflicts between U.S. troops and Native Americans. Cody hires Chief Sitting Bull (Frank Kaquitts) to play himself, as a villain, in stagings of the Battle of the Little Bighorn. But, to Cody's dismay, star performer Annie Oakley (Geraldine Chaplin) and spectators both take to Sitting Bull.

Three cowboy movie stars from the silent era -- Dusty Bottoms (Chevy Chase), Lucky Day (Steve Martin) and Ned Nederlander (Martin Short) -- are fired when one of their movies bombs. In what seems to be a career-saving offer, young Mexican woman Carmen (Patrice Martinez) offers them a high-paying gig in her village. The three jump at the opportunity, expecting to do their typical act, but Carmen believes they are really heroes and asks them to rid her village of bad guy El Guapo (Alfonso Arau).

Dillon (Peter Mullan) is a pioneer who defied the harsh winter in search of rumored gold. Having amassed unimaginable riches, he runs a thriving mining town called Kingdom Come. But the blind ambition and greed that drove him to succeed finally catches up to him with the arrival of 3 strangers. Dalglish (Wes Bentley) a surveyor looking to expand the railroad threatens the future of the town -- and 2 women from Dillon's past hold a secret that could be his undoing.

When diphtheria breaks out at Fort Humboldt, a train is dispatched with medical supplies and relief troops. Also on board are Utah's governor (Richard Crenna), his mistress (Jill Ireland), a marshal (Ben Johnson) and his prisoner, outlaw John Deakin (Charles Bronson). As the train passes through the mountains, soldiers go missing, telegraph lines are cut, and it's discovered that there is no epidemic. There's a conspiracy afoot, and it's up to Deakin, actually a federal agent, to expose it.

When an aging Wild Bill Hickok (Charles Bronson) finds his dreams invaded by the image of a rampaging white buffalo, he decides the only remedy is to find and kill the creature. With the help of his old friend Charlie (Jack Warden), he sets out across the snowy plains, unaware that he's not the only one looking for the fabled beast. Sioux Chief Crazy Horse (Will Sampson) has recently lost a daughter to the white buffalo, and he fears the girl's soul won't rest until he kills it.

In this movie based on a true story, Ned Kelly (Mick Jagger) has served a three-year prison sentence for stealing horses and is released. However, he cannot even begin to get his life in order before his mother (Clarissa Kaye) is arrested and falsely charged with murder. This is the last straw for Ned, who goes on a crime spree with his group, including Joe Byrne (Mark McManus) and Ned's brother, Dan (Allen Bickford). However, eventually the law catches up to them, forcing a fateful showdown.

During a drunken spree in the small Wild West town of Bannock, one of a half-dozen workers from a nearby ranch accidentally shoots an innocent man. Bannock's marshal, a righteous man named Jered Maddox (Burt Lancaster), comes to the larger town of Sabbath bearing the dead body of one of the revelers and demands the surrender of the remaining five from sheriff Cotton Ryan (Robert Ryan) and ranch owner Vincent Bronson (Lee J. Cobb), starting a confrontation that threatens to engulf them all.
Two teenage girls rally what's left of the Doolin-Dalton outlaw gang after Doolin is caught.

A group of Apaches visits a cavalry fort in hopes of laying down their weapons and coming to a peace agreement, but Maj. Wharton (J. Ian Douglas), wanting to make a name for himself, orders his men to massacre them. Meanwhile, Col. Garrett (Kent Taylor) believes his flirtatious wife is sleeping with Capt. Thompson (Ben Johnson), so he tries to get rid of the captain by ordering him to track Victorio (Larry Chance), a notorious Apache warrior who's plotting a large-scale attack on the fort.

After the Civil War, veteran Ben Shelby (Ben Johnson) travels to Arizona to seek out fellow veteran Johnny Tallon (Dane Clark). After saving Johnny's blind brother, Ned (Peter Graves), from being trampled by a horse, Ben accompanies him to the family ranch. While Ben and Ned become friends, Ned's uncle grows suspicious about Ben's claim of friendship with Johnny. As they all wait for news of Johnny, they face an Indian attack and the arrival of vengeful former soldiers also seeking Johnny.

Inspired by the Battle of the Little Bighorn, this Western follows a selfish military leader, Gen. Frederick McCabe (Andrew Duggan), who unfeelingly throws his soldiers into dangerous battle situations, and the soldiers who must follow his orders. While waiting to be sent into combat, two of the men -- Harrod (Tom Tryon) and Rogers (Harve Presnell) -- find themselves in the midst of a love triangle as they both pursue the heart of the beautiful Lou Woddard (Senta Berger).

Set during the Civil War, Colonel John Marlowe leads a Union Calvary brigade on a mission behind Confederate lines to destroy enemy railroads and supplies. The colonel is confronted with numerous challenges before reaching Union held Baton Rouge.

In 1836, the Mexican army, led by General Santa Anna, is invading Texas. Hoping to create a diversion for Santa Anna's forces, General Sam Houston (Richard Boone) orders Colonel William B. Travis (Laurence Harvey), joined by Colonels Jim Bowie (Richard Widmark) and Davy Crockett (John Wayne), to lead a small, heroic band of American and Texican fighters in a resistance battle at the Alamo mission. The carnage at the Alamo further spurs the Republic of Texas toward freedom.

Con motivo del 50.º aniversario del Mustang, Ford desmonta un modelo y lo lleva a un lugar insólito: la cima del Empire State Building. Allí, los mecánicos recomponen las piezas y presentan el modelo de aniversario del legendario "pony car".

En 1964, Ferruccio Lamborghini tenía un sueño: quería construir el mejor coche deportivo del mundo. A pocos kilómetros de la sede de Ferrari. Su primer coche, el 350 GT, dejó en la sombra cualquier comparación con sus competidores de Maranello.
La vida de Ferruccio Lamborghini, quien originalmente construyó tractores, pero luego fundó una de las fábricas de automóviles deportivos más famosas del mundo.
Ferdinand Anton Ernst Porsche fue un pionero de la industria automotriz y el creador de un coche considerado un ícono, el Porsche 356.

Los estadounidenses demostraron que también podían construir coches ganadores. El Ford GT 40 es uno de estos coches. Al principio, el proyecto Victory at Le Mans de Ford USA amenazaba con fracasar.

El Ford Mustang Shelby GT-500 nació de la fibra de los años 60 y de la experiencia en carreras de Carroll Shelby, quien marcó récord de velocidad. Su estilo bulevar de paseo y su motor potente lo transformaron en uno de los más vendidos de su época.

After traveling to a remote Moroccan outpost, LeFevre and his regiment suffer repeated attacks at the hands of the Berber rebel army. In the winter of 1944, American soldiers led by Will Knott (Ethan Hawke) are assigned to capture a small squad of German soldiers posted in France's Ardennes forest. Tired of war, the Americans have already lost half their division and discover that their German enemy is equally unwilling to fight. With Jewish soldier Stan Shutzer (Arye Gross) interpreting, the Germans and Americans agree on a plan that will let the former surrender without violence -- but then, tragedy strikes.

Crysta is a fairy who lives in FernGully, a rainforest in Australia, and has never seen a human before. In fact, she is told they are extinct. But when a logging company comes near the rainforest, she sees that they do exist, and even accidentally shrinks one of them: a boy named Zak. Now her size, Zak sees the damage that the company does and helps Crysta to stop not only them, but an evil entity named Hexxus, who feeds off pollution.

Nearly two decades after being committed to a mental institution for killing his stepfather and older sister, Michael Myers breaks out, intent on returning to the town of Haddonfield, Ill. He arrives in his hometown on Halloween with the indomitable purpose of hunting down his younger sister, Laurie. The only thing standing between Michael and a Halloween night of bloody carnage is psychologist Dr. Samuel Loomis.

A year after narrowly escaping death at the hands of Michael Myers (Tyler Mane), Laurie Strode is at the breaking point, pushed to the edge by Dr. Loomis' (Malcolm McDowell) revelation that she's Michael's sister. Little does she know, the unstoppable killer is back in Haddonfield and, driven by visions of their dead mother (Sheri Moon Zombie), he is determined to bring about a bloody family reunion.
A radio DJ (Sheri Moon Zombie) in Salem, Mass., is plagued by nightmarish visions of vengeful witches after she plays a record by a mysterious group known only as "The Lords."

An empty fuel tank and a flat tire lead two couples down a terror-riddled road to the House of 1000 Corpses. House of 1000 Corpses is at its core a story of family - a cast of twisted individuals who, with each slash of a throat or stab through the chest, add bodies to their sick human menagerie.

After a raid on the rural home of the psychopathic Firefly family, two members of the clan, Otis (Bill Moseley) and Baby (Sheri Moon Zombie), manage to flee the scene. Heading to a remote desert motel, the killers reunite with Baby's father, Capt. Spaulding (Sid Haig), who is equally demented and intent on maintaining their murder spree. While the trio continues to torment and kill various victims, the vengeful Sheriff Wydell (William Forsythe) slowly closes in on them.

Jonas (Brenton Thwaites) lives in a seemingly idyllic world of conformity and contentment. When he begins to spend time with The Giver (Jeff Bridges), an old man who is the sole keeper of the community's memories, Jonas discovers the dangerous truths of his community's secret past. Armed with the power of knowledge, Jonas realizes that he must escape from their world to protect himself and those he loves -- a challenge no one has ever completed successfully.

While scavenging for copper wire, Detroit teenager Eli Solinski stumbles upon a high-tech gun that holds special powers. When his brother, Jimmy, lands in trouble with a local crime boss, the two siblings take the mysterious weapon and go on the run. Eli and Jimmy now find themselves in a life-and-death battle against an army of thugs and two heavily armored, futuristic soldiers who want their gun back.

Fifty years after it was buried in a time capsule, a schoolgirl's cryptic document falls into the hands of Caleb Koestler, the son of professor John Koestler (Nicolas Cage). John figures out that the encoded message accurately lists every major disaster from the past five decades, and predicts three future calamities -- one a global cataclysm. When his warnings fall on deaf ears, John enlists the help of the prophetic author's daughter and granddaughter to try to avert the ultimate disaster.
A marshal (Sam Elliott) tracks an escaped murderess (Linda Fiorentino) who is running with a stagecoach robber (Craig Sheffer).

A Pinkerton agent pursues the James (Rob Lowe, Bill Paxton) and Younger brothers as they rob banks, stagecoaches and trains.

After escaping from a chain gang, Luke (Jim Brown) partners with tough prospector Jaroo (Lee Van Cleef) to search for gold in a Mexican fort. The enterprising duo manage to convince Apache chief Santana (Iron Eyes Cody) and his tribe to help them infiltrate the fort, which is defended by Mexican military officer Chavez (Patrick O'Neal) and his men. While things don't go according to plan, Chavez's lover, Claudine (Mariana Hill), falls for Luke, which proves helpful to the scrappy bandits.
A Confederate soldier (Tom Selleck) returns to his Arizona homestead and finds Union sympathizers have laid claim to his land.
A scout (Rod Cameron) leads a wagon train through territory made hostile by a violated treaty.

Wrongly imprisoned for murder, John Brant (John Wayne) decides his only option is to escape from jail and clear his name by finding the true killer. After breaking out, he ends up on the run from Sheriff Parker (Bob Burns) and catches the attention of outlaw Bob Jones (Lane Chandler), who offers to let Brant into his gang. Needing all the help he can get, Brant agrees, but running with these bandits only gets him deeper into trouble -- while the real killer remains on the loose.

Undercover government agent Randy Bowers (John Wayne) rides into a small town, happening upon a saloon that's just been shot up. Wary of the newcomer, the sheriff (Earle Dwire) arrests Randy for the murders, but the saloon owner's niece, Sally Rogers (Alberta Vaughn), helps him escape because she knows he didn't do it. Randy then sets out to find the man behind the murders and is led to an evil mastermind named Marvin Black (George Hayes), who has been passing himself off as an innocent mute.

When a yearly high-stakes poker game begins between the five richest men in Laredo, Texas, all other activity in the Wild West town comes to a stop as everyone gathers to watch the action. Recovering gambler Meredith (Henry Fonda), passing through town on the way to San Antonio, gets roped into the game by lawyer Otto Habershaw (Kevin McCarthy). When the stress of the game becomes too much to bear, his disapproving wife, Mary (Joanne Woodward), must step in to save the family fortune.

During the Civil War, Union forces stationed in Colorado are hampered by raiders who have been stealing their horses as they travel through the mountains. When several commanding officers begin to suspect a traitor is revealing troop movements, Maj. Lex Kearny (Gary Cooper) goes undercover to investigate. However, the assignment strains Kearny's relationship with his wife, Erin (Phyllis Thaxter), after he chooses to continue the operation instead of searching for their runaway son.

A few years ago, Larry Madden (Randolph Scott) left his fiancée, Corinna (Dorothy Malone), after a run-in with her father, the wealthy landowner Tucker Ordway (Robert Barrat). After saving a man (William Ching) from a vicious attack, Larry learns he is actually Corinna's new husband, and that some of the locals are preparing to challenge Tucker's land ownership. When Larry decides to ride back into town and make a claim himself, he encounters a few unexpected obstacles.

Jim Killian arrives in a small Arizona town hoping to establish a peaceful life as the local preacher, but he soon finds himself in the middle of a feud between sheep ranchers and cattlemen. Leloopa, a young Native American woman, pleads for Killian's help after her shepherd father is hanged by Coke Beck, the vicious son of the head cattle rancher. Killian must weigh his actions carefully lest he perpetuate the cycle of retribution and revenge.

A Pitufo Filósofo no le gustan los chismes, y crea un hechizo que hace que a todos los soplones les crezca cola. Sin embargo, con cola, los Pitufos son presa fácil de Gargamel.

La nueva cosechadora automatizada de Genio y las máquinas de procesamiento de alimentos son un alivio para los Pitufos, que tienen mucho trabajo. Sin embargo, debido a ellas, empiezan a desperdiciar mucha comida.

Nadie le cree al Abuelo Pitufo cuando habla de junglas y sabanas lejanas, repletas de gatos salvajes gigantes, caballos a rayas, comedores de hojas de cuello largo y extrañas tribus. Pero tiene la ocasión de demostrar que no está mintiendo.

Gargamel utiliza pitufresas como sustituto de las cerezas asfixiantes para dar vida a un gigante.

Gargamel crea una historia; Genio se niega a otorgar deseos.

Gargamel envía al bosque las semillas de una enredadera para atrapar a los pitufos, pero Genio tiene la solución.

Dos Papás Pitufo pueden dar el doble de buenos consejos y el doble de amor que uno solo. Sin embargo, después de un tiempo, las cosas se complican en exceso en la aldea. Sobre todo cuando otro accidente hace que Gargamel también se duplique.
El malvado Maestro pinta cuadros vivientes capaces de atrapar a los modelos adentro. Pero Papá Pitufo tiene un plan para enseñarle una lección al Maestro.
Gargamel gasta una broma a los pitufos disfrazándose de arbusto de pitufresas.
